jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1539555&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelors degree with a major in Marketing Additional Requirements Strong interest in Sales & Marketing Career-oriented and willing to build a long-term career Freshers are encouraged to apply Responsibilities & Context ORTRIO Limited, a subsidiary of AKSID Corporation Limited, is the exclusive distribution partner for a leading manufacturer of specialty water treatment chemicals in Bangladesh. We are seeking a mid-level Marketing & Sales Representative to drive new customer acquisition and revenue growth across industrial sectors. This role is ideal for a technically proficient sales professional eager to excel in a high-growth, B2B technical sales environment. Key Responsibilities New Business Development: Identify and acquire new customers across targeted industries including textiles, food & beverage, pharmaceuticals, power, and manufacturing. Build a strong sales pipeline and expand the market for water treatment chemicals. Client Relationship Management: Develop strong relationships with plant managers, engineers, procurement teams, and other key decision-makers. Conduct regular site visits to understand customer requirements. Technical Sales & Consulting: Provide technical guidance on water treatment solutions, including boiler, cooling tower, RO, and wastewater applications. Conduct product presentations, demonstrations, and trials. Sales Target Achievement: Meet and exceed assigned sales targets through effective territory management, account planning, negotiation, and customer conversion while maintaining company profitability guidelines. Market Intelligence: Track market trends, competitor activities, and customer needs, providing relevant insights to management. Reporting & Coordination: Maintain sales records, prepare forecasts and reports, and coordinate with technical, marketing, logistics, and customer service teams to ensure effective customer support. Working Conditions Work Environment: Based at AKSIDs Head Office in Dhaka, with a significant amount of time spent in the field. Expect a field-oriented role, visiting industrial facilities, production plants, and client offices regularly. Travel Requirements: Frequent travel within Bangladesh (up to 60-70% of the time) to meet clients on-site. This includes travel to industrial hubs outside Dhaka. A valid driving license and willingness to travel by car and occasionally by air/rail to distant client sites are required. Reporting Line: You will report to the Managing Director at Ortrio. Regular meetings and reporting will be required to discuss pipeline status, market issues, and strategy. Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams including technical service engineers from Metito, marketing team, and customer service/logistics to ensure timely product delivery and support. Schedule: Full-time position (weekday business hours), with flexibility needed to accommodate client schedules. Occasionally, you may need to attend industry events or client meetings in evenings or weekends as per business needs. Requirements Education Bachelors degree with a major in Marketing Additional Requirements Strong interest in Sales & Marketing Career-oriented and willing to build a long-term career Freshers are encouraged to apply Responsibilities & Context ORTRIO Limited, a subsidiary of AKSID Corporation Limited, is the exclusive distribution partner for a leading manufacturer of specialty water treatment chemicals in Bangladesh. We are seeking a mid-level Marketing & Sales Representative to drive new customer acquisition and revenue growth across industrial sectors. This role is ideal for a technically proficient sales professional eager to excel in a high-growth, B2B technical sales environment. Key Responsibilities New Business Development: Identify and acquire new customers across targeted industries including textiles, food & beverage, pharmaceuticals, power, and manufacturing. Build a strong sales pipeline and expand the market for water treatment chemicals. Client Relationship Management: Develop strong relationships with plant managers, engineers, procurement teams, and other key decision-makers. Conduct regular site visits to understand customer requirements. Technical Sales & Consulting: Provide technical guidance on water treatment solutions, including boiler, cooling tower, RO, and wastewater applications. Conduct product presentations, demonstrations, and trials. Sales Target Achievement: Meet and exceed assigned sales targets through effective territory management, account planning, negotiation, and customer conversion while maintaining company profitability guidelines. Market Intelligence: Track market trends, competitor activities, and customer needs, providing relevant insights to management. Reporting & Coordination: Maintain sales records, prepare forecasts and reports, and coordinate with technical, marketing, logistics, and customer service teams to ensure effective customer support. Working Conditions Work Environment: Based at AKSIDs Head Office in Dhaka, with a significant amount of time spent in the field. Expect a field-oriented role, visiting industrial facilities, production plants, and client offices regularly. Travel Requirements: Frequent travel within Bangladesh (up to 60-70% of the time) to meet clients on-site. This includes travel to industrial hubs outside Dhaka. A valid driving license and willingness to travel by car and occasionally by air/rail to distant client sites are required. Reporting Line: You will report to the Managing Director at Ortrio. Regular meetings and reporting will be required to discuss pipeline status, market issues, and strategy. Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams including technical service engineers from Metito, marketing team, and customer service/logistics to ensure timely product delivery and support. Schedule: Full-time position (weekday business hours), with flexibility needed to accommodate client schedules. Occasionally, you may need to attend industry events or client meetings in evenings or weekends as per business needs. Requirements Additional Requirements Required qualifications and experience Direct, hands-on experience dealing with Dhaka-based manufacturers, workshops, importers, or wholesale markets. Candidates must be able to describe specific sourcing work they personally carried out. Sufficient technical literacy to read and write product specifications and assess build quality, materials, and durability. A background in engineering, industrial design, product development, or a technical trade is an asset but is not required if practical sourcing experience is strong. Currently based in Dhaka, with the mobility and willingness to spend a substantial share of working time in markets and workshops across the city. Fluency in both English and Bangla. Ability to work independently with limited supervision, plan ones own fieldwork, and deliver on schedule. Competence in maintaining structured records in spreadsheets and writing clear, organised reports. Not required but any experience with connected or remotely managed devices (e.g., IoT controllers, pay-as-you-go solar, vehicle telematics) would be useful. Assets Experience sourcing cooling, refrigeration, solar, or battery-powered equipment. Prior work in or around informal markets, street vending, or urban informal enterprise. Experience supporting research projects and working to research-driven standards of documentation and consistency. Responsibilities & Context 1. Background IFPRI, in partnership with the Shakti Foundation, one of Bangladeshs largest microfinance institutions, is developing and evaluating an asset-based loan product that will help street food vendors in Dhaka acquire mobile cooling solutions. As part of our research, the product will be offered to a sample of vendors during an initial launch and rigorously evaluated through a randomized controlled trial. A central design feature of the product is that vendors will be offered a menu of mobile cooling solutions at a range of price points, so that each vendor can select what fits the scale of their business and the goods they sell. This can include products that serve to cool both the food being sold, the vendor themselves, or both, as well as ventilation solutions for vendors who cook on site or at home. This is likely to include insulated/ventilated cart modifications, evaporative cooling units, battery-powered coolers, or other lithium battery based solution packages. Responsibilities & Context
1. Background
IFPRI, in partnership with the Shakti Foundation, one of Bangladesh`s largest microfinance institutions, is developing and evaluating an asset-based loan product that will help street food vendors in Dhaka acquire mobile cooling solutions. As part of our research, the product will be offered to a sample of vendors during an initial launch and rigorously evaluated through a randomized controlled trial.
A central design feature of the product is that vendors will be offered a menu of mobile cooling solutions at a range of price points, so that each vendor can select what fits the scale of their business and the goods they sell. This can include products that serve to cool both the food being sold, the vendor themselves, or both, as well as ventilation solutions for vendors who cook on site  or at home. This is likely to include insulated/ventilated cart modifications, evaporative cooling units, battery-powered coolers, or other lithium battery based solution packages.

Maintain professional communication and protect the company’s brand while dealing with customers and business partners. Maintain confidentiality of customer databases, pricing information, commercial information and other company-sensitive information. Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Experience At least 1 year The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Advertising Agency Additional Requirements Age 20 to 40 years Responsibilities & Context We are looking for enthusiastic & talented Domestic & International sales staff to sell Advertising & Contracts for WhatsOn Digital Agency, WhatsOn Print Magazines and WhatsOn Online media. jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1539590&fc.title: Assistant Officer, Accounts & Purchase

raw_source_fields.age: 20 to 30 years Only Male Good communication and coordination skills. Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint). Hard working, willingness to go market for product sourcing and buying. Responsibilities & Context HBF was founded in 2013 in Gazipur and is a company for fiber products that are manufactured by hand or semi-automatically. Our products are customized and niche products for high quality goods. We are seeking a detail-oriented, hard-working, and responsible Assistant Officer, Accounts & Purchase to join our Accounts team. If you are passionate about accounting and looking to build a strong career in this field, we want to hear from you! Accounts & HR Responsibilities: Maintain & prepare all kind of voucher and posting to the books of accounts. Prepare and maintain different sorts of bill, voucher & requisition slips. To maintain the company accounting activities. Keep record of all office expenses, payroll entries, invoices and other accounting documents. Able to cash management. Provide day to day administrative support. Able to Prepare Daily Receive & Payment Statements. Give support to worker recruitment, documentation, absent list etc. Purchase Responsibilities: Research and identify potential vendors, suppliers, and market trends. Negotiate pricing, delivery terms, and contract conditions with suppliers. Monitor stock levels to prevent shortages or excess inventory. Inspect delivered goods and resolve issues with defective products or delayed shipments. Maintain updated databases of supplier information, invoices, and purchase logs. Perform any other task given by the Management.
raw_source_fields.gender: Only males are allowed to apply.

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1539147&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Master of Commerce (MCom) Candidates with MBA in HRM or Master’s degree in other discipline may apply with PGDHRM, will be given preference. Experience 2 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Automobile, Cement Industry, Furniture Manufacturer, Group of Companies, Manufacturing (Light Engineering and Heavy Industry), Plastic/ Polymer Industry, Real Estate, Steel Freshers are also encouraged to apply. Responsibilities & Context Responsible for recruitment & deployment, staff on-boarding, learning & development initiatives and other assigned duties following office procedure, systems, & practices, culture, climate, structure, operations strategy, and advised by the line manager: Recruitment & Deployment: In close collaboration with the heads Of departments, prepare individual department's recruitment plans and job descriptions are in place for all roles. Assist in preparing job advertisements; arrange job postings, contact applying and coordinate interviews in accordance with the organizational recruitment standards & business needs. Coordinate the recruitment in accordance with the set standard WFP and recruitment policy respectively, and on completion of interviews to check background & references accordingly as & when applicable. Deploy DCW & MCW (workers) on time following the set standard WFP for smooth operations Of the organization. New Staff Onboarding: On confirmation of appointment, handle employee's joining formalities, counseling, performance assessment & job confirmation etc. in appropriate manner. Induction & placement in liaison with other depts., arrange for on-boarding for all newly recruited staff in their first week as per set guidelines, and ensure it goes with org. value, culture, sensibility and confidentiality policy etc. Ensure new team member receives required equipment (official stamp, computer, phone, desk, email addresses, identity cards, business card etc.) on 1st day of reporting and / or with seven days and / or as advised. Staff Development: Consolidate all employees training needs from the annual performance appraisal tools and also address all training requested by line managers. Closely work with HODs for developing the monthly and / or annual training calendar for the review of HR & Admin Manager, and coordinating training program uninterruptedly. Identify suitable trainers or training service provider; act as the focal point for all trainers and training needs. Employee Point of Contact : Answer first-level questions regarding company policies, benefits, and workplace perks. Culture & Engagement : Plan and execute internal company events, holiday parties, and team-building initiatives to drive employee connection. Additional Tasks and Assignments: Manage and Track Attendance of Office Staff Address behavior that disrupts the team or negatively affects the workplace. Coordinate communication and working relationships among employees. Report performance concerns and ensure HQ instructions are followed. Create, Distribute and Maintain Employee Appointment Documentation Store and Maintain HR and Administrative Records Office Management & Operations (Approx. 65%) Facility Operations : Manage relationships with building management, cleaning crews, and maintenance vendors to keep the space safe and functional. Inventory & Procurement : Monitor, order, and stock kitchen supplies, office equipment, and company swag. Vendor & Budget Management : Review and approve office expenses, track the operations budget, and negotiate service contracts. Administrative Support : Manage incoming mail, greet occasional on-site guests, and provide light logistical support to the leadership team. Resourceful: Must be familiar with Bangladeshi and American Laws that govern the workplace (or at least be resourceful enough to gather any need-to-know information related to rules of the land). Partly qualified Chartered Accountants (Professional Level passed) and preferred Associate Chartered Accountant (ACA) qualification from The Institute of Chartered Accountants of Bangladesh (ICAB)· Work experience in reputed Chartered Accountancy firm· 5+ years of relevant professional and industry experience in Treasury Operations, Finance & Accounts, or related areas. Other Skills Strong attention to detail. Strong stakeholder management skills. Good knowledge of Operations, Treasury, Finance & Accounts, and related financial processes. Responsibilities & Context Maintain strong controls over fund availability and daily settlements, including assisted partners Bank settlements, while managing risks arising from core-system downtime. Ensure daily and monthly reconciliation of Treasury Operations activities and reporting in Oracle in compliance with established processes and Bangladesh Bank guidelines. Lead treasury operational onboarding and feasibility assessments for existing and new service modality from Treasury perspective. Review and update Treasury operational processes and Oracle modules and develop Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) in line with ISO standards. Facilitate internal and external audits, support ISO 27001 compliance, and manage ad hoc regulatory reporting and responses to Bangladesh Bank. Review service agreements, legal drafts, and Notes for Approval (NFA) in coordination with Legal, Commercial, Product & Technology, and other relevant teams. Coordinate with Business Finance, Commercial, Product & Technology, and Regulatory & External Affairs on operational issues, financial services, assisted partner settlements, reporting, regulatory requirements, and new product implementation. Coordinate with banks on operational issues, UAT for new products and services, dispute settlement, and fund settlement. Coordinate with MNOs and middleware partners on daily funding modality and assisted partner settlement-related matters as per agreed process. Support regulatory inspections, responses, reporting to Bangladesh Bank, and proposal submissions as required. Facilitate Treasury-related activities for external audits in line with management expectations. Skills & Expertise: Sales & Marketing, Digital Marketing, Facebook marketing, Content Creation Responsibilities & Context Responsibilities & Context: কোম্পানির ট্রাভেল, ভিসা প্রসেসিং, ওয়ার্ক পারমিট ও স্টুডেন্ট ভিসা সংক্রান্ত সেবার মার্কেটিং কার্যক্রমে সহযোগিতা করা। Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, WhatsApp ও অন্যান্য ডিজিটাল প্ল্যাটফর্মে মার্কেটিং কার্যক্রম পরিচালনা ও নিয়মিত কনটেন্ট প্রচার করা। সম্ভাব্য ক্লায়েন্টদেরসাথে যোগাযোগ করে কোম্পানির বিভিন্ন সার্ভিস সম্পর্কে তথ্য প্রদান করা। সোশ্যাল মিডিয়া থেকে আসা ইনবক্স, কমেন্ট ও কাস্টমার কুয়েরি দ্রুত ও পেশাদারভাবে পরিচালনা করা। নতুন ক্লায়েন্ট/লিড সংগ্রহ করা এবং সংগৃহীত লিডগুলো নিয়মিত ফলো-আপ করা। ডিজিটাল মার্কেটিং ক্যাম্পেইন, বিজ্ঞাপন ও প্রচারণার পরিকল্পনা ও বাস্তবায়নে সহযোগিতা করা। মার্কেটিং কনটেন্ট, পোস্ট, ব্যানার ও ভিডিও তৈরির কাজে টিমকে প্রয়োজনীয় সহযোগিতা করা। বাজারের ট্রেন্ড, প্রতিযোগী প্রতিষ্ঠান ও গ্রাহকদের চাহিদা সম্পর্কে তথ্য সংগ্রহ ও বিশ্লেষণ করা। দৈনিক/সাপ্তাহিক মার্কেটিং কার্যক্রম ও লিডের রিপোর্ট প্রস্তুত করা। বিক্রয় বৃদ্ধির জন্য নতুন মার্কেটিং আইডিয়া ও কৌশল প্রস্তাব করা। কোম্পানির ব্র্যান্ড ইমেজ ও কাস্টমার সার্ভিসের মান বজায় রেখে কাজ করা। প্রয়োজনে অন্যান্য মার্কেটিং ও অফিসিয়াল কাজে টিমকে সহযোগিতা করা। Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Sales & Marketing Facebook marketing Visa Processing Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only females are allowed to apply. Job Location Dhaka (Naya Paltan)

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1540203&fc.title: Senior Executive (Marketing & Sales)

raw_source_fields.education: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) in Marketing Master of Business Administration (MBA) in Marketing
raw_source_fields.age: 26 to 45 years Responsibilities & Context Job Responsibilities – Senior Executive (Marketing & Sales) Develop and execute sales and marketing plans to achieve assigned monthly, quarterly, and annual targets. Generate new leads through digital marketing, referrals, networking, corporate contacts, and other sales channels. Follow up with prospective clients and convert qualified leads into property bookings and sales. Present and explain project details, including location, floor plans, specifications, pricing, payment schedules, and facilities. Conduct client meetings, site visits, property presentations, and project demonstrations. Maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective customers to support repeat business and referrals. Prepare quotations, sales proposals, booking documents, and other necessary sales-related paperwork. Negotiate with clients within approved company policies and coordinate with management for special pricing or payment arrangements. Coordinate with Accounts, Legal, Customer Service, Construction, and Project teams to ensure smooth completion of sales transactions. Maintain accurate records of leads, client communications, follow-ups, bookings, collections, and sales status. Monitor market trends, competitor activities, property prices, customer preferences, and emerging business opportunities. Assist in planning and implementing promotional campaigns, exhibitions, property fairs, corporate presentations, and other marketing activities. Support digital marketing activities, including social media promotions, online campaigns, lead generation, and customer engagement. Prepare regular sales reports, lead conversion reports, collection updates, and market feedback for management. Ensure timely follow-up on customer payments and coordinate with the Accounts Department regarding outstanding installments. Handle customer queries professionally and resolve sales-related issues in coordination with the concerned departments. Participate in sales meetings, training sessions, project briefings, and business development activities. Build and maintain a professional network with individuals, corporate organizations, brokers, property consultants, and other potential business partners. Ensure all sales activities comply with company policies, approved pricing, and applicable procedures. Perform any other sales, marketing, and business-development responsibilities assigned by the management.

Requirements Additional Requirements Age At least 18 years Essential requirements: Education: • Desirable finance, business or administration related diploma. Experience: • Essential previous working experience of at least two years in relevant jobs. • Desirable experience in MSF or other NGOs in developing countries. Languages: • Mission language and local language essential Knowledge: • Essential computer literacy (word, excel, internet) Competencies: • Results and Quality Orientation L2 • Team work and Cooperation L2 • Behavioural Flexibility L2 • Commitment to MSF Principles L2 • Stress Management L3 Responsibilities & Context Main Purpose: Execute administrative and finance related tasks and follow up of project accountancy to support the Project Finance Manager following MSF standard and procedures, in order to ensure legal compliance and keep a strict control over monetary resources to achieve project objectives. Accountabilities: • Implementing cash management procedures in order to ensure the highest control and security, assisting the Project Fin Manager in the prevision of monthly treasury and planning in order to en-sure the coverage of daily needs, advances on salaries, payroll, etc. • Processing the payment to suppliers and keep strict on all documentation involved, informing the administration manager of any sort of disparity • Carrying out all accounting tasks and activities, classifying, preparing and filing of all accounting pieces in accounting software, in order to ensure strict control of all expenditures and the reliability of statements and documentation. • Making all administrative information available to the staff (posting, meetings, etc.), supporting the Accountancy Manager (ACMA) in translating documents into local language and assisting in meetings upon request. • Any other administrative task delegated by the Accountancy Manager (ACMA) MSF Section/Context Specific Accountabilities: MSF Cox’s Bazar office is considered as sub office to Dhaka Intersection Support Team (IST), therefore the Finance Assistant will be considered as part of IST finance team member, and for any reason the Finance coordinator can request the Fin Assistant to join IST at Dhaka any time (support, cover gap, etc). • To help the Finance coordinator on the execution of the IST objective by supporting with the proper advise on finance when needed. • Cash Management: To handle 5 (Five) cash box and entry book in cash register UF. • Processing payment of big volume of local purchase for OCA, OCB & OCP mission and workshop Payment. • Encode all the transection into UF. • VAT & TAX challan summary report for different FD’s and organize softcopy of the challan in the finance share folder (PD, PIT & Suppliers). • Challans share to Supplier’s as per need. • Employee & Supplier/Vendor TDS Certificate Download • Organize monthly IST BKK and send to Dhaka IST • To Scan OCA BKK (Heavy duty scanner availability) • To prépare monthly 6 (six) bank reconciliation for IST accounts • Monthly checking IMS PD tracker, uploading in UF & share with all the IST IMS • Prepare monthly medical Tracking sheet & share to Medical • Book adjusting entries in UF for IMS cost reimbursement. • Monthly VAT & TDS deposit information update in the Compliance Overview tracker. • Prepare monthly IST VAT return report with issuing Mushok 6.6 • Monthly workshop related expense report share to IST Workshop Manager. • Bank Signatory add documents preparation for CXB IST • Collaboration with OC’s when they need or ask for. • Help to other work as per need, budget preparation (FD6 & MSF internal), VAT return submission in NBR site, financial statement preparation. • To perform any other task delegated by Finco, and to be flexible to support on some HR tasks. Support to HR & Admin Team: • Support IST HR/Admin team with accommodation and housekeeping arrangements • Monthly IR submission for Food, Hygiene & Stationery Items for CXB IST Office, Warehouse, House, Ukhiya Workshop. • Check the inventory align with Supply Sup. And physical check the stock in present and make Forecast of Monthly Consuption for quarterly basis and submit (Food, Hygiene & Stationery Items for CXB IST Office, Warehouse, House, Ukhiya Workshop) • Distribute ID Cards and Ribbon to colleagues (as per need). • Making all administrative information available to the staff (posting, meetings, leave form, etc.) • Sending staff files (signed contracts, signed JDs, leave form, etc) to HR Assistant/HRM to encode them in Homere. • Additional HR/ Admin tasks delegated by the IST HRCo/Dep HRCo. Compensation & Other Benefits Contract and Benefit: • Fixed term contract for 06 months . Salary according to level 6 (Six) of the internal MSF salary grid (BDT 85,500 Gross). Salary is non-negotiable. Income tax deduction from salary based on current income tax rule. • 2 annual leave days per month worked. • Weekly 2 holidays. • Medical Reimbursement for employee and direct dependents based on Health Care Policy- Locally Recruited Staff. Others: There will be no provisions for relocation. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Coxs Bazar

Requirements
Additional Requirements
Essential requirements:
Education:
• Desirable finance, business or administration related diploma.
Experience:
• Essential previous working experience of at least two years in relevant jobs.
• Desirable experience in MSF or other NGOs in developing countries.
Languages:
• Mission language and local language essential
Knowledge:
• Essential computer literacy (word, excel, internet)
Competencies:
• Results and Quality Orientation L2
• Team work and Cooperation L2
• Behavioural Flexibility L2
• Commitment to MSF Principles L2
• Stress Management L3
Responsibilities & Context
Main Purpose:
Execute administrative and finance related tasks and follow up of project accountancy to support the Project Finance Manager following MSF standard and procedures, in order to ensure legal compliance and keep a strict control over monetary resources to achieve project objectives.
Accountabilities:
• Implementing cash management procedures in order to ensure the highest control and security, assisting the Project Fin Manager in the prevision of monthly treasury and planning in order to en-sure the coverage of daily needs, advances on salaries, payroll, etc.
• Processing the payment to suppliers and keep strict on all documentation involved, informing the administration manager of any sort of disparity
• Carrying out all accounting tasks and activities, classifying, preparing and filing of all accounting pieces in accounting software, in order to ensure strict control of all expenditures and the reliability of statements and documentation.
• Making all administrative information available to the staff (posting, meetings, etc.), supporting the Accountancy Manager (ACMA) in translating documents into local language and assisting in meetings upon request.
• Any other administrative task delegated by the Accountancy Manager (ACMA)
MSF Section/Context Specific Accountabilities:
MSF Cox’s Bazar office is considered as sub office to Dhaka Intersection Support Team (IST), therefore the Finance Assistant will be considered as part of IST finance team member, and for any reason the Finance coordinator can request the Fin Assistant to join IST at Dhaka any time (support, cover gap, etc).
• To help the Finance coordinator on the execution of the IST objective by supporting with the proper advise on finance when needed.
• Cash Management: To handle 5 (Five) cash box and entry book in cash register UF.
• Processing payment of big volume of local purchase for OCA, OCB & OCP mission and workshop Payment.
• Encode all the transection into UF.
• VAT & TAX challan summary report for different FD’s and organize softcopy of the challan in the finance share folder (PD, PIT & Suppliers).
• Challans share to Supplier’s as per need.
• Employee & Supplier/Vendor TDS Certificate Download
• Organize monthly IST BKK and send to Dhaka IST
• To Scan OCA BKK (Heavy duty scanner availability)
• To prépare monthly 6 (six) bank reconciliation for IST accounts
• Monthly checking IMS PD tracker, uploading in UF & share with all the IST IMS
• Prepare monthly medical Tracking sheet & share to Medical
• Book adjusting entries in UF for IMS cost reimbursement.
• Monthly VAT & TDS deposit information update in the Compliance Overview tracker.
• Prepare monthly IST VAT return report with issuing Mushok 6.6
• Monthly workshop related expense report share to IST Workshop Manager.
• Bank Signatory add documents preparation for CXB IST
• Collaboration with OC’s when they need or ask for.
• Help to other work as per need, budget preparation (FD6 & MSF internal), VAT return submission in NBR site, financial statement preparation.
• To perform any other task delegated by Finco, and to be flexible to support on some HR tasks.
Support to HR & Admin Team:
• Support IST HR/Admin team with accommodation and housekeeping arrangements
• Monthly IR submission for Food, Hygiene & Stationery Items for CXB IST Office, Warehouse, House, Ukhiya Workshop.
• Check the inventory align with Supply Sup. And physical check the stock in present and make Forecast of Monthly Consuption for quarterly basis and submit (Food, Hygiene & Stationery Items for CXB IST Office, Warehouse, House, Ukhiya Workshop)
• Distribute ID Cards and Ribbon to colleagues (as per need).
• Making all administrative information available to the staff (posting, meetings, leave form, etc.)
• Sending staff files (signed contracts, signed JDs, leave form, etc) to HR Assistant/HRM to encode them in Homere.
• Additional HR/ Admin tasks delegated by the IST HRCo/Dep HRCo.
Compensation & Other Benefits
Contract and Benefit:
• Fixed term contract for 06 months. Salary according to level 6 (Six) of the internal MSF salary grid (BDT 85,500 Gross). Salary is non-negotiable. Income tax deduction from salary based on current income tax rule.
• 2 annual leave days per month worked.
• Weekly 2 holidays.
• Medical Reimbursement for employee and direct dependents based on Health Care Policy- Locally Recruited Staff.
Others: There will be no provisions for relocation.

Work at office

Full Time

Cox`s Bazar

Application process:
Online application: Please submit your application online at the link below by 07/10/2026. You need to attach your CV and Certificates in a PDF format during application.
No hard copies will be accepted for this position.
Important Notes:
• Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
• Only online applications will be accepted. Any hard copies or soft copies via e-mail (unless it has been requested for) will be discarded.
• Only Bangladeshi citizens will be considered for this position.
• No monetary, goods or service offers, nor favouritism, will be tolerated in a recruitment process. Any illicit solicitations can be reported to the justice system. MSF reserves the right to refuse any candidate having benefited from such acts and will stop collaboration with any workers involved in such acts.
• Our recruitment process is fully transparent and follows standardized evaluation criteria.
• We strictly ensure data protection by handling all candidate information confidentially and in line with applicable policies.
• We are committed to safeguarding principles, ensuring a safe, respectful, and ethical environment.
• Médecins Sans Frontières is an equal opportunity employer and encourages diversity, equity and inclusion. Following that we strongly encourage applications from female and individuals from ethnically diverse backgrounds.
Address:
5th Floor, Khawaja Palace, Plot N. 76, Ro-11, Banani, Dhaka-1213, Bangladesh.

Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Experience At least 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Advertising Agency, BPO/ Data Entry Firm, Business-to-Business (B2B) Software and Services Startup, IT Enabled Service, Software Company Additional Requirements Age At least 20 years 3–5 years of hands-on experience in E-commerce and Marketplace Management. Strong practical experience managing Amazon Seller Central, including FBA/FBM, listings, inventory, orders, pricing, and account health. Proven experience with Amazon, Walmart, eBay, and TikTok Shop or similar major marketplaces. Experience in product research, product sourcing, competitor analysis, and identifying profitable products. Strong knowledge of product listing optimization, marketplace SEO, keyword research, and conversion optimization. Hands-on experience with Amazon PPC, including campaign setup, keyword targeting, bidding, budget management, and performance optimization. Experience managing inventory, pricing, fulfillment, returns, and marketplace operations across multiple channels. Strong understanding of marketplace policies, compliance, account health, listing restrictions, and issue resolution. Experience using tools such as Helium 10, Jungle Scout, Keepa, Data Dive, or similar e-commerce tools. Strong analytical skills with the ability to use Excel/Google Sheets and marketplace reports to track sales, advertising, inventory, and profitability. Ability to independently identify problems, analyze performance, and implement data-driven strategies to improve sales and profitability. Experience working with US/UK/Canada marketplaces will be an advantage. Strong communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills. Responsibilities & Context Manage day-to-day operations of Amazon, Walmart, eBay, and TikTok Shop accounts. Manage Amazon Seller Central & Vendor Central , including listings, inventory, orders, shipments, and account health. Handle Amazon FBA inventory, shipment planning, restocking, storage, and fulfillment-related issues. Conduct product and competitor research to identify market and sales opportunities. Perform keyword research and optimize product titles, bullet points, descriptions, backend keywords, and product content . Manage Amazon A+ Content and Brand Store updates and optimization. Plan, manage, and optimize Amazon PPC campaigns , including Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display. Monitor and optimize ACoS, ROAS, TACoS, CTR, CPC, conversion rate, and advertising performance . Manage Walmart Marketplace listings, inventory, pricing, orders, and account performance. Manage eBay listings, product information, pricing, promotions, orders, and seller performance. Manage TikTok Shop products, inventory, orders, promotions, and marketplace operations. Monitor account health, policy compliance, listing violations, suppressed listings, and marketplace warnings . Analyze sales, traffic, conversion, advertising, inventory, and profitability data using Excel/Google Sheets and marketplace reports . Monitor competitor pricing and marketplace trends and recommend appropriate pricing strategies. Identify sales and operational issues and take timely corrective actions. Prepare regular marketplace performance reports with actionable insights. Coordinate with content, design, customer service, warehouse, and management teams when required. Stay updated with changes in Amazon, Walmart, eBay, and TikTok Shop policies and marketplace features . Skills & Expertise Amazon FBA Amazon Marketing Amazon Seller Central Ecommerce PPC Marketing tiktok Walmart Walmart Marketing Compensation & Other Benefits Performance bonus,Over time allowance Festival Bonus: 2 All public holidays of the Bangladesh Government. Dynamic, innovative work environment. Company-sponsored professional growth and training opportunities. Parental leaves. A safe, respectful, and family-oriented work environment. Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Additional Requirements Age 22 to 26 years Only Male Ideal Candidate We are looking for someone who is: Highly organised and responsible Good with Excel/Google Sheets and numbers Strong at planning and follow-up Comfortable managing factory workers and suppliers Able to solve problems independently Comfortable dealing with logistics companies and government offices Experienced in manufacturing, supply chain, procurement or export Experience with wood products, furniture, homeware or Amazon/FBA is a plus. The Role You will work primarily from our Khulna factory and report directly to the UK-based management team. Because the business is still being established, this is an opportunity to help build the systems and processes from the ground up , rather than simply maintain an existing operation. The aim is to create a reliable operation where production, inventory, quality, purchasing and export are organised and predictable as the business grows. Responsibilities & Context About Stonewell Supply We currently have a wood manufacturing factory in Khulna, Bangladesh , and are in the process of formally establishing and developing the wider Stonewell Supply business. We are a UK-based company developing wooden homeware products for international markets, initially selling through Amazon UK. We are looking for a Supply Chain to help us build and organise the systems needed to grow the business. Location: Khulna, Bangladesh Responsibilities You will help manage the supply chain from raw materials to production, finished products and export . Production planning — decide what needs to be produced, when and in what quantities. Inventory — track raw wood, work-in-progress, finished products and packaging. Demand planning — use sales data to plan future production and avoid stockouts. Quality control — coordinate inspections and reduce defects and rework. Wood & moisture management — monitor drying, storage and moisture levels. Packaging — ensure the correct packaging is available for production. Export & logistics — coordinate shipments from the Khulna factory to the UK. Documentation — manage invoices, packing lists, export paperwork and records. Business & export registration — assist with business registration, trade licence, ERC, chamber registration, export-related requirements and renewals. Cost control — track production and landed costs. Supplier management — monitor suppliers for price, quality and reliability. Reporting — provide a clear weekly report on production, inventory, QC, shipments, costs and problems. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Demand Planning Inventory Management Procurement Management System Production Planning Quality Control Supply Chain Management Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Job Location Khulna, Khulna (Khulna Sadar)
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

Communicate effectively, verbally and in writing, to a diverse audience. Plan, organize and prioritize work. Assign and supervise the work of others. Demonstrate the highest level of ethical behavior. Remain flexible in order to adapt to changes in work environment. Study and apply new information, and take initiative. Excellent time-management, problem-prevention and problem-solving skills. Work accurately with close attention to detail. Maintain confidentiality of sensitive information. Work effectively, professionally and tactfully with diverse workforce, team leaders, senior staff, and outside companies and public agencies. Possess a work ethic that includes neatness, punctuality and accuracy. Exhibit a professional, businesslike appearance and demeanor. Basic computer skills, including e-mail, word processing and spreadsheets. Excellent interpersonal skills to facilitate interaction with the workforce. Candidates having hospitality background are preferred Responsibilities & Context POSITION SUMMARY The Human Resources (“HR”) Manager has overall responsibility for the HR function as it relates to all Hotel Sarina Dhaka team members, including employee relations, compensation and benefits administration, development, implementation and administration of human resources programs and employment policies, personnel record-keeping, workers compensation and team member safety issues, training and workforce development, and compliance with HR laws and regulations of the government of Bangladesh. The HR Manager performs advanced professional work advising Hotel Sarina Dhaka team leaders and team members on the application of employment, benefits and workers compensation laws and regulations and employment policies in the contexts of hiring, discipline, employment termination, training, compensation, benefits, leave, equal opportunity and other human resources issues. The HR Manager must be open and available to discuss human resources matters with the entire workforce. The HR Manager reports to the General Manager, address employee safety issues, and oversee third party administrator and outside counsel in the handling of workers compensation matters. The HR Manager supervises the Organizational Development & Training function. The Human Resources Manager also performs such other functions as may be assigned by the Management / General Manager. RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES OF HUMAN RESOURCES MANAGER Maintain knowledge of and ensure compliance with employment-related laws and regulations of the government of Bangladesh Manage actions and proceedings brought against Hotel Sarina Dhaka arising in connection with employment, benefits and workers compensation issues, including preparation of all Polices Maintain all personnel files, records, Police Reports background investigation results, and other personnel records, and ensure Hotel Sarina Dhaka is in compliance with all laws and regulations and demonstrates “best practices” in regard to personnel information management. Provide leadership in effective conflict resolution for all personnel. Analyze benefits options and cost alternatives for providing employee benefits, recommend benefits program modifications and implement approved benefits modifications. Work with senior management to craft consistent, equitable and competitive compensation and incentives. Develop and implement human resources programs and policies and periodically update Team Member and Team Leader Handbooks. Serve as a resource for team leaders in handling employee issues and assist them in counseling employees, conducting evaluations, staff training, problem-solving and consensus-building. Serve as a resource for all team members by being available and accessible to discuss all human resources related issues. Oversee the Organizational Development & Training function and develop employee training programs. Maintain inter- and intradepartmental work flow by providing information to and cooperating with co-workers. Assist in hiring by providing job descriptions and advertisements, and in the case of hiring of senior team leaders, by screening and interviewing candidates. Work with the Management, and inform on matters involving benefits, employee safety and workers compensation issues. Oversee handling of employment-related inquiries, such as employment verification requests and unemployment compensation inquiries and proceedings. Chair/serve on various Hotel Sarina Dhaka committees, as well as outside human resources or industry-related groups. Develop, implement and participate in employee recognition programs. Enhance job performance by applying up-to-date professional and technical knowledge gained by attending seminars and conferences and reviewing professional publications. Perform other duties as assigned by the Management/ General Manager ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS Prepare and maintain accurate records, files and reports, including responsibility for maintaining personnel records. Organize and work independently on multiple assigned tasks/projects and complete assignments within specified deadlines. Communicate effectively verbally and in writing to all levels of staff and management, outside officials and agencies, and the public, expressing ideas and instructions clearly and concisely. Compile and analyze complex information, and research and develop solutions to complex issues. Work well under pressure. Accurately follow verbal and written directions from senior management. Advise on employment statutes, rules, regulations and policies affecting team members. Meet with and assist Hotel Sarina Dhaka team leaders in planning and directing activities, explaining and implementing decisions, and resolving significant issues involving team members. Recommend, develop, interpret and clarify personnel procedures and policies. Conduct research regarding employment issues, benefits, workers compensation and personnel procedures and, working with General Manager, apply the conclusions to personnel policies and practices. Assist in hiring, including developing job descriptions and job advertisements, and screening and interviewing candidates. Develop, implement and manage a centralized recruiting process. Demonstrate skills in consensus-building and mediation in order to constructively address employee conflicts. Demonstrate skills critical for managerial success including leadership, decisiveness, flexibility, sound business judgment, and highly developed personal, analytical and communication skills. WORK ENVIRONMENT Ability to work in an office setting. Position may require extended hours including evenings and weekends, travel to multiple work sites. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Computer Skills Human Resource Management Problem-solving skill Recruitment & Selection Time Management Employment Status Full Time Job Location Anywhere in Bangladesh

Requirements Education Bachelor of Business Studies (BBS) Master of Business Administration (MBA) Experience 1 to 2 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Airline, Tour Operator, Immigration/Visa Processing Freshers are also encouraged to apply. Additional Requirements Age 20 to 32 years Only Female Responsibilities & Context Make outbound calls to potential customers and introduce the company's travel, visit visa and work visa processing services. Respond to customer inquiries through phone calls, WhatsApp and other communication channels. Generate new leads and follow up with prospective clients. Explain visa processing procedures, required documents, service charges and application processes to customers. Promote the company's travel and visa consultancy services professionally. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Telemarketing Call Center Operation Customer Service Online sales Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only females are allowed to apply. Job Location Dhaka (Naya Paltan)
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

Core Competencies
Key Performance Areas (KPIs)
Responsibilities & Context

Maintain and organize employee personal files, HR documents, and file movement records.
Prepare and update employee records and personal files in the ERP/HRIS.
Ensure proper filing, document retrieval, and confidentiality of employee information.
2. HR Correspondence
Draft official letters, notices, memos, reports, and other HR-related documents.
Maintain confidential HR correspondence and documentation.
3. Attendance, Leave & Overtime
Maintain and update employee attendance and leave records in the ERP/HRIS.
Prepare monthly attendance reports covering absenteeism, late-in, early-out, and other exceptions.
Verify overtime records against attendance data and prepare OT reports.
Identify and coordinate the resolution of attendance, leave, and overtime discrepancies.
4. HR Reporting & Data Management
Prepare HR, attendance, leave, overtime, and salary-related reports using Microsoft Excel and ERP/HRIS.
Maintain accurate employee databases and ensure timely updates.
Analyze and reconcile HR data to identify discrepancies.
5. Recruitment & Selection
Provide administrative and logistical support for recruitment tests and interviews.
Maintain candidate files, CVs, applications, and recruitment-related records.
Assist with recruitment coordination and documentation.
6. Employee Joining & HR Administration
Assist with employee joining formalities and documentation.
Collect and verify required employee documents.
Update new employee information in the ERP/HRIS.
Provide day-to-day HR administrative support to employees and management.
7. Other Responsibilities
Perform other HR-related duties assigned by the Line Manager or Management.
Maintain confidentiality and ensure compliance with HR policies and procedures.

ছুটি, বেতন-সংক্রান্ত ডকুমেন্টেশন ও HR ফাইল সংরক্ষণ করা। বাংলাদেশ শ্রম আইন ও প্রযোজ্য ফ্যাক্টরি বিধিমালা অনুযায়ী কমপ্লায়েন্স নিশ্চিত করা। নিয়োগ, অনবোর্ডিং, কর্মী সম্পর্ক ও শৃঙ্খলামূলক প্রক্রিয়া পরিচালনা করা। HR ও কমপ্লায়েন্স ডকুমেন্টেশন প্রস্তুত ও সংরক্ষণ করা। সোশ্যাল কমপ্লায়েন্স ও এথিক্যাল ট্রেড অডিটের জন্য ফ্যাক্টরিকে প্রস্তুত ও সমন্বয় করা। SEDEX/SMETA, BSCI এবং অন্যান্য কাস্টমার/সোশ্যাল কমপ্লায়েন্স অডিট পরিচালনা ও মোকাবিলার বাস্তব অভিজ্ঞতা থাকা। অডিটের পর কারেকটিভ ও প্রিভেন্টিভ অ্যাকশন (CAPA) সঠিকভাবে বাস্তবায়ন ও বজায় রাখা। নিয়মিত অভ্যন্তরীণ কমপ্লায়েন্স চেক করা এবং উন্নয়নের ক্ষেত্র চিহ্নিত করা। কাস্টমার ও থার্ড-পার্টি অডিটের জন্য প্রয়োজনীয় রেকর্ড ও ডকুমেন্টেশন সংরক্ষণ করা। ফ্যাক্টরি ম্যানেজমেন্ট, প্রোডাকশন ও অন্যান্য বিভাগের সাথে HR ও কমপ্লায়েন্স বিষয়ে সমন্বয় করা। ফ্যাক্টরির HR এবং কর্মক্ষমতা উন্নয়ন সহ পারফরম্যান্স ম্যানেজমেন্ট সিস্টেম (PMS) কার্যক্রম সমন্বয় করা। কর্মচারী সম্পৃক্ততা, মতামত, সংস্কৃতি নির্মাণ এবং কর্মী ধরে রাখার উদ্যোগ পরিচালনা করা। ফ্যাক্টরির দৈনন্দিন HR ও অডিটের পর কারেকটিভ ও প্রিভেন্টিভ অ্যাকশন (CAPA) সঠিকভাবে বাস্তবায়ন ও বজায় রাখা।
নিয়মিত অভ্যন্তরীণ কমপ্লায়েন্স চেক করা এবং উন্নয়নের ক্ষেত্র চিহ্নিত করা।
কাস্টমার ও থার্ড-পার্টি অডিটের জন্য প্রয়োজনীয় রেকর্ড ও ডকুমেন্টেশন সংরক্ষণ করা।
ফ্যাক্টরি ম্যানেজমেন্ট, প্রোডাকশন ও অন্যান্য বিভাগের সাথে HR ও কমপ্লায়েন্স বিষয়ে সমন্বয় করা।
ফ্যাক্টরির HR ও সোশ্যাল কমপ্লায়েন্স স্ট্যান্ডার্ডের ধারাবাহিক উন্নয়ন ও টেকসইতা নিশ্চিত করা।
কর্মচারী সম্পর্ক, কর্মক্ষমতা এবং কর্মক্ষেত্রের সমস্যা সমাধানে ব্যবস্থাপকদের সহায়তা করা।
কেপিআই (KPI) নির্ধারণ, মূল্যায়ন এবং কর্মক্ষমতা উন্নয়ন সহ পারফরম্যান্স ম্যানেজমেন্ট সিস্টেম (PMS) কার্যক্রম সমন্বয় করা।
কর্মচারী সম্পৃক্ততা, মতামত, সংস্কৃতি নির্মাণ এবং কর্মী ধরে রাখার উদ্যোগ পরিচালনা করা।

এই বিভাগের কার্যক্রম আরও সম্প্রসারণের জন্য সংশ্লিষ্ট সেক্টরে কাজের অভিজ্ঞতা রয়েছে—এমন প্রার্থীদের কাছ থেকে আবেদন আহ্বান করা হচ্ছে। Key Responsibilities International students ও clients-এর সাথে নিয়মিত যোগাযোগ ও follow-up করা। Admission ও consultancy-related তথ্য প্রদান এবং প্রয়োজনীয় গাইডলাইন দেওয়া। Europe-এর Work Visa / Job Visa ও Study Abroad সংক্রান্ত client support দেওয়া। Client-এর প্রয়োজন অনুযায়ী সঠিক তথ্য প্রদান ও সংশ্লিষ্ট টিমের সাথে সমন্বয় করা। Admission, documentation ও application-related কাজে সহযোগিতা করা। Client relationship ও communication বজায় রাখা। প্রতিষ্ঠানের সার্ভিস সম্পর্কে prospective clients-কে বিস্তারিতভাবে জানানো। Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Client Relationship Customer Service Sales Target Achievement Education Counseling Student Counseling Tour and Travel visa Compensation & Other Benefits আলোচনা সাপেক্ষে - প্রার্থীর যোগ্যতা, দক্ষতা ও অভিজ্ঞতার ভিত্তিতে বেতন নির্ধারণ করা হবে। Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1540577&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Experience 1 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Diagnostic Centre, Healthcare Startup, Hospital, Pharmaceutical/Medicine Companies Additional Requirements Age 22 to 35 years Candidates with experience as a Medical Representative (MR/MPO) will be given preference. Both "male and female" candidates are encouraged to apply. Job Location: Dhaka and all divisional cities across Bangladesh. Excellent verbal articulation, advanced negotiation tactics, and high-impact corporate presentation skills. Strong capacity to convince, build rapport, and handle objections when dealing with high-profile senior medical specialists, clinical administrators, and pharmacy managers. Proactive self-starter, target-driven mind, tech-savvy, and structurally capable of working independently in the field under pressure. Responsibilities & Context Job Responsibilities Regularly visit private and government hospitals, clinics, diagnostic centers, and individual doctors to establish strategic healthcare partnerships. Build professional institutional relationships and negotiate Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) and corporate partnership agreements with hospital authorities and medical practitioners. Collect, compile, and maintain highly accurate doctor professional information, core specializations, consultation fees, chamber schedules, and clinical service details. jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1540445&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education B.Sc. in Textile Engineering / Fashion Designing / related discipline from a recognized institution. Candidates having knowledge of Seamless Knitting/Seamless Garments will be preferred. Experience At most 1 year The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Garments, Textile, Group of Companies Freshers are also encouraged to apply. Additional Requirements Age 26 to 30 years Only Male Basic knowledge of inventory and store management. Basic knowledge of 5S and warehouse/store practices. Basic knowledge of ERP/software-based inventory management will be an advantage. Understanding of garments/textile production processes. Good numerical and analytical ability. Strong attention to detail.Self-driven and responsible. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Positive mindset and willingness to learn. Ability to work with different departments and under pressure. Experience: 0–6 months / Freshers are encouraged to apply. Internship or practical experience in store, inventory or garments/textile operations will be an advantage. Responsibilities & Context Assist in the day-to-day operation and management of the Seamless Store . Receive, check, arrange and issue raw materials, accessories and other store items according to approved requirements. Maintain proper inventory records, stock registers and system records . Support accurate stock receiving, issuing, transfer and reconciliation . Monitor stock levels and communicate shortages or excess inventory to the concerned authority. Ensure proper identification, tagging, storage and preservation of materials. Follow FIFO/FEFO principles wherever applicable. Assist in conducting regular physical stock counting and reconciliation. Maintain proper housekeeping and 5S practices within the store. Support reduction of material wastage, loss and inventory discrepancies. Coordinate with Production, Planning, Knitting, Technical, Procurement and Accounts departments regarding material requirements. Assist in maintaining proper documentation for material receiving and issuing. Ensure materials are stored safely and systematically to facilitate easy identification and retrieval. Support implementation of best practices for inventory and store management . Perform any other duties assigned by the management. Skills & Expertise Fabric Store Other Relevant Skills Inventory Management Stock Reconciliation FIFO Compensation & Other Benefits Gratuity Salary Review: Yearly Festival Bonus: 2 Other Benefits: As per company policy Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Job Location Gazipur (Kashimpur)

Requirements Education Bachelor of Commerce (BCom) in Marketing Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) in Marketing Bachelor of Science (BSc) in Computer Science & Engineering Experience 1 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Software Company, IT Enabled Service, ISP, Computer Hardware/Network Companies Freshers are also encouraged to apply. Additional Requirements Age 24 to 30 years Responsibilities & Context We are looking for a highly ambitious, self-motivated, and hardworking Manager (Business Development) with strong communication skills in English and sound technical knowledge. The ideal candidate will play a key role in promoting our software and IT services and expanding our business operations. Responsibilities: Conduct in-person client visits, client acquisition, and relationship management (experience in government sales will be preferred; bank/corporate experience will be an advantage). Generate sales for software solutions, including customized software, application development, ERP solutions, and IT-enabled services. Identify and develop new business opportunities through prospecting, networking, cold calling, and referrals. Demonstrate strong knowledge of digital marketing and social media marketing. Manage the full lifecycle of government tenders (EOI, RFP, quotation submission, and clarifications). Handle government tenders through e-GP and ensure compliance with PPR regulations. Identify and track new tender opportunities from platforms such as All Tender, Tender Bazar, Tender BD, etc. Coordinate with technical teams to understand IT solutions and prepare proposals. Prepare monthly tender reports (won, lost, shortlisted, canceled, etc.). Prepare daily work plans and report progress to management. Perform any other tasks assigned by management. Skills & Expertise Business Development Corporate Marketing Corporate Sales (B2B B2C) Sales & Marketing Other Relevant Skills Client Relationship Sales Target Achievement IT Products Sales and Marketing Compensation & Other Benefits Mobile bill,T/A Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka

We are looking for a highly ambitious, self-motivated, and hardworking Manager (Business Development) with strong communication skills in English and sound technical knowledge. The ideal candidate will play a key role in promoting our software and IT services and expanding our business operations.
Responsibilities:
Conduct in-person client visits, client acquisition, and relationship management (experience in government sales will be preferred; bank/corporate experience will be an advantage).
Generate sales for software solutions, including customized software, application development, ERP solutions, and IT-enabled services.
Identify and develop new business opportunities through prospecting, networking, cold calling, and referrals.
Demonstrate strong knowledge of digital marketing and social media marketing.
Manage the full lifecycle of government tenders (EOI, RFP, quotation submission, and clarifications).
Handle government tenders through e-GP and ensure compliance with PPR regulations.
Identify and track new tender opportunities from platforms such as All Tender, Tender Bazar, Tender BD, etc.
Coordinate with technical teams to understand IT solutions and prepare proposals.
Prepare monthly tender reports (won, lost, shortlisted, canceled, etc.).
Prepare daily work plans and report progress to management.
Perform any other tasks assigned by management.

Key Responsibilities Communicating with customers through various channels regarding air export shipments. Ensure customer satisfaction and provide professional customer support throughout the shipment process. Ensure follow-up with the vendor, airline, and relevant parties for customs status, shipping documents, and cargo readiness. Providing clearance to the Air Operation team for planning, mentioning booking no., agent detail, preferred airline, selling rate, flight details, and estimated arrival time through mail only. Coordinate with the Air Operation team regarding cargo handover, flight confirmation, documentation, and urgent consignments. Follow up on AWB, HAWB/MAWB and other required air export documentation to ensure timely shipment processing. Sometimes communicate over the phone for urgent consignments and shipment-related matters. Ability to meet deadlines while maintaining a professional attitude. Agro Processing/Seed/GM) Additional Requirements Minimum 2–3 years of practical experience in Store Operations, preferably in a factory/FMCG/food manufacturing environment. Candidates with hands-on experience in raw materials, packaging materials and finished goods management will be preferred. Key Skills Good knowledge of inventory and store management. Practical knowledge of FIFO/FEFO, stock reconciliation and physical inventory counting. Good computer skills, particularly MS Excel and inventory/ERP software. Strong documentation, communication and coordination skills. Ability to work under pressure and maintain accuracy in stock-related activities. Responsibilities & Context Receive, inspect and properly record all incoming raw materials, packaging materials, finished goods and other store items. Ensure proper storage, identification, stacking and preservation of materials according to company procedures. Maintain accurate stock records, bin cards, stock registers and system entries. Issue materials against authorized requisitions and maintain proper documentation. Conduct regular physical stock verification and reconcile physical stock with system/record balances. Monitor stock levels and inform the concerned authority regarding shortages, excess stock, slow-moving and obsolete items. Ensure FIFO/FEFO practices where applicable, particularly for food/raw materials and other time-sensitive items. Coordinate with Production, Procurement, Quality Assurance, Accounts and other relevant departments for smooth store operations. Maintain proper housekeeping, safety, security and hygiene standards within the store. Prepare regular stock reports and support management during stock audits and inspections. Perform any other store-related duties assigned by management. Compensation & Other Benefits Salary Negotiable, based on qualifications and experience. Requirements Education Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) in Supply Chain Management, Accounting, Management Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Accounting, Management or a relevant discipline from a recognized university Experience 2 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Manufacturing (FMCG), Agro based firms (incl. Agro Processing/Seed/GM) Additional Requirements Minimum 2–3 years of practical experience in Store Operations, preferably in a factory/FMCG/food manufacturing environment. Candidates with hands-on experience in raw materials, packaging materials and finished goods management will be preferred. Key Skills Good knowledge of inventory and store management. Practical knowledge of FIFO/FEFO, stock reconciliation and physical inventory counting. Good computer skills, particularly MS Excel and inventory/ERP software. Strong documentation, communication and coordination skills. Ability to work under pressure and maintain accuracy in stock-related activities. Responsibilities & Context Receive, inspect and properly record all incoming raw materials, packaging materials, finished goods and other store items. Ensure proper storage, identification, stacking and preservation of materials according to company procedures. Maintain accurate stock records, bin cards, stock registers and system entries. Issue materials against authorized requisitions and maintain proper documentation. Conduct regular physical stock verification and reconcile physical stock with system/record balances. Monitor stock levels and inform the concerned authority regarding shortages, excess stock, slow-moving and obsolete items. Ensure FIFO/FEFO practices where applicable, particularly for food/raw materials and other time-sensitive items. Coordinate with Production, Procurement, Quality Assurance, Accounts and other relevant departments for smooth store operations. Maintain proper housekeeping, safety, security and hygiene standards within the store. Prepare regular stock reports and support management during stock audits and inspections. Perform any other store-related duties assigned by management. Compensation & Other Benefits Salary Negotiable, based on qualifications and experience. Other benefits will be provided as per company policy. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Mymensingh
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1540885&fc.source_content:
Requirements Additional Requirements স্পষ্টভাবে কথা বলা, মনোযোগ দিয়ে শোনা এবং গ্রাহকের সঙ্গে ব্যবসায়িক সম্পর্ক তৈরির দক্ষতা থাকতে হবে। Sales, Customer Service বা Account Management-এ অভিজ্ঞতা থাকলে অগ্রাধিকার দেওয়া হবে। ই-কমার্স, B2B সেলস বা চীন থেকে পণ্য সোর্সিং সম্পর্কে ধারণা থাকলে বাড়তি সুবিধা। WhatsApp Business, Excel/Google Sheets এবং কম্পিউটার ব্যবহারে দক্ষ হতে হবে। বাংলা ও বাংলিশে গ্রাহকের সঙ্গে লিখিত যোগাযোগ করতে পারতে হবে। দায়িত্বশীল, ধৈর্যশীল এবং নিয়মিত ফলোআপ ও লক্ষ্যমাত্রা অনুযায়ী কাজ করার মানসিকতা থাকতে হবে। গ্রাহকের অভিযোগ বুঝে সংশ্লিষ্ট টিমের সঙ্গে সমন্বয়ের মাধ্যমে সমাধান করতে আগ্রহী হতে হবে। অভিজ্ঞ প্রার্থীদের পাশাপাশি প্রয়োজনীয় দক্ষতাসম্পন্ন নতুনরাও আবেদন করতে পারবেন। Responsibilities & Context Wholesale Plus গ্রাহকদের সঙ্গে দীর্ঘমেয়াদি ব্যবসায়িক সম্পর্ক তৈরি, নিয়মিত ফলোআপ এবং রিপিট অর্ডার বাড়ানোর জন্য ৫ জন Key Account Manager (KAM) নিয়োগ দেবে। প্রধান দায়িত্বসমূহ: নির্ধারিত গ্রাহকদের সঙ্গে ফোন ও WhatsApp-এ নিয়মিত যোগাযোগ ও ফলোআপ করা। গ্রাহকের ব্যবসা ও পণ্যের চাহিদা বুঝে সোর্সিং, কোটেশন ও অর্ডার করতে সহায়তা করা। পুরোনো ও নিষ্ক্রিয় গ্রাহকদের পুনরায় অর্ডারে আগ্রহী করা। সম্ভাব্য গ্রাহকদের অনুসন্ধান ফলোআপ করে অর্ডারে রূপান্তর করা। অর্ডার, পেমেন্ট ও ডেলিভারির আপডেট দেওয়া এবং সংশ্লিষ্ট টিমের সঙ্গে সমন্বয় করা। গ্রাহকের অভিযোগ ও সমস্যা সমাধানের অগ্রগতি অনুসরণ করা। প্রয়োজন অনুযায়ী গুরুত্বপূর্ণ ব্যবসায়িক ও কর্পোরেট গ্রাহকদের ভিজিট করা। গ্রাহকের তথ্য, যোগাযোগের বিবরণ ও পরবর্তী ফলোআপের তারিখ নির্ধারিত সিস্টেমে সংরক্ষণ করা। মাসিক বিক্রয় ও রিপিট অর্ডারের লক্ষ্যমাত্রা অর্জনে কাজ করা। দৈনিক কাজ ও সাপ্তাহিক অগ্রগতির রিপোর্ট দেওয়া এবং গ্রাহকের মতামত জানানো। Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Relationship Management/ Key Account Management Customer Relationship B2B and B2C sales and marketing Lead Generation Complaint Handling skill Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka

Requirements Additional Requirements স্পষ্টভাবে কথা বলা, মনোযোগ দিয়ে শোনা এবং গ্রাহকের সঙ্গে ব্যবসায়িক সম্পর্ক তৈরির দক্ষতা থাকতে হবে। Sales, Customer Service বা Account Management-এ অভিজ্ঞতা থাকলে অগ্রাধিকার দেওয়া হবে। ই-কমার্স, B2B সেলস বা চীন থেকে পণ্য সোর্সিং সম্পর্কে ধারণা থাকলে বাড়তি সুবিধা। WhatsApp Business, Excel/Google Sheets এবং কম্পিউটার ব্যবহারে দক্ষ হতে হবে। বাংলা ও বাংলিশে গ্রাহকের সঙ্গে লিখিত যোগাযোগ করতে পারতে হবে। দায়িত্বশীল, ধৈর্যশীল এবং নিয়মিত ফলোআপ ও লক্ষ্যমাত্রা অনুযায়ী কাজ করার মানসিকতা থাকতে হবে। গ্রাহকের অভিযোগ বুঝে সংশ্লিষ্ট টিমের সঙ্গে সমন্বয়ের মাধ্যমে সমাধান করতে আগ্রহী হতে হবে। অভিজ্ঞ প্রার্থীদের পাশাপাশি প্রয়োজনীয় দক্ষতাসম্পন্ন নতুনরাও আবেদন করতে পারবেন। Responsibilities & Context Wholesale Plus গ্রাহকদের সঙ্গে দীর্ঘমেয়াদি ব্যবসায়িক সম্পর্ক তৈরি, নিয়মিত ফলোআপ এবং রিপিট অর্ডার বাড়ানোর জন্য ৫ জন Key Account Manager (KAM) নিয়োগ দেবে। প্রধান দায়িত্বসমূহ: নির্ধারিত গ্রাহকদের সঙ্গে ফোন ও WhatsApp-এ নিয়মিত যোগাযোগ ও ফলোআপ করা। গ্রাহকের ব্যবসা ও পণ্যের চাহিদা বুঝে সোর্সিং, কোটেশন ও অর্ডার করতে সহায়তা করা। পুরোনো ও নিষ্ক্রিয় গ্রাহকদের পুনরায় অর্ডারে আগ্রহী করা। সম্ভাব্য গ্রাহকদের অনুসন্ধান ফলোআপ করে অর্ডারে রূপান্তর করা। অর্ডার, পেমেন্ট ও ডেলিভারির আপডেট দেওয়া এবং সংশ্লিষ্ট টিমের সঙ্গে সমন্বয় করা। গ্রাহকের অভিযোগ ও সমস্যা সমাধানের অগ্রগতি অনুসরণ করা। প্রয়োজন অনুযায়ী গুরুত্বপূর্ণ ব্যবসায়িক ও কর্পোরেট গ্রাহকদের ভিজিট করা। গ্রাহকের তথ্য, যোগাযোগের বিবরণ ও পরবর্তী ফলোআপের তারিখ নির্ধারিত সিস্টেমে সংরক্ষণ করা। মাসিক বিক্রয় ও রিপিট অর্ডারের লক্ষ্যমাত্রা অর্জনে কাজ করা। দৈনিক কাজ ও সাপ্তাহিক অগ্রগতির রিপোর্ট দেওয়া এবং গ্রাহকের মতামত জানানো। Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Relationship Management/ Key Account Management Customer Relationship B2B and B2C sales and marketing Lead Generation Complaint Handling skill Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka

Requirements Education Masters in commerce background from any reputed university. Additional Requirements Age At most 45 years Minimum 1 years experience in the NGO sector Experience in Hospital management is preferable; Excellent organizational and multi-tasking ability, strong communication, report writing, presentation, and negotiation skills; Proficient in English (oral and written); Age limit could be consider as per candidate experiance. Responsibilities & Context Job Context: Dhaka Ahsania Mission (DAM) is a non-government development organization founded in 1958 by Khan Bahadur Ahsanullah, an eminent educationist, reformer, and Sufi with the aim of social and spiritual development of the entire human community. DAM has been contributing for the betterment of the disadvantaged population through operating 35 institutions and also 8 sectors of development. The Health and Nutrition Sector is one of the core sectors of DAM which has also been operating 7 institutions and 9 projects. DAM Health and Nutrition Sector is going to recruit a competent and self-motivated individual for the position of Accounts and Admin Officer for "Mayer Hashi General Hospital and Diagnostic Center" at Ashulia, Dhaka. Job Responsibility: Oversee day-to-day administrative operations, including scheduling, inventory management, and facility coordination, to ensure efficient hospital functioning. Assist central HR in the overall recruitment and employee HR relevant relevant process. Coordinate effectively with various departments to facilitate smooth and uninterrupted hospital operations. Supervise and manage support staff, including clerical, front desk, housekeeping, and other administrative personnel. Assist in the development, implementation, and periodic review of hospital policies, procedures, and compliance standards. Maintain accurate, confidential, and up-to-date patient records, administrative documentation, and institutional files. Monitor administrative workflows and identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and service quality. Manage patient billing, invoicing, account reconciliation, and related financial documentation. Oversee payroll processing and ensure timely and accurate payments to employees, suppliers, and service providers. Prepare and maintain financial reports, budgets, cash-flow projections, and periodic financial forecasts. Monitor hospital expenditures, control operational costs, and implement appropriate cost-saving measures. Coordinate with auditors, tax consultants, financial institutions, and relevant regulatory authorities as required. Ensure compliance with applicable financial regulations, accounting standards, tax requirements, and internal hospital policies. Maintain proper financial records and supporting documentation for audit, reporting, and management review purposes. Provide management with timely financial and administrative information to support effective planning and decision-making. Perform any other tasks time to time given by the authority. As a member of the organization, uphold and comply with DAM’s Safeguarding Policies and Code of Conduct, and take appropriate action to prevent, report, and respond to safeguarding concerns in accordance with established procedures. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Operational Management Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka (Ashulia)

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1539588&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelors degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Management, or any relevant discipline. MBA/Masters degree in Marketing or Management will be an advantage. Experience 2 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Automobile Additional Requirements Age 25 to 35 years Only Male Typically 2–3 years of relevant experience in sales, preferably in the motorcycle, automobile, automotive parts, or related industry. Experience in dealer management, retail sales, territory management, and market development will be preferred. Responsibilities & Context The Territory Sales Manager (TSM) will be responsible for achieving motorcycle sales targets, developing and managing the dealer network, expanding market coverage, and increasing the companys market share within the assigned territory. The position requires extensive fieldwork, strong dealer relationships, market analysis, and effective execution of sales and promotional strategies. Key Responsibilities Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual motorcycle sales targets for the assigned territory. Manage, develop, and maintain strong relationships with authorized dealers and sub-dealers. Identify and appoint potential new dealers to expand market coverage. Monitor dealer-wise and model-wise sales performance and take corrective actions where required. Drive secondary/retail sales through dealers and ensure regular product availability. Conduct frequent market and dealer visits to monitor sales, stock, showroom activities, and customer demand. Develop new markets and identify opportunities for increasing motorcycle penetration. Monitor competitors pricing, products, offers, promotions, dealer activities, and market strategies. Implement company-approved sales campaigns, promotional activities, branding, and merchandising programs. Train and motivate dealer sales teams on product features, customer handling, and sales techniques. Monitor dealer inventory and coordinate with relevant teams to maintain optimum stock levels. Support dealers in resolving sales, service, documentation, and customer-related issues. Monitor customer feedback and ensure proper resolution of complaints in coordination with the service team. Follow up on motorcycle registration/documentation processes where applicable. Prepare and submit daily, weekly, and monthly sales, stock, market, and competitor reports. Analyze territory sales data and prepare sales forecasts and action plans. Ensure compliance with company pricing, branding, sales, and operational policies. Monitor dealer showroom standards, product display, signage, and promotional materials. Maintain strong relationships with dealers, customers, and other relevant market stakeholders. Perform any other sales-related responsibilities assigned by management. Skills & Expertise Sales Sales & Marketing Other Relevant Skills Territory sales Sales Target Achievement Market Development Market Analysis Sales Forecasting Compensation & Other Benefits Tour allowance,Mobile bill,Performance bonus Salary Review: Yearly Lunch Facilities: Full Subsidize Festival Bonus: 2 Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Job Location Anywhere in Bangladesh
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

Typically 2–3 years of relevant experience in sales, preferably in the motorcycle, automobile, automotive parts, or related industry.
Experience in dealer management, retail sales, territory management, and market development will be preferred.
Responsibilities & Context
The Territory Sales Manager (TSM) will be responsible for achieving motorcycle sales targets, developing and managing the dealer network, expanding market coverage, and increasing the company`s market share within the assigned territory. The position requires extensive fieldwork, strong dealer relationships, market analysis, and effective execution of sales and promotional strategies.
Key Responsibilities
Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual motorcycle sales targets for the assigned territory.
Manage, develop, and maintain strong relationships with authorized dealers and sub-dealers.
Identify and appoint potential new dealers to expand market coverage.
Monitor dealer-wise and model-wise sales performance and take corrective actions where required.
Drive secondary/retail sales through dealers and ensure regular product availability.
Conduct frequent market and dealer visits to monitor sales, stock, showroom activities, and customer demand.
Develop new markets and identify opportunities for increasing motorcycle penetration.
Monitor competitors` pricing, products, offers, promotions, dealer activities, and market strategies.
Implement company-approved sales campaigns, promotional activities, branding, and merchandising programs.
Train and motivate dealer sales teams on product features, customer handling, and sales techniques.
Monitor dealer inventory and coordinate with relevant teams to maintain optimum stock levels.
Support dealers in resolving sales, service, documentation, and customer-related issues.
Monitor customer feedback and ensure proper resolution of complaints in coordination with the service team.
Follow up on motorcycle registration/documentation processes where applicable.
Prepare and submit daily, weekly, and monthly sales, stock, market, and competitor reports.
Analyze territory sales data and prepare sales forecasts and action plans.
Ensure compliance with company pricing, branding, sales, and operational policies.
Monitor dealer showroom standards, product display, signage, and promotional materials.
Maintain strong relationships with dealers, customers, and other relevant market stakeholders.
Perform any other sales-related responsibilities assigned by management.
Other Relevant Skills
Compensation & Other Benefits
Employment Status
Full Time
Gender
Only males are allowed to apply.

Anywhere in Bangladesh

Responsibilities & Context Job Responsibilities The incumbent will be directly responsible for developing and managing Institutional Sales (Business-to-Business/B2B) for products manufactured and marketed by Quasem Industries PLC and its sister concerns.
