jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1540951&fc.title: Executive - Internal Audit

raw_source_fields.experience: will be an advantage; however, fresh graduates with strong academic credentials from any public university are encouraged to apply. Effective communication and interpersonal skill Critical thinking and analysis The ability to write clear, concise, and grammatically correct English reports is crucial. Problem solving abilities Proficiency in IIA Standards, risks and controls frameworks (COSO etc.) Highest level of integrity Maintains objectivity in appearance and fact Ability to quickly learn new areas of business Flexibility to travel and visit various locations of the organizations partners, including call centers, distribution houses, among others. Responsibilities & Context Support the development of risk-based audit plans and roadmaps aligned with organizational goals, and assist in maintaining the audit universe, risk register, and other relevant tools to continuously assess, link, and prioritize critical business risks. Perform internal audit activities in accordance with IIA Standards, IIA Code of Ethics, Code of Conduct, organizational policies and procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements, while staying updated on audit methodologies, industry best practices, trends, and emerging issues that may impact the business. Demonstrate adherence to established policies and procedures and apply a systematic, disciplined, and value-adding approach to internal audit activities that meets the needs of the organization. Develop and document engagement plans, including objectives, scope, timelines, and resource requirements, considering the organization’s strategies, objectives, and risks relevant to each engagement. Independently perform and document assigned audit engagements by identifying, analyzing, evaluating, and documenting sufficient and appropriate information to achieve engagement objectives within approved timelines, budgets, and departmental standards. Develop, maintain, and update control assessment frameworks, models, criteria, and Risk & Control Matrices (RCMs) at the engagement level to assess the adequacy and effectiveness of governance, risk management, internal controls, processes, and systems. Maintain professional objectivity and independence throughout audit engagements; disclose any actual or perceived impairment of independence or objectivity, ensure balanced assessments based on relevant facts, and avoid undue influence from personal interests or other parties. Consider the possibility of significant errors, fraud, and non-compliance during assigned engagements and conduct appropriate examinations and verifications in line with professional standards and the level of diligence expected from a competent internal auditor. Ensure audit quality and timely delivery by assessing whether engagements adequately cover the approved scope and key risks, objectively evaluate governance, risk management, and controls, identify current business issues and their strategic or operational implications, and provide appropriate recommendations. Communicate audit results in an accurate, objective, clear, concise, constructive, complete, and timely manner, and work with auditees, process owners, and management to develop appropriate action plans and resolve identified control issues and risks. Conduct periodic follow-ups on audit recommendations and action plans, ensure timely implementation of agreed actions, and maintain the audit follow-up tracking system as required by the department. Escalate to the Head of Internal Audit (HIA), through the appropriate channel, where management or divisional heads accept a level of risk that may be unacceptable to the organization. Maintain a thorough and current understanding of the organization’s objectives, strategies, processes, systems, capabilities, employees, culture, industry practices, and business environment to ensure relevant and effective audit assessments. Consider the work of other assurance providers and assess whether reliance on their work is appropriate based on their scope and procedures, while coordinating with other control and monitoring functions to ensure effective use of audit resources. Build and maintain effective working relationships with process owners and business management to support improvements in internal controls, risk management, business processes, effectiveness, and efficiency. Assist the supervisor in functional, administrative, and other audit-related matters as and when required. Skills & Expertise Audit reporting Compliance Compliance and Integrity Critical and analytical thinking Data analysis Internal Control Problem solving and decision making Risk Assessment Target Oriented Other Relevant Skills Compliance code of conduct Internal Audit Risk Analysis

Perform internal audit activities in accordance with IIA Standards, IIA Code of Ethics, Code of Conduct, organizational policies and procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements, while staying updated on audit methodologies, industry best practices, trends, and emerging issues that may impact the business.
Demonstrate adherence to established policies and procedures and apply a systematic, disciplined, and value-adding approach to internal audit activities that meets the needs of the organization.
Develop and document engagement plans, including objectives, scope, timelines, and resource requirements, considering the organization’s strategies, objectives, and risks relevant to each engagement.
Independently perform and document assigned audit engagements by identifying, analyzing, evaluating, and documenting sufficient and appropriate information to achieve engagement objectives within approved timelines, budgets, and departmental standards.
Develop, maintain, and update control assessment frameworks, models, criteria, and Risk & Control Matrices (RCMs) at the engagement level to assess the adequacy and effectiveness of governance, risk management, internal controls, processes, and systems.
Maintain professional objectivity and independence throughout audit engagements; disclose any actual or perceived impairment of independence or objectivity, ensure balanced assessments based on relevant facts, and avoid undue influence from personal interests or other parties.
Consider the possibility of significant errors, fraud, and non-compliance during assigned engagements and conduct appropriate examinations and verifications in line with professional standards and the level of diligence expected from a competent internal auditor.
Ensure audit quality and timely delivery by assessing whether engagements adequately cover the approved scope and key risks, objectively evaluate governance, risk management, and controls, identify current business issues and their strategic or operational implications, and provide appropriate recommendations.
Communicate audit results in an accurate, objective, clear, concise, constructive, complete, and timely manner, and work with auditees, process owners, and management to develop appropriate action plans and resolve identified control issues and risks.
Conduct periodic follow-ups on audit recommendations and action plans, ensure timely implementation of agreed actions, and maintain the audit follow-up tracking system as required by the department.
Escalate to the Head of Internal Audit (HIA), through the appropriate channel, where management or divisional heads accept a level of risk that may be unacceptable to the organization.
Maintain a thorough and current understanding of the organization’s objectives, strategies, processes, systems, capabilities, employees, culture, industry practices, and business environment to ensure relevant and effective audit assessments.
Consider the work of other assurance providers and assess whether reliance on their work is appropriate based on their scope and procedures, while coordinating with other control and monitoring functions to ensure effective use of audit resources.
Build and maintain effective working relationships with process owners and business management to support improvements in internal controls, risk management, business processes, effectiveness, and efficiency.
Assist the supervisor in functional, administrative, and other audit-related matters as and when required.

Support risk-based internal audits, assess governance, risk and controls, identify control gaps, prepare audit findings and recommendations, and follow up on action plans in line with IIA Standards and regulatory requirements.

raw_source_fields.age: 24 to 30 years Responsibilities & Context Job Context: We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Jr. Executive, Business Development to join our team. In this role, you will play a key part in bridging connections between pharmaceutical clients and international suppliers. Job Responsibilities Client Communication & Requirement Gathering: Regularly communicate with pharmaceutical companies to identify and understand their new requirements for Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs) and Excipients. Supplier & Source Development: Identify, evaluate, and develop potential foreign suppliers, factories, and principals for high-quality pharmaceutical raw materials. Technical & Regulatory Documentation: Assist pharma clients by promptly providing essential technical documents, including Certificates of Analysis (COA), Methods of Analysis (MOA), Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS), and Stability Reports etc. Commercial Coordination: Request, collect, and analyze price quotations from international factories, suppliers, and principals to ensure competitive sourcing. Sample Procurement: Coordinate with foreign partners to collect and deliver required product samples to clients for testing and evaluation. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Business Development Supplier Management Supply Chain Management

Supplier & Source Development: Identify, evaluate, and develop potential foreign suppliers, factories, and principals for high-quality pharmaceutical raw materials.
Technical & Regulatory Documentation: Assist pharma clients by promptly providing essential technical documents, including Certificates of Analysis (COA), Methods of Analysis (MOA), Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS), and Stability Reports etc.
Commercial Coordination: Request, collect, and analyze price quotations from international factories, suppliers, and principals to ensure competitive sourcing.
Sample Procurement: Coordinate with foreign partners to collect and deliver required product samples to clients for testing and evaluation.

raw_source_fields.workplace: Dhanmondi 14 Road, 8/A/6/1, Near Sobhanbag Jame Mosque, Dhaka Working Hours: 10 Hours per Day Key Responsibilities Communicate with patients/clients through phone calls, WhatsApp, Messenger, and other communication channels. Provide clear and accurate information about SukunLife's services. Understand clients' needs and guide them toward appropriate services. Handle leads professionally and convert potential leads into appointments/sales. Schedule appointments and conduct timely follow-ups. Maintain client information, communication history, and sales/lead data in the CRM system. Provide professional and empathetic patient/client support. Follow up with existing and potential clients to improve service conversion and customer satisfaction. Forward relevant or sensitive cases to senior team members when necessary. Maintain polite, respectful, patient, and Islamic manners in all communications. Achieve assigned individual and team sales/lead conversion targets. Coordinate with the team to ensure smooth and effective client service. Why Join SukunLife? At SukunLife, you will have the opportunity to work in a meaningful and service-oriented environment where professionalism, compassion, and Islamic values are prioritized. We believe in developing our team members through proper training, performance-based growth, and continuous learning. jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1541116&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Minimum HSC / Bachelor's / Master's degree or equivalent. Candidates from any academic background may apply if they meet the required experience and skill criteria. Additional Requirements Experience Requirements Minimum 1 year of professional experience in Call Center or Sales is mandatory. Candidates with experience in Lead Management, Tele Sales, Customer Support, CRM, Appointment Booking, or Patient Support will receive preference. Required Skills & Competencies Excellent communication skills, especially in Bangla. Smart, confident, and professional communication style. Good listening and interpersonal skills. Ability to understand and respond to clients' concerns patiently. Basic computer knowledge and proficiency in smartphone applications. Ability to work with CRM/software-based systems. Strong sales and follow-up skills. Target-oriented and performance-driven mindset. Strong teamwork and time-management skills. Responsible, disciplined, and professional attitude. Willingness to work in a Deeni and Islamic values-based environment . Candidates must maintain Islamic etiquette and professional behavior while communicating with clients. What We Are Looking For We are looking for individuals who are: Patient and responsible. Excellent communicators. Good listeners who genuinely understand people's concerns. Confident and smart in handling clients. Target-oriented and motivated to achieve sales goals. Capable of working effectively as part of a team. Respectful, professional, and committed to Islamic values. Responsibilities & Context Lead Call Center Executive – Call Center & Sales SukunLife Shariah-Compliant Ruqyah, Counseling & Islamic Healing Services SukunLife is a Shariah-compliant service organization providing Ruqyah, Counseling, and Islamic Healing services . As part of our continued expansion, we are looking for dedicated, responsible, and smart individuals to join our Lead Call Center & Sales Team . We welcome applications from candidates who are interested in working in a Deeni and Islamic values-based environment , have strong communication skills, and can listen to clients' concerns with patience, empathy, and professionalism. Position Information Position: Lead Call Center Executive Department: Lead Call Center & Sales Workplace: Dhanmondi 14 Road, 8/A/6/1, Near Sobhanbag Jame Mosque, Dhaka Working Hours: 10 Hours per Day Key Responsibilities Communicate with patients/clients through phone calls, WhatsApp, Messenger, and other communication channels. Provide clear and accurate information about SukunLife's services. Understand clients' needs and guide them toward appropriate services. Handle leads professionally and convert potential leads into appointments/sales. Schedule appointments and conduct timely follow-ups. Maintain client information, communication history, and sales/lead data in the CRM system. Provide professional and empathetic patient/client support. Follow up with existing and potential clients to improve service conversion and customer satisfaction. Forward relevant or sensitive cases to senior team members when necessary. Maintain polite, respectful, patient, and Islamic manners in all communications. Achieve assigned individual and team sales/lead conversion targets. Coordinate with the team to ensure smooth and effective client service. Why Join SukunLife? At SukunLife, you will have the opportunity to work in a meaningful and service-oriented environment where professionalism, compassion, and Islamic values are prioritized. We believe in developing our team members through proper training, performance-based growth, and continuous learning. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills CRM Software Lead management Call Center Operation Compensation & Other Benefits Salary will be determined based on qualifications and experience. Basic Salary: BDT 14,000-22,000, depending on qualifications and experience. Performance-based incentives. Salary increment after 3 months, subject to performance and company policy. Further increment after 6 months. Annual salary increments thereafter based on performance and company policy. Professional training and development opportunities. Career growth and promotion opportunities. Respectful and supportive Islamic work environment. Scheduled leave and other applicable benefits. Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka (Dhanmondi)

Requirements Education Bachelors or Masters degree in Textile Engineering, Textile Chemistry or a relevant discipline from a recognized university. Additional Requirements 3–10 years of relevant experience in sales and business development within the textile chemical industry. Candidates with proven experience in selling textile dyes, auxiliaries, specialty chemicals or other textile processing chemicals will be preferred. Strong knowledge of textile chemicals, including pretreatment, dyeing, printing and finishing applications. Proven experience in selling textile chemicals to textile mills, dyeing, washing and finishing industries. Established relationships with textile manufacturers and key industry stakeholders will be an advantage. Strong business development, negotiation and customer relationship management skills. Good understanding of market dynamics, competitor activities, pricing and sales strategies within the textile chemical sector. Ability to identify customer needs and coordinate technical solutions with principals and internal teams. Proficiency in MS Office and CRM systems, with the ability to prepare sales reports and forecasts. Responsibilities & Context Drive sales and business development of textile chemicals, including pretreatment, dyeing, printing, finishing and other specialty chemicals. Develop new business opportunities by identifying potential customers, including textile mills, dyeing, washing, printing and finishing factories. Build and maintain strong relationships with existing customers while expanding the companys customer portfolio within the textile industry. Promote and sell textile chemical products by understanding customer requirements and recommending suitable products and solutions. Conduct regular customer visits, technical discussions and product presentations to identify business opportunities and strengthen customer engagement. Coordinate with international principals and suppliers to provide technical support, product information and customized solutions to customers. Arrange product trials, laboratory evaluations and industrial trials in collaboration with customers and technical teams to facilitate product approvals and business conversion Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve assigned sales targets, improve market penetration and ensure sustainable business growth. Monitor market trends, competitor activities, pricing strategies and emerging technologies in the textile chemical industry. Manage customer accounts, negotiate commercial terms, prepare quotations and follow up on sales orders and payments. Maintain up-to-date CRM reports, highlighting potential opportunities and pipeline developments. Effective communication and presentation skills

Good understanding of electrical power systems and basic electrical engineering principles. Basic knowledge of electrical drawings, SLD, load calculation, control panels, and power equipment. Good communication, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills. Good command of Bangla and English, both written and spoken. Proficiency in MS Office will be an advantage. Candidates interested in both technical engineering and sales activities are encouraged to apply. People with no experience in Sells & Marketing are discouraged to apply. Responsibilities & Context MH DHANMONDI LTD. is looking for a motivated and technically capable Generator Sells & Business Development (Assistant Engineer Electric) to join our team in Bangladesh. The position is suitable for fresh Diploma/BSc Electrical Engineers as well as candidates with 2–3 years of relevant experience in power generation, substation, technical sales, or commissioning. Job Responsibilities Support technical sales and business development activities for power and electrical solutions. Visit clients, consultants, contractors, industries, and project sites to understand technical requirements. Conduct site surveys, load assessments, and technical inspections for power projects. Assist in sales, installation, testing, commissioning, and after-sales support of: Substations and Power Distribution Systems Diesel/Gas Generator Sets Solar Power Systems and related equipment Synchronization, ATS/AMF, control and protection systems ACB, MCCB, switchgear, electrical panels and related equipment Prepare and review technical quotations, BOQ, SLD, specifications, tender documents, and proposals . Assist in system design, equipment selection, load calculations, and technical solutions according to project requirements. Coordinate with clients, consultants, contractors, suppliers, and internal technical teams. Support installation, testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, and maintenance activities at project sites. Follow up on quotations, tenders, ongoing projects, and new business opportunities. Prepare customer visit reports, project updates, and other technical/commercial reports. Travel to different locations across Bangladesh for client meetings, site surveys, project execution, commissioning, and business development . Perform any other technical, sales, or project-related responsibilities assigned by the management. Skills & Expertise Business Development Communication Diesel Generator Sales & Marketing Sales Development Solar Energy Other Relevant Skills BOQ Client Relationship Electrical Installation and Maintenance Compensation & Other Benefits Salary Review: Yearly Lunch Facilities: Partially Subsidize Festival Bonus: 2 Attractive salary package based on qualifications, experience, and company policy. Sales commission/bonus based on individual and business performance. Travel Allowance (TA) & Daily Allowance (DA) for official travel and project/site visits. Yearly performance-based salary increments and promotion opportunities. 3-6 months probationary period , depending on individual performance. Professional career development opportunities in Power Generation, Generator Sales, Substation, Commissioning, and Technical Sales. jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1541762&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Masters Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Diploma in relevant discipline from a recognized university/institute (Computer Science/Engineering, IT, Graphic Design, Marketing, or a related field with proven relevant experience). Experience 1 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Trading or Export/Import Additional Requirements Age At least 23 years Experience: 1–3 years in Website Development, Graphic Design, and LinkedIn Lead Generation. (Freshers with strong portfolios are also encouraged to apply for Executive role). Graphic Design: Proficient in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva, with experience in poster, brochure, and print design. Video editing skills (Premiere Pro / CapCut) are a plus. Website Development: Hands-on experience with WordPress / Wix / Shopify, responsive design, basic HTML/CSS, and SEO fundamentals. LinkedIn Lead Generation: Experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator, lead research, outreach/follow-up, and CRM or lead tracking. Strong practical and interpersonal skills; must be able to submit a portfolio of design, website, and lead generation work. Ability Good written communication skills in both Bengali and English Responsibilities & Context Job Summary FVL – Fatiha Venture LTD. is a leading import and distribution company. We are looking for a creative, energetic, and tech-savvy professional to join our team as an Executive/Senior Executive (IT & Digital Marketing). In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining our website, creating engaging print and digital designs (posters, brochures and more), and generating quality business leads through LinkedIn. Key Responsibilities (Job Responsibilities) Graphic & Print Design: Design attractive posters, brochures, banners, flyers, leaflets, and other promotional materials using Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva. Create social media graphics, LinkedIn post creatives, website assets, and digital advertisement designs. Ensure all designs align with the brand’s identity and visual guidelines. Prepare company brochure, company profile, catalogue, banner, poster, and leaflet for print and digital campaigns/programs, ensuring print-ready quality. Website Development & Maintenance: Design, develop, and launch responsive websites and landing pages using WordPress, Wix, Shopify, or similar platforms. Maintain and update the company website, including content, banners, product pages, plugins, and themes. Ensure website speed, mobile responsiveness, security, and basic SEO best practices. Manage domain, hosting, SSL, regular backups, and system updates. Track website performance (Google Analytics / Search Console) and implement improvements. LinkedIn Lead Generation & Outreach: Research and identify potential clients, distributors, and B2B prospects using LinkedIn (Sales Navigator) and other tools. Build targeted lead lists, send connection requests and personalized outreach messages, and follow up consistently. Manage and grow the company LinkedIn page; plan, schedule, and publish regular posts to build brand presence. Maintain a lead database/CRM, track outreach performance (response rate, qualified leads), and report to management regularly. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Adobe Photoshop Digital Marketing (Social Media Marketing) Graphic Design Linkedin marketing Social Media Management Compensation & Other Benefits Salary: Negotiable (Based on experience & capability). Mobile allowance Festive bonus, and other benefits as per company policy. Friendly work environment and career growth opportunities. Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka (Aftabnagar)
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

Requirements Education Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) in Accounting, Finance Experience 1 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Banks, Insurance, Hotel, Real Estate Additional Requirements Age 28 to 35 years Responsibilities & Context The Credit Recovery Officer will be responsible for monitoring outstanding dues, contacting clients for payment collection, and maintaining proper records of receivables. The role requires strong communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to handle sensitive financial matters professionally. Monitor and track all overdue payments. Contact clients via phone, email, and in person to follow up on pending dues. Negotiate and arrange suitable payment plans when necessary. Prepare and maintain daily, weekly, and periodic departmental reports. Maintain and regularly update the departmental customer database. Monitor and maintain the departmental target and achievement records. Conduct physical collection from customers as required. Perform computer-based reporting, data entry, and record maintenance efficiently. Requirements Education Masters Experience At least 2 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Manufacturing (FMCG), Advertising Agency, Electronic Equipment/Home Appliances Additional Requirements Age At least 27 years Only Male Responsibilities & Context Must be fluent in English, both speaking and writing, to effectively communicate with foreign suppliers, shipping lines, and other international stakeholders. Ensure the timely preparation of all import documents to facilitate the smooth execution of import procedures and compliance with regulations. Possess sound knowledge of Letter of Credit (L/C) processes, amendments, and terms and conditions, liaising with banks and other organizations regarding L/C and payment issues. Collaborate with internal departments and suppliers to ensure the quality and timely delivery of raw materials and accessories through import processes. Experienced in operating an ERP system for group import raw materials, ensuring accurate data management and reporting. Communicate with parties in contracts to ensure mutual understanding of terms, particularly regarding financial aspects, and stay updated on market trends, material prices, and product developments. Follow up on the Procurement to Payment process in line with the Procurement Policy, maintaining and updating all Supply Chain Management (SCM) reports for relevant departments. Perform any other tasks assigned by management to support the smooth operation of the supply chain function. jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1541952&fc.source_content:
Requirements Experience At least 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): NGO Additional Requirements Age At most 45 years Training on financial management, planning, financial reporting, project accounting and PPR 2025. Experience working in coastal regions of Bangladesh on development projects. Prior experience in managing accounts for donor-funded projects (e.g., Adaptation Fund, World Bank, European Union). Advanced accounting skills and practical knowledge of standard accounting software. Strong understanding of budgeting, financial reporting, reimbursement reporting and fund management. Knowledge of International Accounting Standards (IAS) and International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS). Ability to prepare financial statements, budgets, and reports in prescribed formats. Excellent oral and written communication skills in English and Bangla. Strong computer proficiency, especially in MS Office Packages (Excel, Word, PowerPoint). Interpersonal skills to perform adequately in a team environment and with partner organizations. 100% travelling to remote project areas Responsibilities & Context HEED Bangladesh is Non-Government and non-political National Organization working in the field of Health, Education and Economic Development for more than 52 (fifty-two) years. The Organization invites applications from the suitable candidates for its Safe Water Project (SWP) – Access to Safe Drinking Water for Climate-Vulnerable Coastal Communities through Solar-Generated RO Water Treatment Facilities in Khulna area. Bangladesh is recognized as one of the country’s most vulnerable to the impacts of climate change. The Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC) has identified the coastal region as one of the major climate hotspot areas due to increasing salinity intrusion, sea-level rise, cyclones, storm surges, tidal flooding, and coastal erosion. These climate-induced hazards have significantly affected the livelihoods, health, and living conditions of coastal communities. Among the most critical challenges is the scarcity of safe drinking water, as freshwater sources are increasingly becoming saline and unsuitable for human consumption. The experience of HEED Bangladesh indicates that climate-vulnerable coastal communities continue to face severe difficulties in accessing safe and reliable drinking water. Salinity intrusion into both surface and groundwater sources, coupled with the impacts of recurrent cyclones and tidal surges, has substantially reduced the availability of potable water. As a result, people—particularly women and children—are compelled to travel long distances to collect drinking water, exposing them to health risks, economic hardship, and reduced productivity. Limited access to safe drinking water also contributes to waterborne diseases and undermines the resilience of vulnerable households. Under these circumstances, to improve access to safe drinking water and strengthen the climate resilience of vulnerable coastal communities in the Dacope upazila of Khulna districts, HEED Bangladesh will implement the project titled “Access to Safe Drinking Water for the Climate Vulnerable People in Coastal Areas of Bangladesh through Solar-generated Reverse Osmosis Water Treatment Facilities.” The project will be financed by the Adaptation Fund (AF) through Palli Karma-Sahayak Foundation (PKSF) and will be implemented over a period of two years. The specific objectives of the project are: Ensure access to safe and climate-resilient drinking water for vulnerable coastal communities through the installation and operation of Reverse Osmosis (RO) water treatment plants. Enhance awareness and knowledge of climate-vulnerable communities on safe drinking water, health, hygiene, and climate change adaptation practices. Hence, HEED Bangladesh is seeking qualified candidates for the post of “OFFICER (Accounts and Procurement)" to implement the project and provide overall technical support for the successful implementation of the project activities. BACKGROUD OF THE PROJECT Bangladesh is one of the countries, most vulnerable to the adverse impacts of climate change. Coastal communities are particularly exposed to sea-level rise, cyclones, storm surges, salinity intrusion, riverbank erosion, waterlogging, and irregular rainfall. These climate-related hazards have severely affected surface water and groundwater sources, creating an acute shortage of safe drinking water and increasing risks to the health, livelihoods, and overall well-being of coastal populations. To address this challenge, Palli Karma-Sahayak Foundation (PKSF), with financial support from the Adaptation Fund under the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC), is implementing the three-year project titled “Access to Safe Drinking Water for the Climate Vulnerable People in Coastal Areas of Bangladesh through Solar-generated Reverse Osmosis (RO) Water Treatment Facilities.” Under the project, a total of 180 Reverse Osmosis water treatment plants will be installed in selected climate-vulnerable areas of Khulna districts to improve access to safe and climate-resilient drinking water. The project is being implemented through Operating Entities (OEs) selected by PKSF. Its major activities include the procurement, installation, commissioning, operation, and maintenance of RO water treatment plants; establishment of three (03) Knowledge Hub; procurement and use of water-testing kits; and capacity-building of beneficiaries, local technicians, and relevant stakeholders. The project also includes awareness-raising activities on safe water management, water quality, hygiene, and public health. Job Responsibilities: The Officer acts as the Financial Lead at the HEED Bangladesh level to ensure transparent, compliant, and efficient financial management of the sub-project. The role focuses on maintaining accurate books of accounts, managing fund flows, preparing budgets, financial reports, and reimbursement application ensuring strict adherence to PKSF and donor financial policies. The position serves as the primary financial liaison between the PO and the PKSF’s Project Management Unit (PMU) of Safe water Project (SWP) for all accounting and reporting matters. The Officer will be responsible for the following duties: Maintain separate books of accounts for the sub-project on an accrual basis under the historical cost convention, following the accounting manual of PKSF, International Accounting Standards (IAS) and International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS). Operate and maintain a computerized accounting system to record all financial transactions of the sub-project accurately and promptly. Prepare and submit monthly financial report and six-monthly reimbursement report according to the PKSF’s Project Management Unit (PMU) of Safe water Project (SWP) financial guideline and template. Support the preparation of annual, half-yearly, and quarterly budgets for the sub-project, aligning with procurement plans and work plans. Monitor the flow of funds from the Project to the sub-project and ensure smooth disbursement of funds to vendors, contractors, and for operational expenses in accordance with approved budgets. Prepare and submit annual financial statements incorporating disclosure on income and expenditure, receipts and payments, and the financial position of the sub-project, along with relevant notes and information. Ensure adequate internal controls are in place for the proper utilization, management, and accounting of funds at the sub-project level. Prepare monthly bank reconciliation statements for sub-project bank accounts. Prepare and review all sub-project budgets, reimbursement bills, and financial claims from partners/vendors before submission to the PMU. Assist in the preparation of cost proposals for new activities, training, and other project-related events. Ensure that shared cost amounts are correctly budgeted in each proposal for sub-project activities. Coordinate with PKSF’s PMU of SWP accounts and internal audit department of PO’s by providing necessary information and documentation for audits. Support external auditors with required information, records, and documentation for project/sub-project audits. Review external and internal audit reports, along with management letters, and assist in implementing audit recommendations. Provide advice and monitoring support to project and PO’s staff on the efficient operation of sub-project bank accounts and fund utilization. Ensure compliance with all PKSF’s PMU of SWP financial, accounting and procurement policies, procedures and donor requirements. Work in coordination with the PKSF’s Project Management Unit (PMU) of Safe Water Project (SWP) for financial validation, reporting, and quality assurance. Assist to prepare tender documents and evaluation procedure of RO plant installation and construction according to PPR 2025. Frequent field visit to monitor the RO Plant. Any other task which is assign by HEED Bangladesh, PKSF and Donor. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Budgeting and Forecasting Cash Management Financial Reporting Internal Audit Vendor Management Compensation & Other Benefits As per HEED Policy Monthly consolidated BDT 40,000 (inclusive of taxes) + other admissible benefits. Employment Status Contractual Job Location Khulna (Dacope)

Salinity intrusion into both surface and groundwater sources, coupled with the impacts of recurrent cyclones and tidal surges, has substantially reduced the availability of potable water. As a result, people—particularly women and children—are compelled to travel long distances to collect drinking water, exposing them to health risks, economic hardship, and reduced productivity. Limited access to safe drinking water also contributes to waterborne diseases and undermines the resilience of vulnerable households.
Under these circumstances, to improve access to safe drinking water and strengthen the climate resilience of vulnerable coastal communities in the Dacope upazila of Khulna districts, HEED Bangladesh will implement the project titled “Access to Safe Drinking Water for the Climate Vulnerable People in Coastal Areas of Bangladesh through Solar-generated Reverse Osmosis Water Treatment Facilities.” The project will be financed by the Adaptation Fund (AF) through Palli Karma-Sahayak Foundation (PKSF) and will be implemented over a period of two years.

raw_source_fields.age: 20 to 30 years Only Male Strong Communication, Presentation, and negotiation skills. Analytical and problem solving skills. Proven track record of achieving sales targets. Excellent customer service and relationship-building abilities. Knowledge of sales techniques and market trends. Responsibilities & Context A Sales Officer is responsible for generating revenue by promoting and selling products and services, which involves identifying, building customer relationships, presenting products and closing deals. Key duties include achieving sales targets, maintaining accurate records, preparing sales reports, and collaborating with other teams like marketing. Core responsibilities: Sales and revenue: Achieve and exceed sales targets by identifying and pursuing new business opportunities through prospecting and cold calling. Customer relations: Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and new clients by understanding their needs and providing excellent customer service. Presentations and negotiation: Present and demonstrate products or services and negotiate pricing and contract terms to close sales. Market analysis: Conduct market research to identify trends, understand competitor activities, and develop effective sales strategies. Reporting and tracking: Maintain accurate records of sales activities, client information, sales performance and prepare regular reports for management. Collaboration: Work with internal teams, such as marketing and logistics, to ensure customer satisfaction and timely delivery of products or services. Skills & Expertise Analytical Skill career oriented Positive attitude Presentation skill Quick learner and hard working Other Relevant Skills Market Analysis Sales
raw_source_fields.gender: Only males are allowed to apply.

Safeguard company assets by controlling inventory age, maintaining furniture and fixtures, handling customer claims, and ensuring proper receiving, dispatch, and transfer of merchandise. jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1542501&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education BBA/MBA/M.Com in Accounting, Finance or related discipline. Fresh graduates or candidates with 1 year of relevant experience may apply. Experience Additional Requirements Age At least 25 years Basic understanding of accounting, inventory control and audit procedures. Good numerical and analytical skills with strong attention to detail. Working knowledge of MS Excel. ERP/Oracle experience will be an added advantage. Candidates should be honest, responsible and willing to perform regular physical inventory checks. Responsibilities & Context We are looking for energetic, detail-oriented professionals to join our Finance Team in the role of Executive – Finance Audit & Controls . Conduct regular physical inventory counts and stock verification across stores, warehouses and production-related inventory locations. Reconcile physical inventory with ERP/system records and investigate shortages, excesses and variances. Perform surprise stock counts and other inventory control checks. Review inventory movement, consumption, adjustments, transfers, wastage and supporting documentation. Review vouchers, bills, invoices, payments and other financial transactions for accuracy and compliance. Verify proper approvals and supporting documents. Check procurement and other finance-related transactions. Identify discrepancies, unusual transactions and internal control gaps. Prepare clear checking/audit observations and follow up on corrective actions. Support periodic internal control reviews and physical verification of assets where required. Ensure compliance with company policies and financial control procedures. Skills & Expertise Accounts and audit Accounts and Finance Data analysis Microsoft Office Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Cumilla (Cumilla Adarsha Sadar)
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1542338&fc.title: Executive - Internal Audit

raw_source_fields.education: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) Candidates must have completed CA (CC) from a renowned CA firm.
raw_source_fields.age: At least 25 years Only Male Responsibilities & Context Perform post-audit verification to ensure proper implementation of audit observations and corrective actions. Verify inventory, stock records, and project materials against physical quantities and supporting documents. Monitor advances, outstanding balances, collections, and related documentation. Review and verify project expenses, and supporting documents for accuracy and compliance. Verify vehicle-related documents, including logbooks, fuel records, maintenance records, bills, and other supporting documents. Identify discrepancies, control weaknesses, irregularities, and potential financial or operational risks and report them to management. Check compliance with company policies, procedures, and internal control requirements. Prepare audit findings, verification reports, and other audit-related reports with clear observations and recommendations. Coordinate with relevant departments and project teams to obtain necessary documents, explanations, and supporting information. Follow up on previous audit findings and monitor the status of corrective actions. Maintain proper audit working papers, records, checklists, and supporting documents for future reference. Conduct field visits to project locations and business concerns when required for audit and verification purposes.
raw_source_fields.gender: Only males are allowed to apply.

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1541468&fc.title: Senior Relationship Officer/Relationship Officer for Liability Marketing

raw_source_fields.experience: in Liability Marketing or Deposit Mobilization from any reputed Commercial Bank will be considered as added advantage. Strong sales, business development and negotiation skills Sound knowledge of CASA, FDR, deposit pricing and liability products Ability to build relationships with senior corporate and institutional decision-makers Target-oriented, with pipeline and portfolio management ability Good understanding of banking operations, KYC and AML/CFT requirements Excellent communication and presentation skills Proficiency in MS Office and MIS tools Ability to work independently and collaboratively Responsibilities & Context Senior Relationship Officer/Relationship Officer-Liability Marketing Unit (LMU) will be responsible for achieving assigned deposit mobilization targets, with primary focus on CASA, through acquiring new customers, and growing existing relationships across corporate, institutional, government, SME and high-net-worth segments. The role involves building and maintaining a strong customer base, promoting the bank’s liability products, and ensuring compliance with internal policies and regulatory guidelines. This is a target based position requiring strong communication, negotiation skills and a result oriented mindset to contribute to the bank’s overall business growth. Job Responsibilities: Deposit Mobilization: Achieve assigned CASA and overall deposit targets, prioritizing low-cost CASA while generating quality FDR and other deposits where appropriate. Customer Acquisition: Identify, approach and onboard New-to-Bank customers from corporate, multinational, government, institutional, SME and HNI segments. Relationship Management: Build long-term relationships with key decision-makers, conduct regular client visits, understand customer needs and offer suitable liability solutions. Pipeline & Sales Planning: Maintain an updated prospect database and sales pipeline, prepare monthly/quarterly/annual sales plans, follow up on leads, and track proposals through to fund placement. CASA Growth & Retention: Promote transactional banking to build sustainable operating balances, monitor portfolio inflows/outflows and maturities, and take proactive steps to retain deposits and deepen wallet share. Compliance : Ensure all activities comply with Bank policies, Bangladesh Bank regulations and AML/CFT requirements, including proper KYC, accurate documentation, approved pricing, and prompt escalation of suspicious activity. Coordination & Reporting: Work with Branches and other units for smooth onboarding and service, maintain records of sales activities, submit timely reports, and perform other duties as assigned by management. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Compliance Customer Acquisition Relationship Management Sales Planning

raw_source_fields.age: At most 35 years Strong knowledge of FMCG sales processes, distributor operations, trade promotions, and ERP/SAP systems with advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel; Power BI knowledge will be an added advantage. Excellent analytical, communication, and report-writing skills with high integrity, attention to detail, and willingness to travel extensively for field and distributor audits. Responsibilities & Context Conduct regular field and system audits to ensure compliance with sales policies, SOPs, and company guidelines across the sales network. Audit distributor operations, including inventory, stock reconciliation, cash collections, credit management, and trade claims to ensure accuracy and control. Verify sales transactions, promotional activities, trade schemes, and incentive claims to detect discrepancies, non-compliance, or fraudulent practices. Monitor field sales execution, including route compliance, market coverage, merchandising standards, and outlet visitation quality. Analyze sales and audit data to identify operational risks, unusual trends, control gaps, and opportunities for process improvement. Prepare comprehensive audit reports with findings, root-cause analysis, and actionable recommendations, and monitor the implementation of corrective actions. Conduct surprise market and distributor audits while collaborating with Sales, Finance, Supply Chain, and Internal Audit to strengthen governance and internal controls. Drive continuous improvement by recommending enhancements to sales processes, audit controls, compliance practices, and operational efficiency. Skills & Expertise Analytical Skill Presentation skill Sales Audit

Experience At least 2 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Marine Industry Additional Requirements Age At least 26 years Only Male We are looking for someone who is strong in field coordination and people management . The ideal candidate should: Be confident and comfortable dealing with divers and field workers. Have a firm but respectful personality. Be able to control difficult situations without unnecessarily escalating conflicts. Be capable of resolving disagreements between team members. Have good leadership and communication skills. Be able to give clear instructions and ensure they are followed. Be responsible and dependable. Be able to work under pressure and in difficult field conditions. Be willing to travel and stay at project locations when required. Have good organizational and documentation skills. Be comfortable communicating with clients, vessel personnel and company management. The ability to manage people, maintain discipline and keep the diving team working together is one of the most important requirements of this position. Experience Experience in any of the following will be an advantage: Commercial diving operations Marine/shipyard operations Offshore or port operations Ship inspection Field operations Construction/site supervision Workforce/team coordination Marine documentation Underwater inspection Ship repair or maintenance Candidates without diving experience may also apply if they have strong field coordination and people-management skills. Required Skills People & Field Management Strong leadership and people-management skills Conflict-resolution ability Ability to maintain discipline among field personnel Good communication and coordination skills Ability to work with workers from different backgrounds Ability to remain calm under pressure Computer & Documentation MS Word MS Excel Report preparation Document formatting File and folder management Basic presentation skills Photo & Video Basic to intermediate video editing skills Ability to use software such as CapCut, Filmora, DaVinci Resolve, Adobe Premiere Pro or similar Basic photo editing and image organization Important Working Conditions This is not a purely office-based position . The selected candidate will be required to work at vessels, ports, terminals, shipyards, workshops and other diving project locations. The candidate may occasionally need to: Work early morning or late night depending on vessel schedules. Work on weekends or public holidays during urgent operations. Travel outside Chattogram. Stay at project locations when required. Work in challenging marine and weather conditions. Coordinate with teams under time pressure. What We Expect From You We are looking for someone who can take ownership of the field operation . You should be the type of person who can: “Go to the site → organize the team → make sure everyone knows their job → keep discipline → solve problems → monitor the work → collect the information → report back to management.” If you are comfortable managing people, communicating with workers and taking responsibility in the field, this position may be suitable for you. Responsibilities & Context Department: Diving Operations About the Position Nishi Salvage & Diving is looking for a responsible, confident and firm Field Coordinator to manage and coordinate our commercial diving teams during underwater inspection and marine diving projects. This position is primarily a field coordination and people-management role . The successful candidate will work closely with divers, diving supervisors, boat crews and office management to ensure that diving operations are properly coordinated, disciplined and completed according to the project requirements. The person will also be responsible for preparing underwater inspection reports, organizing inspection documentation and editing underwater photographs and videos . We are looking for someone who can manage people firmly but professionally, handle disagreements calmly, maintain discipline and keep the field operation running smoothly. Key Responsibilities Field & Diving Team Coordination — Primary Responsibility Coordinate daily activities of divers, diving supervisors, boat crews and field personnel. Ensure that the diving team understands the assigned scope of work and daily requirements. Coordinate manpower, diving equipment, boats and other field requirements with the operations team. Monitor the attendance, discipline and work performance of field personnel. Ensure that instructions from management and the Diving Supervisor are properly communicated and followed. Maintain a professional and respectful working environment among divers and field workers. Handle disagreements, misunderstandings and conflicts between team members before they affect the diving operation. Act as a communication bridge between the office, diving team, vessel crew, clients and supervisors. Keep management updated about field progress, manpower issues, operational problems and delays. Take immediate action on routine field coordination issues and escalate serious matters to management. Ensure that unnecessary arguments, disputes or personal issues do not disrupt the project. Maintain discipline while treating field workers fairly and professionally. Coordinate mobilization and demobilization of diving teams and equipment. Travel to vessels, ports, terminals, shipyards and other project locations as required. Be available outside normal office hours when required by vessel schedules or diving operations. Project Monitoring & Field Reporting Monitor daily progress of underwater inspection and diving activities. Collect accurate information from divers and diving supervisors. Maintain daily field activity records. Record completed work, pending work, difficulties and important observations. Communicate field updates to management on time. Coordinate with vessel representatives, clients and surveyors when required. Ensure that required photographs, videos and inspection information are collected during the operation. Underwater Inspection Documentation Prepare professional underwater inspection reports based on information collected from the diving team. Organize inspection findings, photographs, videos and observations. Prepare daily work reports, inspection records, checklists and other project documentation. Review diver notes and underwater inspection findings for completeness. Compile technical information into clear and properly formatted reports. Maintain proper records for completed diving projects. Ensure reports are prepared and submitted within project deadlines. Underwater Photo & Video Editing Review underwater inspection photographs and videos recorded during diving operations. Select relevant photographs and video footage for reports. Edit underwater inspection videos for client and surveyor presentation. Add vessel name, inspection area, date, location, labels and other relevant information where required. Organize and properly store project photos, videos and final reports. Maintain an organized digital archive of completed projects. Skills & Expertise People Management skill Report Writing Video Editing Other Relevant Skills Documentation Team management Video Editing Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Job Location Chattogram (Chattogram Sadar)
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1542966&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelor’s degree in Human Resource Management, Business Administration, Management, or a related field. MBA/PGD in HRM will be an advantage. Experience 1 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Manufacturing (FMCG), Retail Store Additional Requirements Only Male Must be proactive, energetic, responsible, and well-organized. Willingness to visit factory/production facilities regularly as required. Willingness to handle HR, administration, procurement, and factory coordination responsibilities. Must have good interpersonal and communication skills. Candidates who can join immediately or within a short notice period will get preference. Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines. Experience Requirements 1–3 years of relevant experience in HR & Administration. Candidates with experience in HR operations, recruitment, attendance management, employee documentation, payroll support, administrative procurement, factory coordination, and general administration will be preferred. Experience in manufacturing, FMCG, retail, or factory-based organizations will be an advantage. Required Skills & Competencies Good knowledge of HR & Administrative functions. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Good command of MS Office, particularly MS Excel and MS Word. Ability to maintain accurate records and documentation. Good organizational and time-management skills. Strong coordination and negotiation skills. Basic understanding of procurement and vendor management. Ability to handle confidential information professionally. Strong problem-solving and multitasking abilities. Strong sense of responsibility, discipline, and professionalism. Ability to work independently as well as in a team. Ability to communicate effectively with factory workers, employees, management, vendors, and external parties. Responsibilities & Context Department: Human Resources & Administration Job Summary: We are looking for a proactive, responsible, and well-organized HR & Admin Executive to manage day-to-day HR, administrative, procurement, and factory coordination activities. The ideal candidate should have good communication skills, strong interpersonal ability, practical knowledge of HR operations, and the ability to handle multiple administrative responsibilities efficiently. Key Responsibilities HR Responsibilities Assist in end-to-end recruitment activities, including job posting, CV screening, interview scheduling, candidate coordination, and onboarding. Maintain and update employee personal files, HR records, attendance, leave, and other employee-related documents. Prepare and maintain appointment letters, confirmation letters, increment letters, transfer letters, warning letters, and other HR documents. Monitor daily attendance, late attendance, leave, overtime, and employee movement. Assist in monthly payroll preparation and provide necessary HR-related data. Ensure proper implementation of company HR policies, rules, procedures, and guidelines. Handle employee queries and provide necessary support regarding HR-related matters. Assist in employee onboarding, orientation, and induction programs. Maintain confidentiality of employee and organizational information. Support management in maintaining a positive and disciplined workplace environment. Prepare regular HR reports and employee-related reports as required by management. Administration & Factory Coordination Manage day-to-day administrative activities to ensure smooth and efficient office operations. Regularly visit factory/production facilities to monitor HR and administrative activities and ensure proper coordination between the head office and factory. Coordinate with factory management and employees regarding attendance, manpower, employee issues, administrative requirements, and operational matters. Ensure availability and proper management of stationery, office supplies, equipment, and other administrative materials. Manage office and factory-related documentation and maintain proper records. Coordinate with vendors, suppliers, service providers, and external parties for administrative requirements. Assist in maintaining proper workplace facilities and ensuring necessary administrative support for employees. Support management in organizing meetings, events, employee engagement activities, training programs, and other organizational activities. Handle any other day-to-day administrative tasks assigned by management. Administrative Purchase & Procurement Handle administrative purchasing and procurement activities for office and factory requirements. Source and communicate with suppliers/vendors for necessary products and services. Collect and compare quotations, prices, product quality, and delivery schedules. Coordinate purchase orders, deliveries, and follow-up with suppliers. Maintain proper purchase records, bills, invoices, quotations, and supporting documents. Ensure timely procurement of office stationery, supplies, equipment, and other administrative requirements. Develop and maintain good relationships with suppliers and service providers. Ensure purchases are made within approved budgets and company policies. Skills & Expertise Employee Management Factory HR Administration General Administration HR Operation Payroll Administration Procurement Recruitment & Selection Other Relevant Skills Employee Management Factory HR Administration General Administration HR Operation Payroll Administration Procurement Recruitment & Selection Compensation & Other Benefits Compensation & Benefits Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications. Festival Bonus. Other benefits as per company policy. Career growth and professional development opportunities. Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Job Location Dhaka
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

Requirements
Education
Experience
Additional Requirements
Must be proactive, energetic, responsible, and well-organized.
Willingness to visit factory/production facilities regularly as required.
Willingness to handle HR, administration, procurement, and factory coordination responsibilities.
Must have good interpersonal and communication skills.
Candidates who can join immediately or within a short notice period will get preference.
Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
Experience Requirements
1–3 years of relevant experience in HR & Administration.
Candidates with experience in HR operations, recruitment, attendance management, employee documentation, payroll support, administrative procurement, factory coordination, and general administration will be preferred.
Experience in manufacturing, FMCG, retail, or factory-based organizations will be an advantage.
Required Skills & Competencies
Good knowledge of HR & Administrative functions.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Good command of MS Office, particularly MS Excel and MS Word.
Ability to maintain accurate records and documentation.
Good organizational and time-management skills.
Strong coordination and negotiation skills.
Basic understanding of procurement and vendor management.
Ability to handle confidential information professionally.
Strong problem-solving and multitasking abilities.
Strong sense of responsibility, discipline, and professionalism.
Ability to work independently as well as in a team.
Ability to communicate effectively with factory workers, employees, management, vendors, and external parties.
Responsibilities & Context
Department: Human Resources & Administration
Job Summary:
We are looking for a proactive, responsible, and well-organized HR & Admin Executive to manage day-to-day HR, administrative, procurement, and factory coordination activities. The ideal candidate should have good communication skills, strong interpersonal ability, practical knowledge of HR operations, and the ability to handle multiple administrative responsibilities efficiently.
Key Responsibilities
HR Responsibilities
Assist in end-to-end recruitment activities, including job posting, CV screening, interview scheduling, candidate coordination, and onboarding.
Maintain and update employee personal files, HR records, attendance, leave, and other employee-related documents.
Prepare and maintain appointment letters, confirmation letters, increment letters, transfer letters, warning letters, and other HR documents.
Monitor daily attendance, late attendance, leave, overtime, and employee movement.
Assist in monthly payroll preparation and provide necessary HR-related data.
Ensure proper implementation of company HR policies, rules, procedures, and guidelines.
Handle employee queries and provide necessary support regarding HR-related matters.
Assist in employee onboarding, orientation, and induction programs.
Maintain confidentiality of employee and organizational information.
Support management in maintaining a positive and disciplined workplace environment.
Prepare regular HR reports and employee-related reports as required by management.
Administration & Factory Coordination
Manage day-to-day administrative activities to ensure smooth and efficient office operations.
Regularly visit factory/production facilities to monitor HR and administrative activities and ensure proper coordination between the head office and factory.
Coordinate with factory management and employees regarding attendance, manpower, employee issues, administrative requirements, and operational matters.
Ensure availability and proper management of stationery, office supplies, equipment, and other administrative materials.
Manage office and factory-related documentation and maintain proper records.
Coordinate with vendors, suppliers, service providers, and external parties for administrative requirements.
Assist in maintaining proper workplace facilities and ensuring necessary administrative support for employees.
Support management in organizing meetings, events, employee engagement activities, training programs, and other organizational activities.
Handle any other day-to-day administrative tasks assigned by management.
Administrative Purchase & Procurement
Handle administrative purchasing and procurement activities for office and factory requirements.
Source and communicate with suppliers/vendors for necessary products and services.
Collect and compare quotations, prices, product quality, and delivery schedules.
Coordinate purchase orders, deliveries, and follow-up with suppliers.
Maintain proper purchase records, bills, invoices, quotations, and supporting documents.
Ensure timely procurement of office stationery, supplies, equipment, and other administrative requirements.
Develop and maintain good relationships with suppliers and service providers.
Ensure purchases are made within approved budgets and company policies.
Other Relevant Skills
Compensation & Other Benefits
Compensation & Benefits
Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications.
Festival Bonus.
Other benefits as per company policy.
Career growth and professional development opportunities.
Employment Status
Full Time
Gender
Only males are allowed to apply.
Job Location
Dhaka

Interested candidates are requested to submit their updated CV mentioning "HR & Admin Executive" in the subject line.
Candidates with relevant experience in HR, Administration, Administrative Purchase, and Factory Coordination are strongly encouraged to apply.

The university is playing an integral role in the development of skilled graduates for a knowledge-based economy. We are searching for a competent candidate to add value to this role including strategic and operational support to all areas of the organization.
KEY RESPONSIBILTIES
Maintain and update employee information in the HRIS, ensuring real-time updates for any changes
Assist in conducting the recruitment and selection process, including job advertisements, CV screening, scheduling interviews, contacting candidates, managing competitive exams, physical interviews and overseeing the employee onboarding process
Generate standard and custom reports from the HRIS as and when required
Handle day-to-day HR operations along with periodic and special assignments
Drafting meeting minutes, office circular and different employee communications
Organize different employee engagement events
Involvement in employer branding and promote the organization`s employer brand to attract top talent
Participate in HR projects and initiatives aimed at enhancing the employee experience and advancing organizational objectives
Stay abreast of HR trends, laws, regulations and recommend changes to enhance the effectiveness of HR services

Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Bachelor’s degree in any relevant subject. Experience 1 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Travel Agency Additional Requirements 1–3 years of experience in Recruitment / Talent Acquisition / Candidate Sourcing. Strong practical experience in candidate hiring will be preferred. Experience using BDjobs and LinkedIn for recruitment is highly preferred. Excellent communication and convincing skills. Good telephone communication skills. Strong CV screening and candidate sourcing ability. Smart, confident and target-oriented. Good follow-up skills. Able to handle multiple vacancies and candidates at the same time. We are especially interested in candidates who have previous experience in: Recruitment | Talent Acquisition | Candidate Sourcing | BDjobs Recruitment | LinkedIn Recruitment | Mass Hiring | Interview Coordination Responsibilities & Context Department: Recruitment Office Time: 10.0 AM – 6:00 PM Job Overview SKYLINK AIRWAYS is looking for an experienced and target-oriented Talent Acquisition Specialist who will be responsible only for candidate recruitment and hiring. The selected candidate will focus on finding suitable candidates for the companys vacancies, conducting initial screening, arranging interviews and ensuring selected candidates join the company. Key Responsibilities Search and source candidates for available vacancies. Post job circulars on BDjobs, LinkedIn, Facebook and other recruitment platforms. Search suitable candidates through CV databases and online/offline/Field platforms. Review and shortlist CVs according to job requirements. Call candidates and conduct initial screening. Explain job responsibilities, salary and interview details to candidates. Schedule and coordinate candidate interviews. Maintain regular communication with candidates throughout the recruitment process. Follow up with selected candidates until their joining. Maintain a proper candidate database and recruitment tracker. Build and maintain a strong pipeline of potential candidates. Meet assigned monthly recruitment targets. Submit regular recruitment updates to management. The primary responsibility will be: Candidate Sourcing → CV Screening → Calling → Interview → Selection → Joining Recruitment Target The candidate will be responsible for achieving assigned monthly hiring targets and maintaining a continuous pipeline of suitable candidates. Responsibilities & Context
Department: Recruitment
Office Time: 10.0 AM – 6:00 PM
Job Overview
SKYLINK AIRWAYS is looking for an experienced and target-oriented Talent Acquisition Specialist who will be responsible only for candidate recruitment and hiring.
The selected candidate will focus on finding suitable candidates for the company`s vacancies, conducting initial screening, arranging interviews and ensuring selected candidates join the company.
Key Responsibilities
Search and source candidates for available vacancies.
Post job circulars on BDjobs, LinkedIn, Facebook and other recruitment platforms.
Search suitable candidates through CV databases and online/offline/Field platforms.
Review and shortlist CVs according to job requirements.
Call candidates and conduct initial screening.
Explain job responsibilities, salary and interview details to candidates.
Schedule and coordinate candidate interviews.
Maintain regular communication with candidates throughout the recruitment process.
Follow up with selected candidates until their joining.
Maintain a proper candidate database and recruitment tracker.
Build and maintain a strong pipeline of potential candidates.
Meet assigned monthly recruitment targets.
Submit regular recruitment updates to management.
The primary responsibility will be:
Candidate Sourcing → CV Screening → Calling → Interview → Selection → Joining
Recruitment Target
The candidate will be responsible for achieving assigned monthly hiring targets and maintaining a continuous pipeline of suitable candidates.
Other Relevant Skills
Compensation & Other Benefits
Salary: Negotiable based on experience and recruitment performance

Requirements Experience At least 2 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Business-to-Business (B2B) Software and Services Startup Additional Requirements Age At least 30 years Only Male Experience working with business owners, executives, government organisations, regulatory bodies, legal or compliance matters, or multiple businesses would be useful. We do not expect one person to already know everything. What matters is having broad knowledge, being able to understand new subjects quickly and knowing how to find the information or people needed to get something done. Requirements We are looking for someone who can think independently and deal with a wide range of work. You should have: Very good knowledge of Bangladesh A good understanding of business in Bangladesh Knowledge of Bangladeshi government departments, systems and administrative processes Knowledge or experience across several industries Good research and problem-solving skills Strong written and spoken Bangla and English Good organisation and attention to detail Confidence speaking with businesses, professionals and government organisations Good computer and internet research skills The ability to manage several matters at once Good judgement The ability to work without constant supervision The ability to learn about unfamiliar subjects quickly Discretion when dealing with private or commercially sensitive information Responsibilities & Context We are looking for an experienced and intelligent person to assist with the management of several businesses and projects. This role goes beyond the normal responsibilities of a Personal Assistant or secretary. There will be administrative work, but a large part of the job will involve dealing with business matters, researching issues, speaking with different organisations and helping resolve problems. You may be given a task or problem without detailed instructions and expected to work out how to handle it. This could involve researching the issue, finding the correct person or organisation to contact, making enquiries, following up and reporting back. A good understanding of Bangladesh is important. You should be familiar with the business environment, different industries, government departments, regulations and administrative processes. The Role You will sometimes be given an objective rather than step-by-step instructions. You will be expected to understand what needs to be done, research it where necessary, speak to the relevant people and follow the matter through. The work can vary significantly depending on what the businesses need at the time. You should be comfortable taking on work that may not fall under a typical secretary or Personal Assistant job description. We are looking for someone who can gradually take responsibility for more matters and become closely involved in the day-to-day running of several businesses. Location and Travel You may be based anywhere, provided you are reliable and available when required. Knowledge of Bangladesh is essential. You must also be willing to travel to Dhaka when necessary. Responsibilities Assist with several businesses and projects at the same time Manage meetings, correspondence, documents, appointments and deadlines Communicate with companies, executives, consultants, lawyers, government offices and other organisations Research companies, industries, regulations and government procedures Make enquiries and deal with government departments and other organisations when required Find the correct people or departments to contact regarding particular issues Follow up on applications, enquiries and outstanding matters Coordinate between businesses, employees and outside organisations Prepare reports and summaries when required Organise meetings, appointments and travel Keep track of important matters and make sure they are followed up Handle confidential business information and documents Help resolve problems as they arise Take on responsibilities outside normal PA work when required Travel to Dhaka for meetings or business matters when necessary Skills & Expertise Government Liaison Operation Project Management Other Relevant Skills Business Administration Operations Management Government Liaison Business Research Stakeholder Communication Compensation & Other Benefits Salary: The salary is ৳100,000 to ৳200,000 per month, depending on experience and ability. The exact amount will depend on your background, knowledge, experience and the level of responsibility you are able to handle. There is room for increased responsibility and progression for someone who performs well in the role. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Job Location Anywhere in Bangladesh
