You should have:
Responsibilities & Context
We are looking for an experienced and intelligent person to assist with the management of several businesses and projects.
This role goes beyond the normal responsibilities of a Personal Assistant or secretary. There will be administrative work, but a large part of the job will involve dealing with business matters, researching issues, speaking with different organisations and helping resolve problems.
You may be given a task or problem without detailed instructions and expected to work out how to handle it. This could involve researching the issue, finding the correct person or organisation to contact, making enquiries, following up and reporting back.
A good understanding of Bangladesh is important. You should be familiar with the business environment, different industries, government departments, regulations and administrative processes.
The Role
You will sometimes be given an objective rather than step-by-step instructions. You will be expected to understand what needs to be done, research it where necessary, speak to the relevant people and follow the matter through.
The work can vary significantly depending on what the businesses need at the time. You should be comfortable taking on work that may not fall under a typical secretary or Personal Assistant job description.
We are looking for someone who can gradually take responsibility for more matters and become closely involved in the day-to-day running of several businesses.
Location and Travel
You may be based anywhere, provided you are reliable and available when required.
Knowledge of Bangladesh is essential.
You must also be willing to travel to Dhaka when necessary.
Responsibilities
Assist with several businesses and projects at the same time
Manage meetings, correspondence, documents, appointments and deadlines
Communicate with companies, executives, consultants, lawyers, government offices and other organisations
Research companies, industries, regulations and government procedures
Make enquiries and deal with government departments and other organisations when required
Find the correct people or departments to contact regarding particular issues
Follow up on applications, enquiries and outstanding matters
Coordinate between businesses, employees and outside organisations
Prepare reports and summaries when required
Organise meetings, appointments and travel
Keep track of important matters and make sure they are followed up
Handle confidential business information and documents
Help resolve problems as they arise
Take on responsibilities outside normal PA work when required
Travel to Dhaka for meetings or business matters when necessary

Requirements Education BBA or MBA in Human Resource Management. Experience At least 2 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Hospital, Diagnostic Centre, Manpower Recruitment, Travel Agency, Group of Companies Additional Requirements Age At least 21 years Only Male Manage calendars, coordinate meeting & Prepare Meeting Minutes. English typing speed of at least 40 words per minute (WPM) and Bijoy Bangla typing speed of at least 30 WPM. Hands-on experience in Admin and HR. Have to expert at IT and modern software related knowledge. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Sound knowledge of HR policies, procedures, and the Bangladesh Labor Act & Labor Rules. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint) and HR-related software. Experience in CV sorting, screening, and shortlisting through BDJobs. Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously and perform effectively under pressure. Smart, energetic, self-motivated, and a strong team player with a positive attitude. Responsibilities & Context JSK Group , a rapidly expanding and diversified business conglomerate with interests in Hospital & Diagnostic Services, Passenger Transport, Capital Market Brokerage House, Sara Express and Overseas Recruitment & Training, is looking for a smart, dynamic, and energetic Executive-Admin & HR . The selected candidate will be responsible for handling Admin & HR operations, recruitment, employee relations, and HR documentation across multiple business units under JSK Group . Job Responsibilities: Answer phone calls, sort emails, and greet office visitors. Order office supplies and maintain office equipment. Process basic invoices, track expenses, and reconcile budgets. Handle end-to-end recruitment process — job posting, candidate sourcing, interviewing, and onboarding. Maintain accurate employee records, personal files, and attendance database. Support in payroll preparation, leave management, and benefits administration. Conduct orientation programs for new employees and ensure smooth joining formalities. Assist in performance appraisal and employee evaluation processes. Handle employee queries, grievances, and ensure a healthy work environment. Support HR audits, training programs, and compliance with labor laws and company policy. Coordinate with different units (Hospital, Diagnostic, Transport, Brokerage, Training Center) to fulfill manpower needs. Prepare periodic HR reports for management review. Skills & Expertise HR and Administration Compensation & Other Benefits As per company policy. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Job Location Dhaka (Motijheel)

Requirements Education Higher Secondary Educational Requirements : Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Computer Science, Information Technology, or any related discipline. Experience 2 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Software Company Additional Requirements Experience Requirements : Minimum 2-3 years of hands-on experience in Corporate Sales, IT Sales, Software Sales, ERP Sales, SaaS Sales, or Business Development. Experience in selling Accounting Software, ERP, HRM, CRM, Custom Software, or other IT solutions will be given preference. Candidates with an existing corporate client network will receive additional preference. Required Skills & Competencies Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills. Strong negotiation and relationship-building abilities. Ability to understand business requirements and recommend appropriate technology solutions. Sound knowledge of ERP, HRM, Accounting Software, CRM, Web Applications, Mobile Applications, and Custom Software concepts. Ability to work independently, manage time effectively, and achieve sales targets. Strong follow-up, reporting, and documentation skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and CRM software. Positive attitude, professional appearance, and willingness to travel for regular corporate client visits. Responsibilities & Context About F. A. Creative Firm Limited F. A. Creative Firm Limited is a growing Software Development and Digital Solutions Company committed to helping businesses accelerate their digital transformation through innovative and customized technology solutions. We specialize in developing enterprise software and business automation systems for organizations of all sizes. Our Core Solutions Accounting Software HRM & Payroll Software CRM Solutions ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) Custom Software Development Web Applications Android & iOS Mobile Applications Online Newspaper Management System ePaper Solutions Online TV & Media Platforms Domain, Hosting & Business Email Solutions We are looking for an experienced, energetic, self-motivated, and target-driven Field Executive (Sales & Business Development) to identify new business opportunities, build strong corporate relationships, and generate software sales. Job Responsibilities Visit corporate offices and business organizations to promote the company's software products and digital solutions. Identify new business opportunities through corporate visits, networking, referrals, and market research. Arrange and conduct professional meetings with prospective clients. Understand clients' business processes and identify opportunities for business automation. Present and demonstrate ERP, HRM, Payroll, Accounting, CRM, Custom Software, Mobile Applications, Web Applications, Online Newspaper, ePaper, Online TV, and other IT solutions. Gather business requirements and coordinate with the Technical Project Manager for solution planning, project estimation, and proposal preparation. Prepare quotations and proposals in collaboration with the internal technical team. Build and maintain long-term relationships with existing and prospective corporate clients. Follow up with prospects until successful project confirmation and deal closing. Maintain accurate CRM records, daily visit reports, and sales activity reports. Achieve monthly sales targets, client meeting targets, and lead generation goals. Coordinate with internal departments to ensure smooth project handover after project confirmation. Skills & Expertise Business Development Software Sales Compensation & Other Benefits Negotiable Salary Attractive Sales Commission Performance Bonus Mobile Bill Travel Allowance (Official Field Visits) Yearly Salary Review 2 Festival Bonuses (As per Company Policy) Professional Training & Continuous Skill Development Clear Career Growth Based on Performance Opportunity to Work with Enterprise Software, ERP & Digital Transformation Projects Friendly, Professional & Collaborative Working Environment Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Chattogram (Agrabad)

Requirements Education Bachelor of Science (BSc) Experience At least 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Computer Hardware/Network Companies, Garments, Multinational Companies, Software Company, Technical Infrastructure, Textile Additional Requirements Age 25 to 35 years IT end user support experience. Customer Service oriented. Effective communication with end users and colleagues in the IT area. Oriented to the fulfillment of policies, procedures as well as the follow-up of the assigned tasks. Experience as Service Desk, Helpdesk or Network Support. Experience in remote support of IT problems and escalation of incidents to other IT Areas. Experience in Service Desk Platforms (Service-Now or similar) Strong understanding of IT Networking services (Internet Services, DNS, TCP/IP, WAN LAN SERVICES). Responsibilities & Context The IT Support Sn Technician is responsible for providing advanced remote technical support to GILDAN users globally, focusing on complex and critical issues that require specialized knowledge and elevated access privileges. The Global position is responsible for the onboarding, testing, and deployment of new automation technologies across all regions, as well as the responsible of the administration of massive end-user accounts in different systems, and IT support tools that impacts users globally. With the Highest privileges on the systems will be responsible of the account administration. Major Responsibilities Oversee the management of software and tools required for the global administration of accounts, and ticketing systems across all regions. Ensure that solutions are standardized and scalable to meet global needs. Create and update documentation for known issues and solutions with a global audience in mind and provide training to Level 1 and Level 2 support teams worldwide to ensure consistent support practices across all locations. Identify and standardize IT lifecycle processes across all regions to ensure global consistency. Develop and maintain documentation for known issues and solutions with a global scope. Identify advanced automation technologies that are compatible with Gildan’s global operations and integrate them seamlessly into existing systems worldwide to optimize efficiency and scalability. Identify and address existing problems by analyzing patterns and behaviors in devices across all regions, conducting thorough root cause analysis of recurring issues to prevent future incidents and enhance system reliability on a global scale. Leverage the global ticketing database to predict upcoming issues and proactively reduce future problems worldwide, ensuring continuous improvement in IT support and system performance. Perform internal audits to Account management processes, deep technical expertise and forensic, with elevated access privileges. Guarantee the daily operation compliance and supervise any daily operations of account creation, audit creations, departures, and modifications, responsible for account management KPI compliance and participate and be responsible of any audit related to account management, assist in any continuous improvement for account management. Lead and participate in the planning, development, and execution of global IT support projects focused on enhancing IT services and infrastructure across all regions. Collaborate with cross-functional teams worldwide to implement new technologies, tools, and processes that boost the efficiency and capabilities of IT support on a global scale, ensuring consistency and alignment with Gildan’s global operations. raw_source_fields.age: At least 18 years What You Will Learn: Software product sales process Customer communication and support handling Telesales and follow-up process Social media inbox management CRM/lead management process Accounting/POS software সম্পর্কে practical ধারণা Real customer query handling Sales conversion process পরবর্তীতে performance অনুযায়ী Full-time job opportunity থাকবে । Responsibilities & Context Retina Soft একটি সফটওয়্যার ডেভেলপমেন্ট কোম্পানি। আমাদের অন্যতম প্রোডাক্ট Alhisab Accounting Software, যা ব্যবসায়ীদের Accounting, POS, Inventory এবং Business Management সহজ করতে সাহায্য করে। আমাদের Telesales & Customer Support টিমের জন্য কয়েকজন Intern নেওয়া হবে। নির্বাচিত প্রার্থীরা কাস্টমার কমিউনিকেশন, সফটওয়্যার ব্রিফিং, সোশ্যাল মিডিয়া ইনবক্স ম্যানেজমেন্ট, লিড ফলোআপ এবং কাস্টমার সাপোর্টের বাস্তব কাজ শেখার সুযোগ পাবে। Internship Duration: 4 Months Internship Responsibilities: আগত কাস্টমার কল রিসিভ করা এবং প্রাথমিকভাবে কাস্টমারের প্রয়োজন বোঝার চেষ্টা করা Facebook, Messenger, WhatsApp ও অন্যান্য সোশ্যাল প্ল্যাটফর্মে কাস্টমারের মেসেজের রিপ্লাই দেওয়া কাস্টমারকে Alhisab Accounting Software সম্পর্কে প্রাথমিক ধারণা দেওয়া কাস্টমারের প্রয়োজন অনুযায়ী সফটওয়্যারের ফিচার ও প্যাকেজ সম্পর্কে ব্রিফ করা নতুন লিড/ইনকোয়ারি ফলোআপ করা ডেমো বা সেলস কনফার্ম করার জন্য টিমকে সহযোগিতা করা কাস্টমারের সাধারণ প্রশ্ন ও সাপোর্ট কুয়েরি নোট করা প্রয়োজন হলে সিনিয়র/টেকনিক্যাল টিমের কাছে কাস্টমারের বিষয়টি ফরওয়ার্ড করা প্রতিদিনের কল, ফলোআপ ও কাস্টমার আপডেট CRM/Sheet-এ এন্ট্রি করা টিমের সাথে নিয়মিত রিপোর্টিং ও আপডেট শেয়ার করা Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Accounting CRM POS Software Social Media Management

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1543587&fc.title: Intern - Planning & Materials Management

raw_source_fields.education: Bachelor of Science (BSc) in Industrial & Production Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Electrical & Electronic Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or any other relevant field.
raw_source_fields.age: 22 to 28 years Basic understanding of Supply Chain Management (SCM), inventory control, and Material Requirements Planning (MRP) principles. General familiarity with manufacturing, warehousing, and procurement workflows. Fundamental understanding of data management and record-keeping. Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, with strong data analysis capabilities. Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate across departments. Effective time management, task prioritization, and attention to detail. A methodical approach to tracking material movement schedules. A proactive, adaptable, and solution-oriented mindset, with eagerness to learn in a fast-paced environment. Integrity, reliability, and accuracy in handling information. Basic leadership and interpersonal coordination capabilities. Responsibilities & Context Assist in monitoring raw material (RM) and packaging material (PM) inventory levels to prevent stockouts and excess inventory. Gather, organize, and analyze production planning and material consumption data for daily, weekly, and monthly reporting. Facilitate the receipt and issuance of raw materials, packaging materials, local materials, and project materials. Coordinate with procurement and user teams to track delivery schedules and incoming material receipts. Maintain accurate inventory records and material master data in SAP/ERP systems and Excel files. Participate in routine physical stock verification and inventory reconciliation audits. Support material requirements planning and continuous improvement initiatives across materials planning and supply chain workflows. Ensure the safe and secure storage of materials and maintain safety and quality standards during material loading, unloading, inspection, and issuance. Perform SAP/ERP operations related to planning and warehouse management. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Inventory Management Supply Chain Coordination Warehouse operations Stock Reconciliation

raw_source_fields.age: 20 to 40 years

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1543811&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education BBA/MBA in International Business, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Marketing or related discipline. Graduates/Postgraduates in English/EEE/CSE with strong business communication skills are also encouraged to apply. Additional Requirements Age 20 to 40 years Experience Requirements 1–5 years relevant experience in International Sourcing, Foreign Communication, Procurement, Import/Export, International Business or Supply Chain. Fresh graduates with excellent English communication and strong commercial aptitude may also be considered for Executive. Additional Requirements Excellent English communication and business correspondence skills. Strong negotiation and supplier relationship management skills. Good understanding of international sourcing, procurement and import processes. Ability to communicate confidently with Chinese and overseas suppliers. Good analytical and MS Excel skills. Proactive, organized and result-oriented. Preferred / Advantage Experience in industrial machinery, textile/garments machinery, printing/digital printing/sublimation machinery, spare parts, China sourcing, machinery trading/import or B2B business will be preferred. Responsibilities & Context Job Context Hasan Trade is a leading industrial machinery importer and solution provider in Bangladesh, serving the Textile, Garments, Printing, Signage, Packaging, Manufacturing and related industries. We are looking for a dynamic, commercially minded and result-oriented professional to manage international sourcing and supplier coordination while supporting new product sourcing, market development and business growth initiatives. Key Responsibilities International Sourcing & Supplier Development Identify and develop overseas manufacturers, suppliers and potential business partners, particularly from China. Source industrial machinery, spare parts, printing equipment, inks, consumables and related products based on market and customer requirements. Communicate with overseas suppliers regarding product specifications, pricing, MOQ, lead time, payment terms and commercial matters. Evaluate and compare suppliers/products and negotiate competitive pricing and favorable terms. Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and potential overseas suppliers. Procurement & Import Coordination Coordinate procurement activities from requirement identification to order confirmation and shipment. Follow up PI, purchase orders, production, inspection, packing and shipment with overseas suppliers. Coordinate LC/TT payment and commercial/shipping documentation with Finance, Commercial and Logistics teams. Monitor shipment schedules and maintain proper supplier, order and shipment records. Business Development & Market Expansion Conduct market research to identify new products, technologies, brands and business opportunities. Explore potential international brands/manufacturers for new partnerships and product representation. Identify products and solutions with potential for introduction and expansion in Bangladesh. Support Sales & Marketing with product information, supplier capabilities, pricing and market intelligence. Assist Management in evaluating new products, brands and business opportunities. Cross-functional Coordination Coordinate with Sales & Marketing, Commercial, Logistics and Service teams for smooth business execution. Coordinate product-related technical queries, spare parts and after-sales requirements with overseas suppliers and the Service Department. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills International Sourcing Supply Chain Management Compensation & Other Benefits Attractive salary package (Negotiable based on experience and competency) Mobile allowance Festival bonuses Other benefits as per company policy & Practice Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka (Purana Paltan)

About MO’S Detailing
MO’S Detailing is a professional automotive detailing studio specializing in premium car care services, including Paint Protection Film (PPF), ceramic coating, paint correction, interior deep cleaning, and professional car washing. We are looking for a responsible, organized, and energetic individual to manage our accounts, daily studio operations, customer coordination, and social media presentation.
Key Responsibilities
Studio & Operations Management
Supervise daily studio operations and ensure smooth workflow.
Monitor staff attendance, punctuality, productivity, and discipline.
Coordinate job allocation and service delivery.
Ensure quality standards are maintained for all detailing services.
Monitor cleanliness, equipment handling, and overall studio presentation.
Manage customer appointments, service updates, complaints, and feedback.
Coordinate with suppliers and ensure essential products are available.
Customer Service & Sales Coordination
Welcome customers and explain available detailing services.
Assist customers in selecting suitable PPF, ceramic coating, paint correction, and interior care packages.
Prepare quotations, service orders, and customer invoices.
Follow up with customers and maintain customer records.
Support sales growth through professional communication and service recommendations.
Social Media & On-Camera Presentation
Confidently appear in videos, reels, and promotional content for MO’S Detailing.
Explain detailing services, products, and procedures in a clear and engaging manner.
Participate in educational videos, service demonstrations, and promotional campaigns.
Coordinate with the content creation team for filming and social media activities.
Help build customer trust and strengthen the brand’s online presence.
Other Relevant Skills
Compensation & Other Benefits
Competitive, negotiable salary. Opportunity to grow with a premium automotive detailing brand. Professional working environment. Opportunities to develop skills in business operations, automotive care, sales, and digital content creation.

Strong knowledge of local accessories raw materials, market pricing, and technical specifications.

Responsibilities & Context
We are seeking an energetic, analytical, and performance-driven SCM professional to manage end-to-end local procurement and import supply chain operations for our Garments Accessories manufacturing facility. The role involves material requirement planning, local/foreign vendor negotiation, import LC coordination, and inventory control to maintain seamless factory production.
1. Local Sourcing & Procurement Management:
Review and verify Local PRs based on technical specifications, stock positions, and required delivery dates.
Collect quotations, prepare Comparative Statements (CS), and negotiate price, quality, MOQ, lead time, and payment terms.
Issue POs/Work Orders and actively track delivery to achieve On-Time Delivery (OTD).
Handle local vendor claims, short supplies, rejections, replacements, and payment documentation.
2. Import Sourcing, LC & Commercial Coordination:
Manage import procurement activities from requirement planning to final receipt at the factory warehouse.
Maintain an Import Procurement Priority Plan based on production demand, Days on Hand (DOH), and lead times.
Coordinate PO/PI processing, Back-to-Back LC opening/amendments, shipment bookings, ETD/ETA tracking, and port arrivals.
Work closely with Commercial and Finance teams to ensure proper utilization of Bond facilities and entitlement allocations.
3. Cross-Functional Coordination & Inventory Control:
Coordinate with Planning, Production, Stores, QA, Maintenance, Accounts, and Commercial teams to align material arrivals with production schedules.
Monitor minimum/maximum stock levels, consumption rates, and pipeline stock to prevent stockouts or over-inventory.
Oversee material receiving, inspection clearance, and quantity verification with QA and Store departments.
4. MIS Reporting & Record Keeping:
Prepare and present daily, weekly, and monthly SCM reports (Pending PRs, Open POs/LCs, Shipment Trackers, and Risk Assessments).
Maintain accurate vendor databases, PR/PO histories, and procurement documentation in ERP.

Excellent oral and written communication skills in English and Bangla. Strong computer proficiency, especially in MS Office Packages (Excel, Word, PowerPoint). Interpersonal skills to perform adequately in a team environment and with partner organizations. Responsibilities & Context Project: Access to Safe Drinking Water for Climate-Vulnerable Coastal Communities through Solar-Generated RO Water Treatment Facilities (Safe Water Project) Location: Khulna & Satkhira (as assigned by PO) with 50% travelling to remote areas. Reports to: Focal Person of Organizations Duration: One year (Renewable based on performance and project timeline). BACKGROUND Bangladesh is recognized as one of the country’s most vulnerable to the impacts of climate change. The Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC) has identified the coastal region as one of the major climate hotspot areas due to increasing salinity intrusion, sea-level rise, cyclones, storm surges, tidal flooding, and coastal erosion. These climate-induced hazards have significantly affected the livelihoods, health, and living conditions of coastal communities. Among the most critical challenges is the scarcity of safe drinking water, as freshwater sources are increasingly becoming saline and unsuitable for human consumption. The experience of Satkhira Unnayan Sangstha (SUS) indicates that climate-vulnerable coastal communities continue to face severe difficulties in accessing safe and reliable drinking water. Salinity intrusion into both surface and groundwater sources, coupled with the impacts of recurrent cyclones and tidal surges, has substantially reduced the availability of potable water. As a result, people—particularly women and children—are compelled to travel long distances to collect drinking water, exposing them to health risks, economic hardship, and reduced productivity. Limited access to safe drinking water also contributes to waterborne diseases and undermines the resilience of vulnerable households. Under these circumstances, to improve access to safe drinking water and strengthen the climate resilience of vulnerable coastal communities in the selected upazilas of Khulna and Satkhira districts, Satkhira Unnayan Sangstha (SUS) will implement the project titled “Access to Safe Drinking Water for the Climate Vulnerable People in Coastal Areas of Bangladesh through Solar-generated Reverse Osmosis Water Treatment Facilities.” The project will be financed by the Adaptation Fund (AF) through Palli Karma-Sahayak Foundation (PKSF) and will be implemented over a period of two years. The specific objectives of the project are: Ensure access to safe and climate-resilient drinking water for vulnerable coastal communities through the installation and operation of Reverse Osmosis (RO) water treatment plants. Enhance awareness and knowledge of climate-vulnerable communities on safe drinking water, health, hygiene, and climate change adaptation practices. Hence, Satkhira Unnayan Sangstha (SUS) is seeking qualified candidates for the post of " OFFICER (Accounts and Procurement)" to implement the project and provide overall technical support for the successful implementation of the project activities. BACKGROUD OF THE PROJECT Bangladesh is one of the countries, most vulnerable to the adverse impacts of climate change. Coastal communities are particularly exposed to sea-level rise, cyclones, storm surges, salinity intrusion, riverbank erosion, waterlogging, and irregular rainfall. These climate-related hazards have severely affected surface water and groundwater sources, creating an acute shortage of safe drinking water and increasing risks to the health, livelihoods, and overall well-being of coastal populations. To address this challenge, Palli Karma-Sahayak Foundation (PKSF), with financial support from the Adaptation Fund under the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC), is implementing the three-year project titled “Access to Safe Drinking Water for the Climate Vulnerable People in Coastal Areas of Bangladesh through Solar-generated Reverse Osmosis (RO) Water Treatment Facilities.” Under the project, a total of 180 Reverse Osmosis water treatment plants will be installed in selected climate-vulnerable areas of Khulna, Satkhira, and Bagerhat districts to improve access to safe and climate-resilient drinking water. The project is being implemented through Operating Entities (OEs) selected by PKSF. Its major activities include the procurement, installation, commissioning, operation, and maintenance of RO water treatment plants; establishment of three (03) Knowledge Hub; procurement and use of water-testing kits; and capacity-building of beneficiaries, local technicians, and relevant stakeholders. The project also includes awareness-raising activities on safe water management, water quality, hygiene, and public health. OBJECTIVE OF THE ASSIGNMENT The Officer acts as the Financial Lead at the Satkhira Unnayan Sangstha (SUS) level to ensure transparent, compliant, and efficient financial management of the sub-project. The role focuses on maintaining accurate books of accounts, managing fund flows, preparing budgets, financial reports, and reimbursement application ensuring strict adherence to PKSF and donor financial policies. The position serves as the primary financial liaison between the PO and the PKSF’s Project Management Unit (PMU) of Safe water Project (SWP) for all accounting and reporting matters. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES The Officer will be responsible for the following duties: Maintain separate books of accounts for the sub-project on an accrual basis under the historical cost convention, following the accounting manual of PKSF, International Accounting Standards (IAS) and International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS). Operate and maintain a computerized accounting system to record all financial transactions of the sub-project accurately and promptly. Prepare and submit monthly financial report and six-monthly reimbursement report according to the PKSF’s Project Management Unit (PMU) of Safe water Project (SWP) financial guideline and template. Support the preparation of annual, half-yearly, and quarterly budgets for the sub-project, aligning with procurement plans and work plans. Monitor the flow of funds from the Project to the sub-project and ensure smooth disbursement of funds to vendors, contractors, and for operational expenses in accordance with approved budgets. Prepare and submit annual financial statements incorporating disclosure on income and expenditure, receipts and payments, and the financial position of the sub-project, along with relevant notes and information. Ensure adequate internal controls are in place for the proper utilization, management, and accounting of funds at the sub-project level. Prepare monthly bank reconciliation statements for sub-project bank accounts. Prepare and review all sub-project budgets, reimbursement bills, and financial claims from partners/vendors before submission to the PMU. Assist in the preparation of cost proposals for new activities, training, and other project-related events. Ensure that shared cost amounts are correctly budgeted in each proposal for sub-project activities. Coordinate with PKSF’s PMU of SWP accounts and internal audit department of PO’s by providing necessary information and documentation for audits. Support external auditors with required information, records, and documentation for project/sub-project audits. Review external and internal audit reports, along with management letters, and assist in implementing audit recommendations. Provide advice and monitoring support to project and PO’s staff on the efficient operation of sub-project bank accounts and fund utilization. Ensure compliance with all PKSF’s PMU of SWP financial, accounting and procurement policies, procedures and donor requirements. Work in coordination with the PKSF’s Project Management Unit (PMU) of Safe Water Project (SWP) for financial validation, reporting, and quality assurance. Assist to prepare tender documents and evaluation procedure of RO plant installation and construction according to PPR 2025. Frequent field visit to monitor the RO Plant. Any other task which is assign by (name of the partner organization), PKSF and Donor. Compensation & Other Benefits Remuneration: Monthly consolidated BDT 40,000 (inclusive of taxes) + other admissible benefits. Employment Status Contractual Job Location Khulna, Satkhira

Performance-based incentive. Transportation Allowance and mobile bill as per company policy. Lunch and dinner as per company policy Two Festival bonuses, medical Allowance. Responsibilities & Context Job Purpose: The Officer – Admin is responsible for ensuring smooth and efficient administrative operations across the organization. This role focuses on managing office facilities, coordinating vendor services, maintaining company assets, and implementing effective administrative processes to support business operations. The position ensures that workplace systems are well-organized, efficient, and aligned with company standards. By coordinating with internal departments and external service providers, the Officer – Admin supports operational efficiency, effective resource use, and a safe, clean, and productive work environment. The role also supports continuous improvement in workplace management and administrative control to enhance the overall employee experience and contribute to organizational objectives. Key Responsibilities Oversee daily administrative activities to ensure smooth and efficient office operations. Monitor office supplies and inventory, ensuring timely procurement and adequate stock availability. Coordinate with external vendors and service providers for office maintenance, repairs, and other essential services. Maintain accurate records of company assets, office equipment, inventory, and administrative documentation. Provide administrative support to internal departments, including correspondence, scheduling, documentation, and other operational requirements. Ensure the office environment remains clean, safe, organized, and fully functional in accordance with company standards. Support the implementation of administrative policies, procedures, and process improvements to enhance workflow efficiency. Monitor the proper use, maintenance, and preservation of company assets and administrative resources. Serve as a key point of contact for internal departments and external stakeholders regarding administrative matters, ensuring effective communication and coordination. Identify administrative needs and operational challenges and recommend practical solutions to improve workplace efficiency and service quality. The incumbent will be responsible for end-to-end supply chain operations, including local and international sourcing, procurement, inventory management, warehousing, logistics, and supplier relationship management. The role will act as the second-in-command of the department and ensure smooth business operations in the absence of the department head. Coordinate import procurement activities, including purchase orders, shipping schedules, Incoterms, freight forwarding, customs clearance, and documentation. Ensure timely procurement of materials while optimizing cost, quality, and lead time. Manage inventory planning, warehouse operations, and stock control to minimize shortages and excess inventory. Oversee inbound and outbound logistics and transportation activities. Collaborate with Production, Commercial, Finance, Quality, and Engineering departments to meet operational requirements. Monitor supply chain KPIs and prepare analytical reports for management. Ensure compliance with procurement policies, regulatory requirements, and company procedures. Lead, mentor, and develop the Supply Chain team. Perform the responsibilities of the Head of Supply Chain Management in their absence. Requirements Education Bachelor’s Degree from Recognized University in Management / HRM / Public Administration Experience 2 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Architecture Firm, Engineering Firms, HVAC System, Interior Design Additional Requirements Only Male 2–3 years of similar professional experience. raw_source_fields.age: 25 to 45 years Responsibilities & Context চাকরির দায়িত্বসমূহ: কোম্পানির বিক্রয় বৃদ্ধি ও ব্যবসায়িক উন্নয়নের লক্ষ্যে মার্চেন্ডাইজিং কৌশল প্রণয়ন ও বাস্তবায়ন করা। পণ্য সংগ্রহ, সরবরাহকারীদের সঙ্গে সম্পর্ক বজায় রাখা, মূল্য নির্ধারণ, ক্রয় এবং পণ্যের পর্যাপ্ত মজুত নিশ্চিত করা। পণ্যের বৈচিত্র্য, মজুতের পরিমাণ, বিক্রয় কার্যক্রম এবং বাজারের চাহিদা পর্যবেক্ষণ করা। বিভিন্ন আউটলেট বা বিভাগে সময়মতো পণ্য ক্রয় ও সরবরাহ নিশ্চিত করা। প্রতিযোগিতামূলক মূল্য, উন্নত মানের পণ্য এবং অনুকূল ব্যবসায়িক শর্ত নিশ্চিত করতে সরবরাহকারীদের সঙ্গে আলোচনা ও দর-কষাকষি করা। বিক্রয়, ক্রয়, মজুত ব্যবস্থাপনা এবং স্টোর পরিচালনা বিভাগের সঙ্গে সমন্বয় করে কাজ করা। লাভজনকতা বৃদ্ধির জন্য নতুন পণ্য, সরবরাহকারী এবং বাজারের সুযোগ চিহ্নিত করা। পণ্যের গুণগত মান বজায় রাখা এবং সঠিক মার্চেন্ডাইজিং কার্যক্রম নিশ্চিত করা। বিক্রয়, পণ্য মজুত, ক্রয় এবং বিভাগের কার্যক্রমের ওপর নিয়মিত প্রতিবেদন তৈরি করা। শিক্ষাগত যোগ্যতা: ন্যূনতম এইচএসসি (HSC) পাস। অভিজ্ঞতা: মার্চেন্ডাইজিং, রিটেইল ম্যানেজমেন্ট, সুপারশপ পরিচালনা, পণ্য ক্রয় অথবা সংশ্লিষ্ট ক্ষেত্রে ন্যূনতম ২ বছরের বাস্তব অভিজ্ঞতা থাকতে হবে।

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1544098&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Master of Commerce (M.Com) in Accounting Experience At least 2 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): NGO Additional Requirements Age 25 to 35 years Minimum 2 years of accounting experience, preferably in an NGO or development organization. The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): NGO & Micro finance Knowledge of accounting software (Tally) Strong knowledge of financial management and reporting. Responsibilities & Context Job Context The accounts officer is responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, processing financial transactions, ensuring compliance with organizational policies and donor requirements, and supporting effective financial management of the NGO. The position plays a key role in budgeting, reporting and safeguarding organizational resources. Key Responsibilities Financial Management Maintain accurate accounting records and financial documentation. Record daily financial transactions in the accounting system. Prepare vouchers, journal entries and ledger reconciliations. Monitor cash and bank balances and maintain cash books. Payments and Receipts Process payments to vendors, staff and beneficiaries. Verify invoices, bills and supporting documents before payment. Prepare check, bank transfer request, and and payment vouchers. Record and reconcile all receipts and payments. Budget Monitoring Assist in preparing annual budgets and project budgets. Track project expenditures against approved budgets. Report any budget variances to management. Financial Reporting Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports. Assist in donor financial reporting and compliance requirements. Support financial analysis and management reporting. Banking and Reconciliation Conduct monthly bank reconciliations. Maintain relationships with banks and financial institutions. Ensure proper filing of bank statements and transaction records. Audit and Compliance Assist internal and external auditors during audits. Ensure compliance with NGO policies, donor regulations, and local laws. Maintain proper filing and documentation for audit purposes. Asset and Inventory Management Support maintenance of fixed asset registers. Assist in periodic inventory verification and reporting. Compensation & Other Benefits Salary: As per organizational policy and experience. Other benefits as applicable under NGO policies. Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka, Manikganj
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1544271&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelors in Finance/Accounting from a reputed public/private university with a minimum CGPA of 3.00. Must possess CA (CC) from a reputed Chartered Accountancy firm. Candidates with CA Certificate level examinations will be given preference. Experience At least 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Pharmaceutical/Medicine Companies Additional Requirements At least 3 years of professional experience in Finance & Accounts. Job requirements may be relaxed for highly deserving candidates. Responsibilities & Context BEACON GROUP is one of the fastest growing conglomerates in Bangladesh. After the success in local market, Beacon is the most popular Bangladeshi company in global market for its high quality products. To support and strengthen our existing team, we are currently looking for a smart, energetic, & committed individuals. Key Responsibilities Maintain accurate books of accounts and record all financial transactions in accordance with applicable accounting standards. Prepare monthly, quarterly and annual financial statements, including Statement of Financial Position, Profit or Loss, Cash Flow Statement and Changes in Equity. Prepare annual budgets, monitor actual performance against budget and investigate significant variances. Monitor cash balances, bank accounts, fund requirements and ensure adequate liquidity for business operations. Perform bank reconciliations and resolve outstanding or unusual transactions. Verify supplier invoices, process payments and maintain accurate records of trade and other payables. Maintain the fixed asset register, calculate depreciation, monitor additions/disposals and conduct periodic verification. Review payroll-related accounting entries, employee benefits, deductions and statutory payments. Any other tasks assigned by management time to time. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Budgeting and Forecasting Cash Flow Management Financial accounting Financial Analysis Financial Statement Fixed Asset Management Payroll Processing Compensation & Other Benefits Attractive remuneration package with excellent career growth opportunities. Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

Responsibilities & Context
CSS is a humanitarian and socio-economic development organization that has been operating in Bangladesh since 1972. Within the Health Sector, CSS manages the Reverend Abdul Wadud Memorial Hospital (RAWMH), a 100-bed general hospital located in Tilok, Rupsha, Khulna. We are looking for an experienced “Administrator” who will be responsible for ensuring the smooth execution of all administrative tasks at Reverend Abdul Wadud Memorial Hospital.
Job Responsibilities:
Monitor the duties of nurses, including their duty rosters prepared by the Matron.
Monitor the activities of security guards and ensure they have a proper understanding of their responsibilities.
Ensure cleanliness inside the hospital as well as within the hospital campus, including the proper incineration of waste at regular intervals, safe disposal of ashes, and conducting periodic rounds of all hospital facilities. In case of any discrepancies or irregularities, take necessary actions in consultation with the supervisor.
Ensure the maintenance of staff files by the responsible staff, including leave approvals, updating of the leave register, preparing and submitting leave reports to the head office, tracking staff records related to probation and performance, and timely dispatching of information to the head office.
Maintain appropriate and adequate inventory of all medical and non-medical goods in the central store to ensure smooth service delivery at all hospital stations, by ensuring proper storekeeping through maintenance of stock registers, ledgers, and BIN cards by the Store In-Charge.
Ensure that the six-monthly physical inventory report is prepared and maintained in the central store.
Ensure proper maintenance of the hospital building and staff quarters.
Supervise and ensure the proper functioning of the kitchen and laundry, the hygienic preparation of food, and the overall cleanliness of these areas, and resolve issues as needed.
Supervise internal management by providing motivation and guidance to staff.
Guide drivers in the maintenance of vehicles and ensure that all necessary documents are properly maintained.
Carry out any other tasks assigned by the supervisor/higher authorities.
Other Relevant Skills
Compensation & Other Benefits
After being permanent upon successful completion of the probation period (six months), other benefits will be provided as per the organizational policy i.e., provident fund, gratuity, festival bonus, yearly increment, staff insurance (kormi Bima), medical allowance (Kormi Sohayota Tohobil) etc.

Please write the name of the position on the envelope and also mention the mobile number on your CV. Only short-listed applicants will be called for an interview. Requirements Education Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Economics, Statistics, or a related discipline. Experience At least 2 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Group of Companies, IT Enabled Service Additional Requirements Key Qualifications: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to convert data and research into practical business recommendations. Strong understanding of market research, competitor analysis, customer behavior, and business fundamentals. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets; knowledge of dashboards and reporting tools is an advantage. Practical knowledge of AI tools for research, analysis, reporting, and productivity. Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and coordination skills. Ability to prepare professional business reports, presentations, proposals, and analysis. Strong commercial awareness with the ability to identify business opportunities and understand their potential impact. Experience Requirements: 2+ years of relevant experience in Business Development, Market Research, Business Analysis, Sales, or related areas is preferred. Responsibilities & Context We are looking for a proactive and analytical Executive, Business Development (Digital Commerce and AI) to identify new business opportunities, support growth initiatives, and drive commercial performance. The role will focus on market research, business analysis, opportunity identification, partnership development, and cross-functional execution. Key Responsibilities: Research market trends, customer preferences, competitor activities, industry developments, and emerging business opportunities. Analyze sales, customer, product, and market data to identify growth opportunities and performance gaps. Identify and recommend new products, markets, customer segments, partnerships, and business initiatives. Generate and evaluate potential business leads, partnerships, and growth opportunities. Use AI tools and platforms to accelerate market research, competitor analysis, data analysis, business intelligence, content preparation, and reporting. Identify opportunities to apply AI and automation to improve business processes, customer experience, digital commerce operations, and team productivity. Evaluate emerging AI technologies, tools, and business use cases and recommend practical applications for the organization. Support the development of business proposals, presentations, business cases, and partnership plans. Conduct market and competitor analysis to support business decisions and strategic initiatives. Monitor key business and growth metrics, including revenue, customer acquisition, conversion, customer retention, and campaign performance. Prepare regular reports and dashboards highlighting business performance, key findings, opportunities, and recommended actions. Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, E-commerce, Product, Finance, and other relevant teams to execute business development initiatives. Coordinate with internal teams and external partners to support partnership and business development activities. Evaluate the effectiveness of business and growth initiatives and recommend improvements. Maintain business development action plans and follow up with relevant teams to ensure timely execution. Verify the accuracy and reliability of business data, reports, research findings, and analysis. Monitor emerging technologies, consumer behavior, and market developments and assess their potential business impact. Support process and workflow improvements to improve business development efficiency and execution. Perform other business development and analytical tasks assigned by management. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Business Development Market Research Business Analysis Competitor Analysis Market trend analysis Artificial intelligence (AI) Compensation & Other Benefits Festival Bonuses Competitive Salary Yearly Salary Review Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka (Gulshan)

Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Diploma Graduate/Bachelor’s degree in any discipline (Business Administration, English, or related fields preferred). Experience At most 3 years Freshers are also encouraged to apply. Additional Requirements Age At least 20 years Experience: 0 to 3 years of experience in executive assistance, secretarial work, or general administration. Fresh graduates with excellent communication skills and a strong desire to learn are highly encouraged to apply. Language Proficiency: Fluent in both written and spoken English and Bengali (Essential). Knowledge of Japanese language (JLPT N5/N4 or basic conversation) or previous experience working with Japanese expatriates is a strong plus, but not mandatory. Technical Skills: Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and communication tools (Zoom, WhatsApp, Email). Soft Skills: High level of integrity, trust, and confidentiality. Strong interpersonal skills with a polite, helpful, and professional attitude. Adaptable, self-motivated, and comfortable working in a dynamic startup/pre-launch environment. Working Hours: 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM (Saturday to Thursday) Workplace & Transition Plan: Phase 1 (Immediate to December 2026): Flexible hybrid model (Work from Home with regular meetings/desk-work at the temporary office/expatriate residence in Bashundhara R/A, Dhaka). Phase 2 (From January 2027): Relocation to our brand-new factory office at the Bangladesh Special Economic Zone (BSEZ) in Araihazar. Transportation support or allowance will be discussed and provided upon transition. Responsibilities & Context We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and reliable Executive Assistant & Admin Officer to join our team for the exciting launch of Bengal IRIS Takumi Ltd. (a subsidiary of IRIS Co., Ltd., Japan). In this role, you will work closely with our Japanese Managing Director, providing critical secretarial, administrative, and logistical support to ensure smooth daily operations during our pre-launch and transition phases. Key Responsibilities: Executive Support: Assist the Managing Director with daily scheduling, managing calendar appointments, and preparing for business meetings. Translation & Communication: Act as a bridge between the Managing Director (limited English/no Bengali) and local vendors, government authorities, and business partners. Help draft official letters, emails, and documents in both English and Bengali. General Administration & Office Operations: Handle general administrative tasks, bookkeeping support, expense management, and coordination with the local legal/tax advisers. Logistic Coordination: Arrange travel, transportation, and accommodation for business trips. Manage the procurement of office supplies and IT equipment (laptops, etc., which will be provided by the company). Temporary Hybrid Work Management: Support daily operations smoothly under a flexible/hybrid working model (remote work and meetings at designated residential/temporary office spaces in Bashundhara R/A, Dhaka ) before transitioning to our new factory office in the Bangladesh Special Economic Zone (BSEZ) in January 2027 . Skills & Expertise Business Communication communication and teamwork skills English Japanese Culture Japanese Language Schedule and Detail Oriented Typing Skill - Bengali and English Other Relevant Skills Administration Management Japanese Language Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka, Narayanganj
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

Responsibilities & Context
We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and reliable Executive Assistant & Admin Officer to join our team for the exciting launch of Bengal IRIS Takumi Ltd. (a subsidiary of IRIS Co., Ltd., Japan).
In this role, you will work closely with our Japanese Managing Director, providing critical secretarial, administrative, and logistical support to ensure smooth daily operations during our pre-launch and transition phases.
Key Responsibilities:
Executive Support: Assist the Managing Director with daily scheduling, managing calendar appointments, and preparing for business meetings.
Translation & Communication: Act as a bridge between the Managing Director (limited English/no Bengali) and local vendors, government authorities, and business partners. Help draft official letters, emails, and documents in both English and Bengali.
General Administration & Office Operations: Handle general administrative tasks, bookkeeping support, expense management, and coordination with the local legal/tax advisers.
Logistic Coordination: Arrange travel, transportation, and accommodation for business trips. Manage the procurement of office supplies and IT equipment (laptops, etc., which will be provided by the company).
Temporary Hybrid Work Management: Support daily operations smoothly under a flexible/hybrid working model (remote work and meetings at designated residential/temporary office spaces in Bashundhara R/A, Dhaka) before transitioning to our new factory office in the Bangladesh Special Economic Zone (BSEZ) in January 2027.

Full Time

raw_source_fields.education: Masters in Accounting/Finance from a reputed university Professional qualification on Supply Chain Management Background of Civil Engineering or Apparel Merchandising are encouraged to apply Relevant Certifications in Supply Chain Management are advantageous.

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1544741&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Masters in Accounting/Finance from a reputed university Professional qualification on Supply Chain Management Background of Civil Engineering or Apparel Merchandising are encouraged to apply Relevant Certifications in Supply Chain Management are advantageous. Experience At least 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Supply Chain Additional Requirements Key Qualifications: Good knowledge of local and international procurement processes. Understanding of commercial operations, import/shipment documentation, and inventory management. Strong negotiation, analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills. Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel. Strong attention to detail, follow-up, and coordination skills. Experience Requirements: 3+ years of relevant experience in Procurement, Commercial, Supply Chain, or related fields. Experience in LC, import, international procurement, or commercial operations will be preferred. Fresh graduates with strong potential may also be considered. Responsibilities & Context We are looking for a capable Sr. Executive, Procurement & Commercial to manage and support local and international procurement and commercial activities. The role will coordinate with suppliers, process procurement and commercial documentation, follow up on orders and shipments, and coordinate invoices and payments. The position will work closely with internal departments to ensure timely procurement, smooth material flow, and effective resolution of supplier and commercial issues. Key Responsibilities: Source and coordinate with local and international suppliers to ensure competitive pricing, quality, and timely delivery. Collect and evaluate quotations, prepare comparative statements, negotiate prices, and support procurement decisions. Prepare and process Purchase Orders (PO), Work Orders (WO), and other procurement documents. Follow up on purchase orders, production, deliveries, shipments, and supplier commitments. Coordinate local and international procurement, including import, shipment, and commercial documentation. Coordinate LC opening, amendments, and related documentation with suppliers and Finance/Banking teams. Follow up on LC terms, shipment schedules, shipping documents, and supplier commitments. Coordinate with Merchandising, Finance, Logistics, Stores, and other departments for smooth procurement and material flow. Verify supplier invoices, bills, and supporting documents and coordinate payment processing with Finance. Maintain supplier records, procurement data, LC status, order/shipment status, and related reports. Monitor supplier performance and coordinate resolution of delivery, quality, pricing, and commercial issues. Support cost-saving initiatives through negotiation, alternative sourcing, and supplier comparison. Coordinate with Stores and relevant departments to ensure timely availability of required materials. Support inventory planning by monitoring procurement status and material requirements. Ensure procurement and commercial activities comply with company policies, approved procedures, and applicable requirements. Maintain professional relationships with suppliers and support supplier development. Prepare regular procurement and commercial reports for management. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Supply Chain Management Purchase/ Procurement Export Import Through LC International Procurement Commercial Compensation & Other Benefits Festival Bonuses Competitive Salary Yearly Salary Review Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka (Gulshan)

raw_source_fields.experience: in sales, marketing, customer service, or the automobile industry will be an added advantage. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Strong customer handling and negotiation abilities. Ability to build and maintain positive customer relationships. Basic knowledge of sales and marketing techniques. Proficiency in using smartphones, email, WhatsApp, and social media platforms. Self-motivated, target-oriented, and capable of working in a team. Willingness to learn about vehicle models, packages, features, and specifications. Responsibilities & Context Job Context: We are looking for motivated, creative, and results-driven Marketing & Sales Officer to drive sales growth and strengthen our business presence. The selected candidates will be responsible for customer handling, lead generation, vehicle sales, customer relationship management, and supporting marketing activities Sanzida Car Selection Ltd. is looking for enthusiastic and target-oriented Sales & Marketing Officers to support its vehicle sales and marketing operations. The ideal candidates should be capable of handling customers professionally, identifying potential buyers, generating sales leads, achieving sales targets, and maintaining strong customer relationships. Job Responsibilities Customer Handling: Welcome customers, understand their needs, and provide professional assistance. Product Knowledge: Clearly explain vehicle features, specifications, packages, benefits, and pricing to customers. Sales Generation: Identify potential customers, generate sales leads, and achieve monthly sales targets. Customer Follow-Up: Maintain regular communication with prospective customers through phone calls, WhatsApp, email, and social media. Product Demonstration: Present vehicles to customers and explain their features, specifications, and functionality. Negotiation & Sales Closing: Negotiate prices, address customer questions and objections, and convert potential customers into buyers. Lead Management: Maintain customer databases, record inquiries, and monitor sales progress. Marketing Support: Assist with vehicle promotions, advertising campaigns, and other sales and marketing activities. Documentation: Prepare quotations, sales orders, invoices, and other necessary documents. Customer Relationship Management: Build long-term relationships with customers and encourage repeat business and customer referrals. Sales Reporting: Prepare and submit daily, weekly, and monthly sales reports to management. After-Sales Service: Follow up with customers after purchases and assist in resolving complaints or service-related issues. Communication with Prospective Car Buyers: Maintain regular communication with potential car buyers, provide vehicle information according to their interests and requirements, and follow up effectively to close sales. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Business Negotiation Prepare Quotation Campaign Management Lead Generation Customer Service

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1544251&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Masters of Professional Human Resource Management (MPHRM) Postgraduate degree in any discipline, preferably in Human Resource Management (HRM), from a recognized university. Candidates holding a PGDHRM or equivalent professional qualification will be given preference. Experience At least 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): NGO Additional Requirements Age 30 to 45 years Age: Minimum 30 years and maximum 45 years as of 30 September 2026. At least 3 years of relevant professional experience in Human Resource Management preferably in the NGO/INGO sector. Practical experience in using Human Resource Information Systems (HRIS), HRM software, or other digital HR platforms. Proven experience in HR management, with a sound understanding of national and international HRM practices and standards. Sound knowledge of Bangladesh Labour Law, applicable rules and regulations, HR policies, and organizational compliance requirements. Strong report writing, analytical, interpersonal, and communication skills. Fluency in both Bangla and English, with strong written and verbal communication skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications. Demonstrated managerial, leadership, decision-making, and team management skills. Responsibilities & Context Good Neighbors (1991) is an international humanitarian, development and non-governmental organization with membership in General Consultative Status in the United Nations Economic and Social Council (UN ECOSOC). Winner of MDG 2 award 2007 and UNESCO-Hamdan Prize for Teacher Development 2024, Good Neighbors Bangladesh (GNB) is operating 17 Community Development Projects (CDP) and 2 Special Projects (SP) in 13 districts for child protection, education, health, women empowerment, income generating activities, DRR and Rohingya emergency response activities. Good Neighbors Bangladesh (GNB) intends to recruit suitable personnel for the mentioned position: Location: GNB Head Office, Dhaka Probation Period: 6 months (Confirmation of employment, extension of the probation period, or discontinuation of employment will be based on the performance evaluation during the probation period) Key Responsibilities: Manage the organizations Human Resource Management functions in accordance with GNB policies, procedures, standards, and applicable laws. Manage recruitment and selection processes, workforce planning, talent management, and succession planning. Oversee staff performance management, probationary evaluations, contract renewals, and related HR processes. Maintain and oversee day-to-day HR operations across all project offices, including employee records, HR databases, HR data analysis, and reporting. Ensure the accurate, timely, and equitable administration of employee compensation, benefits, and entitlements in accordance with GNB HR policies, employment terms, and applicable labour laws. Ensure the effective and consistent implementation of HR policies, procedures, and processes, while maintaining legal, regulatory, and organizational compliance. Monitor staff turnover and retention trends and recommend appropriate measures to improve employee retention and workforce stability. Prepare, review, and issue HR-related letters and certificates for employees, including employment, confirmation, transfer, promotion, salary, experience, service, and separation-related documents. Provide appropriate HR guidance and support to employees and management on HR policies, employee relations, and compliance matters. Plan, coordinate, and facilitate staff capacity-building and professional development initiatives, including training programs, workshops, seminars, and conferences. Provide effective leadership and supervision to the HRM team and foster a professional, collaborative, and accountable work environment. Develop and manage the internship program, including recruitment, placement, supervision, evaluation, and maintaining a pipeline of potential future employees. Prepare and submit HR reports, analyses, and management information as required. Perform any other HR-related duties and responsibilities assigned by the Head of HR Department. Skills & Expertise HRIS/ HR Database Management Human Resource Management Human Resource Planning Labor Law payroll management Performance Evaluation Recruitment & Selection Staff Capacity Development Staff Management Other Relevant Skills HR Management HRIS Administration HRM Human Resource Management Labour Rules Manpower Recruiting People Management Compensation & Other Benefits Consolidated remuneration of Tk. 60,000 per month, plus a 100% annual bonus after successful completion of the probationary period, 15 days of paid leave excluding public holidays, and training opportunities for career development. Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka (Khilkhet)

Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Experience 1 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Newspaper/Magazine, Telecommunication, Call Center Freshers are also encouraged to apply. Additional Requirements Age 20 to 30 years Only Female Applicants may have experience in one or more of the following areas: Front Desk Operations, Personal Secretarial Support, Customer Service, Office Security, and Hygiene Maintenance. Responsibilities & Context Welcome clients, visitors, and guests professionally while maintaining accurate records of front desk operations. Answer incoming calls politely, provide information and assistance, and operate the PABX system to manage incoming and outgoing telephone calls. Receive, record, track, and distribute incoming and outgoing letters, messages, documents, and parcels to the concerned persons. Maintain and organize front desk documents, records, and files for easy access and proper documentation. Communicate with vendors, monitor vending machine operations, arrange timely refilling of supplies, and help resolve any related issues. Issue money receipts for book and newspaper sales, maintain sales records, and submit the receipts and related documents to the Accounts Department. Assist e-paper readers over the phone, report technical problems to the Technical Team, and follow up to ensure their issues are resolved. Record newspaper subscription orders and customer details, follow up on delivery issues, and coordinate with the relevant team to resolve customer complaints. Prepare and maintain a comprehensive guest list for The Daily Star’s Anniversary event, ensuring guest information is accurate and up to date. Assist the administrative heads with their tasks as required. Job Location Dhaka (Kawran Bazar)
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

raw_source_fields.education: Master of Commerce (MCom) in Accounting CA course completion is required.
raw_source_fields.age: At least 28 years Responsibilities & Context Develop, review and maintain Bills of Materials (BOM) for control over material consumption and other related analysis. Partner with Plant head and factory operation team for preparing, analyzing, monitoring and controlling manufacturing overhead. Ensure and establish proper accounting of Direct cost and manufacturing overhead. Design and establish control over inventory management including attention for management of slow, non-moving, unused and obsolete materials. Parter with Plant Head and departments to organize and establish control over factory procurement. Work closely with Factory Leadership team to drive down cost and improve factory performance. Prepare SBU and department wise yearly budget for the plant and act as Owner of Plant level Budget, monitor monthly progression of budget, report monthly variances against budget identifying reason of variances in coordination related persons/department. Coordinate with Plant Head and departmental Heads to report and optimize use and management of Plant Assets (operational resources of Capacity, Workforce, Facility and Inventory). Contribute to manage and dispose scarp and wastage at factory. Skills & Expertise Cost reduction Factory Accounts Procurement Variance Analysis

Responsibilities & Context Position Overview OK Immigration is seeking a motivated, detail-oriented Accounting & IT Intern (Accounting Systems Development) for a four-month, full-time internship at our Chattogram office. Additional Qualifications — Preferred · Currently studying or recently completed a degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline. · Familiarity with QuickBooks, Xero, Tally, Zoho Books, or other accounting applications. ·

Requirements Education Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) in Accounting & Information System, Accounting, Cost & Management Accounting, Cost Accounting, Finance Experience At least 1 year The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Immigration and Education Consultancy Service Freshers are also encouraged to apply. Additional Requirements Age At least 22 years Only Male Interested candidates who meet the mandatory requirements are requested to email their updated CV and a cover letter to career@okimmigration.ca, explaining their knowledge of double-entry accounting, proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets, familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, or Claude, and relevant IT or accounting experience, as well as how their skills would help OK Immigration clear its accounting backlog, standardize financial records, and develop a customized accounting solution during the four-month internship. Responsibilities & Context Position Overview OK Immigration is seeking a motivated, detail-oriented Accounting & IT Intern (Accounting Systems Development) for a four-month, full-time internship at our Chattogram office. This hands-on role is designed for an accounting student or recent graduate who wants to apply theoretical knowledge in a real business environment while helping us clear our accounting backlog, standardize records, and build a customized accounting solution using suitable digital applications. Mandatory Requirements · Sound knowledge of double-entry bookkeeping, including debits, credits, journal entries, general ledgers, trial balances, and basic financial statements. · Practical skills in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas, financial calculations, and data organization. · Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Google Gemini, and Claude, and the ability to use them thoughtfully for research, spreadsheet support, and workflow development. · A combination of accounting knowledge and relevant IT proficiency is essential. · Strong attention to detail, analytical ability, confidentiality, and willingness to learn and implement new processes. Additional Qualifications — Preferred · Currently studying or recently completed a degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline. · Familiarity with QuickBooks, Xero, Tally, Zoho Books, or other accounting applications. · Experience with advanced spreadsheets, PivotTables, data validation, automation, cloud applications, or low-code/no-code tools. · Any practical experience in bookkeeping, account reconciliation, financial data entry, or reporting. Job Responsibilities Accounting & Backlog Clearance · Review and organize historical transactions and supporting documents to help clear pending bookkeeping work. · Post transactions using double-entry principles; maintain journals, ledgers, cashbooks, and basic accounting schedules. · Assist with reconciliation of bank transactions, receipts, expenses, payables, and receivables; flag discrepancies for review. Standardization & System Development · Help design a suitable chart of accounts and standardized templates for income, expenses, receivables, payables, and reporting. · Work with management to evaluate, configure, test, and document a customized accounting solution using relevant applications. · Help build accurate spreadsheet formulas, reports, checks, and practical procedures that the team can continue using. AI & Technology Support · Use ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and other suitable tools to support research, spreadsheet development, documentation, and workflow improvements. · Check all AI-generated formulas, classifications, and outputs before use; protect confidential financial information. · Explore simple automation opportunities to reduce repetitive data entry and improve consistency. Reporting & Team Support · Prepare basic financial summaries and progress updates on backlog clearance and system development. · Organize electronic records and perform other related accounting and systems-support tasks assigned by management. Skills & Expertise Accounting Accounts and Finance Accounting Software Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Job Location Chattogram (Chittagong GPO)
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

Responsibilities & Context
OK Immigration is seeking a motivated, detail-oriented Accounting & IT Intern (Accounting Systems Development) for a four-month, full-time internship at our Chattogram office. This hands-on role is designed for an accounting student or recent graduate who wants to apply theoretical knowledge in a real business environment while helping us clear our accounting backlog, standardize records, and build a customized accounting solution using suitable digital applications.
· Sound knowledge of double-entry bookkeeping, including debits, credits, journal entries, general ledgers, trial balances, and basic financial statements.
· Practical skills in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas, financial calculations, and data organization.
· Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Google Gemini, and Claude, and the ability to use them thoughtfully for research, spreadsheet support, and workflow development.
· A combination of accounting knowledge and relevant IT proficiency is essential.
· Strong attention to detail, analytical ability, confidentiality, and willingness to learn and implement new processes.
· Currently studying or recently completed a degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline.
· Familiarity with QuickBooks, Xero, Tally, Zoho Books, or other accounting applications.
· Experience with advanced spreadsheets, PivotTables, data validation, automation, cloud applications, or low-code/no-code tools.
· Any practical experience in bookkeeping, account reconciliation, financial data entry, or reporting.
· Review and organize historical transactions and supporting documents to help clear pending bookkeeping work.
· Post transactions using double-entry principles; maintain journals, ledgers, cashbooks, and basic accounting schedules.
· Assist with reconciliation of bank transactions, receipts, expenses, payables, and receivables; flag discrepancies for review.
· Help design a suitable chart of accounts and standardized templates for income, expenses, receivables, payables, and reporting.
· Work with management to evaluate, configure, test, and document a customized accounting solution using relevant applications.
· Help build accurate spreadsheet formulas, reports, checks, and practical procedures that the team can continue using.
· Use ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and other suitable tools to support research, spreadsheet development, documentation, and workflow improvements.
· Check all AI-generated formulas, classifications, and outputs before use; protect confidential financial information.
· Explore simple automation opportunities to reduce repetitive data entry and improve consistency.
· Prepare basic financial summaries and progress updates on backlog clearance and system development.
· Organize electronic records and perform other related accounting and systems-support tasks assigned by management.
Workplace
Work at office
Employment Status
Full Time
Gender
Only males are allowed to apply.
Job Location
Chattogram (Chittagong GPO)
Job Highlights
A four month, hands on internship combining accounting and technology. Apply double-entry bookkeeping, use AI and spreadsheets, clear accounting backlogs, and help develop a customized accounting system under management guidance.
Address:
B9, SH HOMES, Shantidhara Residential Area, Chattogram 4000

এই চাকরির জন্য বিজ্ঞাপনদাতা ব্যাক্তি/প্রতিষ্ঠান আপনার কাছ থেকে কোন অর্থ চাইলে কিংবা নিয়োগ প্রক্রিয়া চলাকালীন কোন প্রকার হয়রানিমূলক (শারীরিক/মানসিক) আচরণ করলে অতিসত্ত্বর আমাদেরকে জানান অথবা জবটি রিপোর্ট করুন। চাকরি পাওয়ার জন্য কোন ব্যাক্তি/প্রতিষ্ঠানকে অর্থ প্রদান করবেন না। চাকরিকালীন কোন প্রকার হয়রানির (শারীরিক/মানসিক) সম্ভাবনা থাকলে সেখানে জয়েন করবেন না। কোন প্রকার অর্থ লেনদেন বা নিয়োগদাতা কর্তৃক হয়রানির দায়িত্ব বিডিজবস বহন করবে না।
