jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1544770&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Graduate in any discipline. Experience At least 1 year Additional Requirements Only Female Only Females are allowed to apply. Minimum of 1 year of relevant experience in HR and accounts. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Proficient in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and Tally Prime software . Detail-oriented with excellent organizational skills. A minimum commitment of 2 years is required. Responsibilities & Context A+ Consultancy & Mega Solutions is as specialized company for complete infrastructure safety solution in Bangladesh provides a versatile range of products and services include the design, consultancy, supply, engineering, installation and maintenance. We are looking for dynamic personal who are ready to lead the team, achieve growth and enhance our specialization. Job Location: Gulshan- Badda Link Road, Dhaka. Job Description: We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented HR and Accounts Executive to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing HR functions and assisting with basic accounting tasks. This position is a fantastic opportunity for an individual looking to grow their career in human resources and accounting. Key Responsibilities: Daily Cash Inflow check and entry to TALLY SOFTWARE (Specially in TALLY Prime) Maintain petty cash, ledger book, registers & Prepare to invoices, expense forms and payment request Monitor and follow-up on outstanding receivables. Closely monitor and operate all payments and expenditure Assist in preparing monthly. Quarterly and annual financial reports Ensure bill, voucher checking, verifying and proper recording as per guideline Handle accounts including invoice process Prepare & maintain mushak TDS and VDS treasury challan. Prepare documents for tax filing and audits. Communicate with vendors, clients and banks regarding financial matters To generate monthly sales accounts reports & submit to Higher Authority. Manage recruitment processes, including job postings, resume screening, interviewing, and onboarding of new employees. Maintain employee records and manage HR documentation. Assist in the development and implementation of HR policies and procedures. To check and verify all sorts of requisition, expenditure and other bills, Sales bill etc. Maintain organized records of transactions and supporting documents Archive financial data for future reference and audits Manage Daily accounting operations Any Other duties as assigned by the management from time to time Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Accounts and Finance Financial Reporting Petty Cash Managementment Tally Prime Software Compensation & Other Benefits Sales incentive. Yearly Increment. TA/DA, Mobile Bill Yearly Two Festival Bonus. Employment Status Full Time Gender Only females are allowed to apply. Job Location Dhaka

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1545224&fc.source_content:

raw_source_fields.age: 24 to 36 years Candidates with a strong interest in fashion, jewelry, product design, and creativity will be given preference. Responsibilities & Context Source and develop reliable suppliers for imitation jewelry, fashion jewelry, and accessories, clothing, ladies' parts and bags, shoes from local and international markets mostly from India China, Turkey, Thailand, Korea etc. Identify new products, designs, and fashion trends based on market demand and customer preferences. Negotiate product prices, MOQ, payment terms, lead time, packaging, and other commercial terms with suppliers. Collect and compare supplier quotations and prepare product costing for management approval. Coordinate product sampling, customization, and new product development with suppliers. Monitor purchase orders, production progress, shipment schedules, and ensure timely delivery. Ensure product quality by coordinating inspections and resolving quality issues with suppliers. Maintain strong relationships with suppliers and continuously expand the supplier network. Coordinate with merchandising, inventory, warehouse, sales, and finance teams to ensure smooth product availability. Monitor market prices, competitor products, supplier performance, and identify opportunities for cost savings and business growth. Skills & Expertise Communication and interpersonal skill Fashion and Lifestyle Brand jewellery retouch Strategic Planning Strategic Sourcing Other Relevant Skills Cost optimization Market Research Product Development Quality Control Relationship Management Supplier Sourcing Supply Chain Management

Responsibilities & Context WE ARE HIRING: SOCIAL MEDIA MANAGER Foreign Guides | Study Abroad & IELTS Are you creative, confident, and passionate about social media, content creation, and digital marketing? Join Foreign Guides and help us grow our online presence, reach prospective students, and build valuable business partnerships. Educational Requirements Undergraduate students and Bachelor’s degree holders are welcome to apply. Freshers with practical skills and a willingness to learn are encouraged to apply. Candidates with relevant marketing, media, or communication skills will receive priority. Job Location: Shantinagar, Bailey Road, Dhaka. Job Responsibilities Manage and maintain our Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube platforms. Plan and publish engaging social media content, promotional photos, and videos. Analyse advertising performance, including reach, impressions, clicks, CTR, cost per lead, and campaign results. Prepare performance reports and recommend improvements to increase campaign effectiveness. Communicate with prospective students and clients, manage enquiries, and follow up on leads. Conduct B2B outreach to universities, educational institutions, agencies, and potential business partners. Support partnership development, brand awareness, and marketing campaigns for study abroad and IELTS services. Skills & Expertise Advertising & Promotion Advertising Branding Digital Marketing (Social Media Marketing) Marketing Other Relevant Skills Social Media Management Content Creation Graphic Design Compensation & Other Benefits Salary: BDT 15,000-20,000 per month, depending on skills and experience. Requirements Education Higher Secondary Additional Requirements Only Female Responsibilities & Context Promote the company’s Europe visa and immigration services to potential clients. Generate new leads through online and offline marketing activities. Build and maintain strong relationships with prospective and existing clients. Respond to customer inquiries via phone calls, WhatsApp, email, and social media platforms. Explain visa requirements, processing procedures, and available services professionally. Schedule client appointments and follow up with potential customers regularly. Meet monthly sales and marketing targets set by the company. Develop and implement effective marketing strategies to increase brand awareness. Create and manage promotional campaigns on social media and other digital platforms. Coordinate with the processing team to ensure smooth client service. Maintain accurate records of client interactions and sales activities. Conduct market research to identify new business opportunities and competitors. Attend promotional events, seminars, and exhibitions when required. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly marketing and sales reports. Maintain a high level of professionalism, honesty, and customer satisfaction at all times. Create promotional video advertisements and voice-over advertisements for the company’s services as required. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Client Relationship Digital Marketing (Social Media Marketing) Immigration Education Consultancy Service Lead Generation Market Research Sales & Marketing Compensation & Other Benefits T/A,Mobile bill,Performance bonus,Provident fund Salary Review: Half Yearly Festival Bonus: 3 Salary & Benefits Probation Period: 3 months. Salary Review: Salary will be reviewed based on performance after successful completion of the 3-month probation period. Performance Appraisal: Outstanding performers will be considered for salary increments and career growth opportunities. Per File Commission: Attractive commission will be provided for every successfully processed client file, as per the companys commission policy. Target Achievement Incentive: Employees who achieve or exceed their monthly sales targets will receive an attractive performance bonus/commission. Career Growth: Opportunity for promotion and additional incentives based on performance and contribution to the company. Training & Development: Professional training and continuous learning opportunities will be provided to enhance skills and career development. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only females are allowed to apply. Job Location Dhaka

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1545347&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related discipline. Candidates with strong relevant experience and proven sales leadership ability may also be considered. Experience 2 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Healthcare/Lifestyle product, E-commerce, F-commerce Additional Requirements Age 25 to 32 years Experience Requirements 2–3 years of relevant experience in telesales, telemarketing, call center sales, or a similar sales role. Previous experience leading, supervising, or managing a telesales team will be an advantage. Additional Requirements Strong verbal communication, persuasion, negotiation, and customer-handling skills. Good leadership, interpersonal, team-coordination, and employee-motivation abilities. Proven ability to work toward sales targets and improve conversion rates. Familiarity with CRM systems, call monitoring, lead management, and sales reporting. Good analytical, reporting, and problem-solving skills; proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets is an advantage. Strong sense of responsibility, discipline, time management, and ability to work under pressure. Responsibilities & Context Company Name: Buzzblu-Hedaaya Position: Telesales Leader / Telesales Manager Job Category: Sales & Marketing Job Level: Team Leader / Mid-Level Management Job Location: Shonir Akhra, Dhaka, Bangladesh Job Context: Buzzblu-Hedaaya is looking for dynamic, target-oriented, and experienced candidates to lead and supervise its telesales operations. The selected candidates will help achieve sales targets, guide telesales executives, improve conversion rates, maintain sales quality, and ensure effective execution of sales strategies and daily operations. Key Responsibilities Lead, supervise, motivate, and support telesales executives to achieve assigned sales targets. Develop and implement telesales strategies and support sales campaigns to achieve daily, monthly, and quarterly targets. Distribute leads, assign daily tasks, monitor call productivity, and ensure timely customer follow-up. Monitor individual and team performance, including call volume, conversions, sales, revenue, lead quality, and customer engagement. Coach team members to improve sales techniques, negotiation, objection handling, and customer communication. Review sales calls and ensure compliance with approved scripts, pricing, company policies, and professional standards. Maintain accurate CRM records, customer information, lead status, and sales activity updates. Monitor attendance, punctuality, discipline, and compliance with operational procedures. Identify underperforming employees, provide feedback, and implement improvement plans where necessary. Assist with recruitment, onboarding, training, and performance evaluation of telesales employees. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly sales performance reports for management and recommend corrective actions. Coordinate with Marketing, HR, Finance, and other relevant departments to ensure smooth operations. Forecast sales performance, identify operational challenges, and recommend resource allocation or process improvements. Escalate customer complaints, policy violations, and operational issues to the appropriate authority. Maintain a positive, productive, accountable, and customer-focused team environment. Skills & Expertise Customer Support through Phone Manage workload and meet deadline Motivation skills Problem solving and decision making Team Leader (Sales) Team management Training & Development Working under pressure Other Relevant Skills Telesales sales strategy Lead management Customer Relationship Compensation & Other Benefits Performance bonus Salary: BDT 14,000-30,000 per month, depending on experience and qualifications Other Benefits: As per company policy Performance Incentives: As per company policy, where applicable Monthly salary: BDT 14,000-30,000, depending on experience, qualifications, and role suitability. Other benefits as per company policy. Performance-based incentives, where applicable, as per company policy. Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka (Shonir Akhra)

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1544743&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Minimum Bachelors Degree or equivalent. Educational qualifications in Marketing, Media, Journalism, or a relevant discipline will be preferred. Experience 1 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Automobile, Motor Workshop Additional Requirements 1–3 years of experience in content creation, videography, or digital marketing will be preferred. Freshers with strong creative skills and relevant knowledge are encouraged to apply. Experience in the automobile industry or car sales business will be an added advantage. Strong interest in automobiles and willingness to learn about vehicle features and specifications. One Must be proficient in writing accurate and informative scripts covering various aspects of Auto Mobiles. One must be adept at speaking in Standard Bangali in a highly Engaging and appealing manner. Experience creating content for Facebook, YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok. Excellent Bangla communication and presentation skills. Creativity, punctuality, and the ability to work collaboratively as part of a team. Responsibilities & Context Job Context Sanzida Car Selection Ltd. is a reputed automobile sales company offering a wide range of reconditioned vehicles from various brands. To strengthen our digital marketing, branding, and vehicle sales activities, we are looking for a creative, talented, and enthusiastic Content Creator. The selected candidate will be responsible for producing engaging automotive videos and photographs, creating social media content, and attracting potential customers through various digital platforms. Job Responsibilities You need to show cars to customers visiting the showroom and sell cars to them. Create engaging video content highlighting vehicle features, packages, engine capacity, mileage, and specifications. Produce Reels, YouTube Shorts, and promotional videos for Facebook, YouTube, Instagram, and other social media platforms. Create car reviews, vehicle walkaround videos, feature highlights, and showroom promotional content. Prepare video scripts, captions, titles and descriptions for social media content. Develop SEO-friendly titles, descriptions, and content publishing plans for YouTube and Facebook. Create engaging content to attract potential car buyers and support sales activities. Monitor content performance and suggest creative ideas to improve audience engagement and reach. Coordinate with the Digital Marketing and Sales teams to support promotional campaigns. Create promotional content highlighting new vehicle arrivals, special offers, down payment facilities, car loan options, and sales campaigns. Maintain consistent brand identity while producing and publishing high-quality content regularly. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Video Content Creator Search Engine Optimization (SEO) promotional activities Digital Marketing (Social Media Marketing) Compensation & Other Benefits Mobile bill allowance. Other benefits as per company policy. Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka (Tejgaon)
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1545046&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelor of Science (BSc) in Computer Science & Engineering, Computing & Information System, Electrical & Electronic Engineering, Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering Experience At least 2 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Business-to-Business (B2B) Software and Services Startup, Computer Hardware/Network Companies, Industrial Machineries (Generator, Diesel Engine etc.) Additional Requirements Age 22 to 32 years Only Male The applicants should have experience in the following area(s):Electrical Engineering, Electrical Maintenance, Computer engineering The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Bridge Toll Plazas, excel load control (WIM) stations. Responsibilities & Context Immediate Joining We are looking for an efficient IT support site engineer who has sound knowledge on installing & configuring both Electronic & Networking devices. Job Responsibilities: Regular maintenance of the IT systems used in the electronic toll collection(ETC). This includes troubleshooting and resolving any technical issues that arise in the toll collection systems, surveillance cameras, network connectivity, and other related technologies. Ensuring stable and secure network operations. This includes overseeing the installation and management of network devices, performing network upgrades, and ensuring reliable internet connectivity. Installing, updating, and managing the software used for toll collection, including ensuring that it integrates seamlessly with other systems like vehicle detection and classification systems. Providing technical support to staff at the toll plaza. This involves training employees on new systems, assisting them with technical difficulties, and ensuring they can effectively use the technology. Developing and implementing emergency plans for IT systems in case of system failures, power outages, or other emergencies that could impact operations. Should have experience in Maintaining and Troubleshooting core data center network, LAN, WAN devices & Firewall devices. Should have experience in installing and configuring CCTV Cameras Should have experience in Maintenance & repair of all types of electrical channels, lighting systems other electrical works which are needed to smooth operation. Safeguarding the data collected at the excel load control(WIM), which includes financial transactions and vehicle information. Implementing and managing data backup and recovery plans, and ensuring compliance with data protection regulations. Continuously seeking ways to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the IT systems at the toll plaza. This may involve researching and implementing new technologies or processes. Skills & Expertise CCTV Installation Electrical Installation and Maintenance Installation and Maintenance IT system support and maintenance Operation & Maintenance Server Maintenance Software Business Analysis Software Installation Other Relevant Skills Information technology LAN/ WAN CCTV Installation Maintenance and Troubleshooting Compensation & Other Benefits Performance bonus,Tour allowance Salary Review: Yearly Festival Bonus: 2 Yearly salary increment. Fully subsidized lunch or accommodation. Outstanding working environment. On the Job Training and Development. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Job Location Anywhere in Bangladesh

Responsibilities & Context Attend customer calls and provide effective solutions within defined Service Level Agreements (SLA). Job Nature: 6-months’ contract, which is renewable subject to satisfactory performance. jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1545210&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Fresh graduates Additional Requirements Age 20 to 30 years Only Male Fresh graduates with excellent English communication and strong analytical abilities are encouraged to apply. Important Requirements Strong English proficiency is mandatory, including speaking, listening, reading, and writing. Candidates must be able to communicate ideas and explain their reasoning clearly in English. Excellent logical reasoning, critical thinking, and analytical skills are essential. Candidates must be comfortable working with detailed instructions and completing research-intensive tasks. Basic computer proficiency and familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini are preferred. Prior experience in AI training, data annotation, research, content evaluation, or quality assurance will be considered an advantage. Responsibilities & Context We are looking for highly motivated, analytical, and detail-oriented individuals to join our team as AI Research & Quality Analysts . The selected candidates will work on AI-related research, response evaluation, quality assurance, and problem-solving activities. This role requires excellent English communication skills, strong logical reasoning, critical thinking, and the ability to understand and evaluate complex information. Candidates from different educational backgrounds are welcome. Previous AI experience is not mandatory, but strong analytical abilities and a willingness to learn are essential. Key Responsibilities Evaluate AI-generated responses for accuracy, relevance, clarity, completeness, and logical consistency. Analyze complex questions and identify reasoning errors, factual inaccuracies, and inconsistencies. Compare multiple AI-generated responses and provide clear, evidence-based evaluations. Conduct online research, verify information, and assess the reliability of sources. Follow detailed English instructions, project guidelines, and quality standards. Develop and review prompts, questions, and evaluation criteria for AI systems. Provide clear written explanations and constructive feedback on AI-generated content. Apply logical reasoning, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills to challenging tasks. Identify potential issues, document findings, and recommend improvements. Maintain accuracy, consistency, and attention to detail while working on assigned projects. Participate in English-language meetings, assessments, training sessions, and project discussions. Learn and adapt to new AI platforms, tools, workflows, and project requirements. Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors 4 years Graduation in any discipline. Having BBA/MBA in any business discipline will be preferred. Experience At least 1 year The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Banks Additional Requirements 1–3 years of experience in banking, cash management, product or fintech (strong fresh graduates may be considered). Analytical and writing skills; proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint; interest in digital banking. Preparing proposals, product papers and MIS reports. Coordinating product implementation and client on-boarding. Supporting RMs in booking new CASA, SND, FDR and collection/payment mandates. Responsibilities & Context Support RMs/SRMs in prospecting, client calls, preparation of pitches, proposals and pricing notes. Conduct market research and peer bank bench-marking to identify product gaps and new business opportunities. Assist in developing new and enhanced products: draft product papers, business requirement documents (BRD), process flows and pricing proposals. Coordinate with IT, Operations, Compliance and vendors for UAT, approvals and launch of products and Corporate Internet Banking, API and H2H features. Coordinate client on-boarding and implementation of collection and payment mandates; ensure account opening and KYC documentation is complete. Prepare business MIS, pipeline trackers, budget-vs-achievement and product performance reports. Prepare marketing collateral, product presentations and client training material. Achieve budgeted targets through mobilization of CASA, SND, Special Transactional Accounts, FDRs and other liability products while maintaining a low cost of funds. Identify, target, and develop a diversified client base comprising large local corporate and multinational companies, Capital Market participants (including securities companies, IPOs, dividend distribution mandates), Insurance companies, local and international NGOs, Education, Healthcare, Fuel & Power, Food, and Telecommunications sectors. Design tailored collection and payment solutions to expand the deposit portfolio, drive sustainable growth, increase wallet shares within existing relationships, and maintain a low-cost funding base. Handle client service requests and complaints within agreed turnaround time. Ensure compliance with internal policies, regulatory requirements and AML/CFT guidelines. We are an official representative of leading universities in Australia, Canada, Malaysia, the UK and the USA, and support students through every step from choosing a destination to securing an offer. Position Overview This is a hands-on role for a sharp, capable professional who will work closely with senior management. You will help turn plans and strategies into executed projects, work with business data, and prepare high-quality business documents. We are looking for someone who can think, take initiative and finish what they start. We will train the right person, and the role will grow with your performance. Department: Administration Reports to: Senior Management Location: Banani, Dhaka Employment type: Full-time, with a six-month Process Familiarization Period (PFP), then permanent Working schedule: Sunday to Thursday, plus alternate Saturdays. Friday is the weekly holiday. Office hours are 10:00 am to 6:30 pm. Key Responsibilities Project execution Break down project plans and strategies into action lists, timelines and assigned tasks. Track progress, deadlines and approvals daily, and follow up until each task is closed. Coordinate with the HR, accounts, operations and counselling teams, and raise delays or risks early. Prepare progress updates for management. Business data and reporting Collect, clean, organise and analyse business data from the CRM, spreadsheets and team reports. Build trackers, summaries and reports that help management make decisions. Check data for accuracy and keep it up to date. Business documents Draft, review, proofread and format letters, reports, proposals, presentations and internal documents to a professional standard. Maintain organised, confidential and easily retrievable files, contracts and records. Administration Handle correspondence, follow-ups and administrative tasks assigned by management. Maintain strict confidentiality over business and personnel information. Growth areas Take on additional responsibilities, including marketing and communication support, as your skills develop. Requirements Education হিসাববিজ্ঞান, ফিন্যান্স বা সংশ্লিষ্ট বিষয়ে স্নাতক ডিগ্রি। Additional Requirements Experience Requirements: অ্যাকাউন্টস ও ফাইন্যান্স বিভাগে পূর্ব অভিজ্ঞতা থাকা বাধ্যতামূলক। ফার্নিচার ব্যবসা, শোরুম বা ট্রেডিং প্রতিষ্ঠানে হিসাব পরিচালনার অভিজ্ঞতাসম্পন্ন প্রার্থীদের অগ্রাধিকার দেওয়া হবে। Additional Requirements: MS Excel এবং হিসাবরক্ষণ সফটওয়্যারে দক্ষতা। আর্থিক হিসাব ও প্রতিবেদন তৈরিতে দক্ষতা। সততা, দায়িত্বশীলতা ও নির্ভুলভাবে কাজ করার সক্ষমতা। Responsibilities & Context Job Responsibilities: প্রতিষ্ঠানের দৈনিক হিসাব-নিকাশ ও আর্থিক লেনদেন পরিচালনা করা। বিক্রয়, ক্রয়, ক্যাশ, ব্যাংক লেনদেন ও খরচের হিসাব সংরক্ষণ করা। দৈনিক, মাসিক ও বার্ষিক আর্থিক প্রতিবেদন প্রস্তুত করা। ইনভয়েস, বিল, ভাউচার এবং অন্যান্য আর্থিক নথিপত্র যাচাই ও সংরক্ষণ করা। পাওনা ও দেনা হিসাব পর্যবেক্ষণ এবং সময়মতো হিসাব সমন্বয় করা। প্রতিষ্ঠানের আর্থিক নীতিমালা ও হিসাবরক্ষণ পদ্ধতি অনুসরণ নিশ্চিত করা। প্রয়োজন অনুযায়ী ম্যানেজমেন্টকে আর্থিক প্রতিবেদন ও হিসাবসংক্রান্ত তথ্য প্রদান করা। Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Accounting Software Financial Reporting MS Excel Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka

এই চাকরির জন্য বিজ্ঞাপনদাতা ব্যাক্তি/প্রতিষ্ঠান আপনার কাছ থেকে কোন অর্থ চাইলে কিংবা নিয়োগ প্রক্রিয়া চলাকালীন কোন প্রকার হয়রানিমূলক (শারীরিক/মানসিক) আচরণ করলে অতিসত্ত্বর আমাদেরকে জানান অথবা জবটি রিপোর্ট করুন। চাকরি পাওয়ার জন্য কোন ব্যাক্তি/প্রতিষ্ঠানকে অর্থ প্রদান করবেন না। চাকরিকালীন কোন প্রকার হয়রানির (শারীরিক/মানসিক) সম্ভাবনা থাকলে সেখানে জয়েন করবেন না। কোন প্রকার অর্থ লেনদেন বা নিয়োগদাতা কর্তৃক হয়রানির দায়িত্ব বিডিজবস বহন করবে না।

raw_source_fields.age: 25 to 40 years Only Male Responsibilities & Context Develop and implement effective marketing and sales strategies to achieve the company’s business objectives. Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients and other relevant stakeholders. Identify new business opportunities and generate potential leads for real estate projects. Conduct regular client meetings, property/project visits, presentations, and follow-ups. Monitor market trends, competitor activities, customer preferences, and market conditions. Develop strategies for promoting residential and commercial projects. Lead negotiations with clients and ensure successful conversion of leads into sales. Prepare regular sales and marketing reports and present performance updates to senior management. Coordinate with other departments to ensure smooth execution of marketing and sales activities. Skills & Expertise Customer Relationship Motorcycle Driving Sales & Marketing Other Relevant Skills Marketing Strategy Customer Relationship Lead Generation Market Research Campaign Management

Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Experience At least 2 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Advertising Agency, Agro based firms (incl. Agro Processing/Seed/GM), Tea Garden Freshers are also encouraged to apply. Additional Requirements Age 24 to 35 years Only Male All official report must be prepared in English. Responsibilities & Context Arkay Multimedia Limited invites applications from energetic and pro-active individuals for the position of Supervisor - Outdoor Beautification and Development Coordinator Work. · Plan, develop and care for all our beautification and landscaping projects. · Ensuring that the day-to-day activities of the gardeners are being carried out as per schedule, routine and plan and work is carried out efficiently · Recruiting quality Gardeners and training them · Monitoring that each gardener is performing their daily routine job · Monitoring efficiency level of each Gardener. · Distributing daily work of gardeners so that optimum efficiency of work is achieved · Ensuring regular maintenance of our sites and replacing dead or missing plants with new plants. · Ensuring that Gardeners are wearing their uniform and raincoats when required and keeping track of their uniforms. · Setting up quality standards and ensuring we are up to the standard required. · Ensure regular watering is done. Creating and maintaining a weekly watering schedule. · Arranging watering trucks to ensure smooth watering of our project sites. · Ensuring regular hedge cutting is done and creating a routine and plan for hedge cutting. · Ensuring that height and dimensions of hedge are being followed as per company guidelines. · Ensuring grass cutting is done and creating a routine and plan for grass cutting. · Any equipment not functioning must be immediately repaired or replaced. · Must have inventory of all gardening equipment and must ensure that they are stored safely at the end of the day’s work. · In case of absence of staff, must recruit daily labor to ensure that the work is carried out smoothly. · Must have a passion for plants and greenery. · Must have leadership and commanding Skills. · Must know how to get the job done effectively and efficiently within the shortest time possible · Must be able to assess the present quality of our landscaping sites and methods to improve it. · Must ensure regular removal of unwanted plants, shrubs and weeds. · Must ensure regular booming and removal of dirt or debris or unwanted materials from our landscaping projects. · Must ensure that gardening tools including watering tanks, pipes, nozzles, rickshaw vans are repaired regularly and all items are useable. · Must keep track of daily gardeners attendance. · Must keep track of their in time to work and their out time. · Must have time management skills to ensure the gardeners are working effectively & efficiently. · Must be able to work at site for long hours under hard conditions such as rain or direct sun. · Must be able to work at night if and when required. · Must ensure that all gardening equipment’s are available to the gardeners. · Must visit sites daily to provide example to team members on how to work efficiently. · Work in field and come to head office for daily meetings. · Assist in preparation of work schedule and job assignment. · Budget and sourcing plants for replacement of damaged plants. · Regularly replace all damaged plants. · Ensuring that the condition of grounds and gardens meet the standards and quality of our designs. · Make sure that the health of landscape is at its best condition. Consult with horticulturist if there is bacterial attack on plants. Skills & Expertise Gardener Compensation & Other Benefits T/A Salary Review: Yearly Festival Bonus: 2 Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Job Location Dhaka
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

Responsibilities & Context
Arkay Multimedia Limited invites applications from energetic and pro-active individuals for the position of Supervisor - Outdoor Beautification and Development Coordinator Work.
· Plan, develop and care for all our beautification and landscaping projects.
· Ensuring that the day-to-day activities of the gardeners are being carried out as per schedule, routine and plan and work is carried out efficiently
· Recruiting quality Gardeners and training them
· Monitoring that each gardener is performing their daily routine job
· Monitoring efficiency level of each Gardener.
· Distributing daily work of gardeners so that optimum efficiency of work is achieved
· Ensuring regular maintenance of our sites and replacing dead or missing plants with new plants.
· Ensuring that Gardeners are wearing their uniform and raincoats when required and keeping track of their uniforms.
· Setting up quality standards and ensuring we are up to the standard required.
· Ensure regular watering is done. Creating and maintaining a weekly watering schedule.
· Arranging watering trucks to ensure smooth watering of our project sites.
· Ensuring regular hedge cutting is done and creating a routine and plan for hedge cutting.
· Ensuring that height and dimensions of hedge are being followed as per company guidelines.
· Ensuring grass cutting is done and creating a routine and plan for grass cutting.
· Any equipment not functioning must be immediately repaired or replaced.
· Must have inventory of all gardening equipment and must ensure that they are stored safely at the end of the day’s work.
· In case of absence of staff, must recruit daily labor to ensure that the work is carried out smoothly.
· Must have a passion for plants and greenery.
· Must have leadership and commanding Skills.
· Must know how to get the job done effectively and efficiently within the shortest time possible
· Must be able to assess the present quality of our landscaping sites and methods to improve it.
· Must ensure regular removal of unwanted plants, shrubs and weeds.
· Must ensure regular booming and removal of dirt or debris or unwanted materials from our landscaping projects.
· Must ensure that gardening tools including watering tanks, pipes, nozzles, rickshaw vans are repaired regularly and all items are useable.
· Must keep track of daily gardeners attendance.
· Must keep track of their in time to work and their out time.
· Must have time management skills to ensure the gardeners are working effectively & efficiently.
· Must be able to work at site for long hours under hard conditions such as rain or direct sun.
· Must be able to work at night if and when required.
· Must ensure that all gardening equipment’s are available to the gardeners.
· Must visit sites daily to provide example to team members on how to work efficiently.
· Work in field and come to head office for daily meetings.
· Assist in preparation of work schedule and job assignment.
· Budget and sourcing plants for replacement of damaged plants.
· Regularly replace all damaged plants.
· Ensuring that the condition of grounds and gardens meet the standards and quality of our designs.
· Make sure that the health of landscape is at its best condition. Consult with horticulturist if there is bacterial attack on plants.

raw_source_fields.education: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) in Accounting Master of Business Administration (MBA) in Accounting, Finance যেকোনো স্বীকৃত বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় থেকে হিসাববিজ্ঞানে বিসিএ (BBA in Accounting) বা এমবিএ (MBA in Accounting/Finance)। CIMA / CA Knowledge Level সম্পন্ন প্রার্থীদের অগ্রাধিকার দেওয়া হবে।
raw_source_fields.age: 25 to 35 years Additional Requirements টিমে কাজ করার মানসিকতা এবং যোগাযোগ দক্ষতা থাকতে হবে। Computer Skills: MS Excel (Advanced), MS Word এবং Accounting Software (Tally / QuickBooks / Custom ERP)-এ পারদর্শী হতে হবে। চাপ সামলে কাজ করার ক্ষমতা থাকতে হবে। অভিজ্ঞতা: ১ থেকে ৩ বছরের কাজের অভিজ্ঞতা (রিয়েল এস্টেট ডেভেলপমেন্ট কোম্পানিতে কাজের পূর্ব অভিজ্ঞতা থাকলে বিশেষ অগ্রাধিকার পাবেন)। Responsibilities & Context একটি উদীয়মান এবং সুনামধন্য রিয়েল এস্টেট ডেভেলপমেন্ট কোম্পানি কর্মস্থল: বগুড়া রোড, বরিশাল দায়িত্বসমূহ (Job Responsibilities): রিয়েল এস্টেট প্রজেক্টের দৈনিক আয়-ব্যয় এবং ক্যাশ ফ্লো (Cash Flow) সঠিকভাবে হিসাব ও লিপিবদ্ধ করা। কাস্টমারদের বুকিং মানি, ডাউন পেমেন্ট এবং কিস্তির (Installment) হিসাব সংরক্ষণ ও রসিদ প্রদান করা। প্রজেক্টভিত্তিক নির্মাণ সামগ্রী ক্রয়, ঠিকাদার (Contractor) এবং সাপ্লাইয়ারদের বিল যাচাই ও পরিশোধ করা। কোম্পানির ব্যাংক স্টেটমেন্ট রিকনসিলিয়েশন (Bank Reconciliation) করা। মাসিক আর্থিক বিবরণী (Monthly Financial Statements) এবং প্রফিট & লস রিপোর্ট প্রস্তুত করে উচ্চপদস্থ কর্মকর্তাদের নিকট পেশ করা। আয়কর (TAX/AIT) এবং ভ্যাট (VAT) সংক্রান্ত প্রাথমিক হিসাব বজায় রাখা। হিসাবরক্ষণ সফটওয়্যার (Accounting Software / Tally / ERP) নিয়মিত আপডেট রাখা।

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1545311&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Experience At least 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Banks Additional Requirements RM: 3–6 years; SRM: 6+ years of experience in corporate banking, cash management or corporate liability. Good knowledge of payment systems (BEFTN, RTGS, NPSB), digital channels and relevant regulations. Strong sales, negotiation and relationship skills; proficiency in Chinese (Mandarin) preferred for the Foreign Corridor desk. Managing customers requests, requirements & complaints. Making calls to corporate clients and prospects. Booking new collection and payment solutions, FDR, CASA, SND, Special Transactional Accounts, Government and Corporate Mandates. Maintaining a sustainable deposit portfolio and cementing relationships with existing clients. Helping to maintain the Banks AD Ratio. Language preference: Proficiency in Chinese (Mandarin), spoken and written (HSK 4 or above), will be strongly preferred. Proficiency in other relevant languages such as Japanese or Korean will be an added advantage. Responsibilities & Context Identify and develop target markets including Government, Semi-Government, Autonomous bodies, utility service providers, Large Local and Multinational Corporates, Capital Market entities, Insurance, NGOs, Education, Healthcare, Fuel & Power, Food and Telecom sectors to offer customized collection and payment solutions and increase wallet share. Achieve budgeted targets through mobilization of CASA, SND, Special Transactional Accounts, FDRs and other liability products while maintaining a low cost of funds. Structure and implement solutions such as virtual accounts, payment gateway, cash pick-up, bulk/payroll, vendor and tax/VAT payments through BEFTN, RTGS and NPSB, escrow, and IPO/dividend services (Banker to the Issue / Lead Banker to the Issue). Generate fee-based income and enhance portfolio profitability through pricing negotiation and multi-product solutions. Sell, onboard and support clients on the Corporate Internet Banking Platform, H2H and API channels; feed client needs into feature enhancements. Establish trusted advisor status by understanding clients' cash flow cycles and advising on deposit structures and transactional needs. Actively cross-sell Trade, Treasury, Payroll and Retail products of Bank Asia PLC to corporate clients and their employees. Ensure full compliance with KYC/CDD, AML/CFT, Bangladesh Bank regulations and internal policies; maintain complete documentation. SRM: lead larger and more complex mandates, and guide and mentor RMs/ARMs in the team. Foreign Corridor (Desk-specific responsibilities) Acquire and service foreign-owned and foreign-invested companies operating in Bangladesh (e.g., Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Indian, Middle Eastern), including EPZ/Economic Zone units, EPC contractors on foreign-funded/G2G projects and their local supply chains. Offer corridor-specific propositions: Foreign Currency and local currency accounts, FDI/inward remittance handling, expatriate payroll and vendor payments, in line with Foreign Exchange Transactions Guidelines and in coordination with Trade, Treasury and FI/Correspondent Banking. Communicate with clients' local management and overseas head offices in their language; support translation of proposals, documentation and service requests. Build networks with bilateral chambers of commerce (e.g., BCCCI, JBCCI, KBCCI), embassies, BIDA, BEZA and BEPZA to generate referrals and track incoming investment pipelines. jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1545368&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Media, Business or a related field. Experience 1 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Advertising Agency, Cultural Centre, Event Management, Film Production, Newspaper/Magazine, Online Newspaper/ News Portal, Telecommunication, Web Media/Blog Additional Requirements Age 22 to 28 years Requirements - 1 to 3 years of experience in social media management, content creation or digital marketing, preferably in music, entertainment or media. Hands-on experience with Facebook, Instagram, YouTube and TikTok, and a good understanding of current trends and platform algorithms. Basic skills in video editing and design tools such as CapCut, Canva, Premiere Pro or Photoshop. Ability to read and report on platform analytics. Strong written communication in Bangla and English. Deep passion for Bangladeshi music, drama and pop culture. Ability to work to deadlines and handle multiple posts and campaigns at once. Responsibilities & Context Reports to: Strategic Planner Location: Dhaka, Bangladesh Type: Full-time Working days: Saturday to Thursday Office hours: 11:00 AM to 7:00 PM Gaanchill is a leading music label, production house and mobile content provider in Bangladesh. Across our wings Gaanchill Music, Gaanchill Drama & Cinema and Gaanchill Folk, we produce original songs, drama soundtracks, films and mobile entertainment for audiences at home and abroad. We are looking for a Social Media Executive to run our daily presence across all Gaanchill channels and keep our audience engaged between releases. Responsibilities - Content calendar : Plan and publish daily posts across Facebook, Instagram, YouTube and TikTok, aligned with the release calendar and festive peaks like Eid, Boishakh and Puja. Release campaigns : Execute social rollouts for songs, music videos, drama OSTs and folk projects, including teasers, countdowns, lyric snippets and behind the scenes content. Short-form content : Create and post Reels, Shorts and TikToks using strong hooks from our tracks, and support trends, challenges and creator collaborations. Copywriting : Write clear, catchy captions, titles and descriptions in Bangla and English that suit each platform and artist. Community management : Respond to comments and messages, monitor feedback and flag important issues to the team. Channel upkeep : Maintain YouTube channel health, including thumbnails, playlists, end screens, community posts and metadata. Reporting : Track reach, views, engagement and follower growth using Meta Business Suite, YouTube Studio and TikTok analytics, and share a weekly and monthly summary with insights. Old catalog content : Create posts that bring back older hit tracks, such as throwback posts, acoustic and lo-fi versions and best-of playlists. Brand and sponsor deliverables : Publish sponsored and partner content on time, following brand guidelines and approvals. Team coordination : Work with musicians, video directors, designers and the marketing team to collect assets and meet release targets. Skills & Expertise Content Creation Content writing Digital Marketing (Social Media Marketing) Facebook marketing Instagram Marketing Linkedin marketing Meta Marketing SEO and Digital Marketing YouTube Marketing YouTube SEO Other Relevant Skills Social Media Management Content Creation Copywriting Community management Compensation & Other Benefits Salary : Negotiable, plus two festival bonuses and an annual review. Gaanchill is a leading music label, production house and mobile content provider in Bangladesh. Across our wings Gaanchill Music, Gaanchill Drama & Cinema and Gaanchill Folk, we produce original songs, drama soundtracks, films and mobile entertainment for audiences at home and abroad.
We are looking for a Social Media Executive to run our daily presence across all Gaanchill channels and keep our audience engaged between releases.
Responsibilities -
Content calendar : Plan and publish daily posts across Facebook, Instagram, YouTube and TikTok, aligned with the release calendar and festive peaks like Eid, Boishakh and Puja.
Release campaigns : Execute social rollouts for songs, music videos, drama OSTs and folk projects, including teasers, countdowns, lyric snippets and behind the scenes content.
Short-form content : Create and post Reels, Shorts and TikToks using strong hooks from our tracks, and support trends, challenges and creator collaborations.
Copywriting : Write clear, catchy captions, titles and descriptions in Bangla and English that suit each platform and artist.
Community management : Respond to comments and messages, monitor feedback and flag important issues to the team.
Channel upkeep : Maintain YouTube channel health, including thumbnails, playlists, end screens, community posts and metadata.
Reporting : Track reach, views, engagement and follower growth using Meta Business Suite, YouTube Studio and TikTok analytics, and share a weekly and monthly summary with insights.
Old catalog content : Create posts that bring back older hit tracks, such as throwback posts, acoustic and lo-fi versions and best-of playlists.
Brand and sponsor deliverables : Publish sponsored and partner content on time, following brand guidelines and approvals.
Team coordination : Work with musicians, video directors, designers and the marketing team to collect assets and meet release targets.

Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Masters Experience At least 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Advertising Technology (AdTech) Startup, BPO/ Data Entry Firm, Business-to-Business (B2B) Software and Services Startup, Consulting Firms, Direct Selling/Marketing Service Company, Event Management, Immigration and Education Consultancy Service, Market Research Firms Additional Requirements Age 20 to 40 years Responsibilities & Context About PlayD8 Ltd PlayD8 Ltd is a UK-based company providing smart offshore staffing solutions to businesses across various industries. We are looking for a results-driven Digital Marketing Manager to lead our digital marketing initiatives, develop effective growth strategies, and drive measurable business results. The ideal candidate must have strong hands-on experience in paid advertising, performance marketing, lead generation, conversion optimisation, and digital growth strategy. The candidate must be well versed with Meta & Google advertisement policies. This role requires a commercially minded professional who can manage advertising campaigns, analyse performance data, optimise marketing budgets, and identify opportunities to increase customer acquisition and business growth. Key Responsibilities Digital Growth Strategy: Develop and implement data-driven digital marketing strategies aligned with business objectives, lead generation targets, and revenue growth. Paid Advertising & Campaign Management: Plan, launch, manage, and optimise advertising campaigns across platforms such as Meta (Facebook and Instagram), Google Ads, LinkedIn, and TikTok. Performance Marketing: Monitor campaign performance, manage advertising budgets, and improve key metrics such as cost per lead (CPL), cost per acquisition (CPA), conversion rate, and return on ad spend (ROAS). Lead Generation: Develop and execute strategies to attract qualified leads, improve lead quality, and increase the efficiency of customer acquisition. Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO): Analyse landing pages, advertising funnels, and user journeys to identify opportunities to improve conversion rates and reduce drop-offs. Campaign Analytics & Reporting: Track, analyse, and report on campaign performance using Google Analytics 4 (GA4), advertising platform analytics, and other relevant tools. Audience Targeting & Retargeting: Build and refine audience segments, implement retargeting strategies, and optimise campaigns based on customer behaviour and engagement. A/B Testing & Experimentation: Conduct structured tests on ad creatives, copy, audience segments, landing pages, and campaign strategies to improve performance. Content & Creative Strategy: Collaborate with content creators, designers, and other team members to develop compelling advertising creatives, messaging, and marketing materials. Social Media Growth: Develop strategies to improve social media reach, engagement, and lead generation across relevant platforms. Competitor & Market Research: Analyse competitors, audience behaviour, market trends, and campaign opportunities to identify areas for growth. Continuous Optimisation: Regularly evaluate campaign results, identify performance gaps, and implement improvements to maximise marketing efficiency and business impact. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with internal teams and relevant stakeholders to ensure marketing activities support wider commercial objectives. Search Engine Optimisation (SEO): To lead our digital marketing strategy and improve our online visibility, organic traffic, and lead generation. The ideal candidate will have proven experience in technical SEO, on-page and off-page optimisation, keyword research, content strategy, backlink building, local SEO, and competitor analysis. Required Skills & Qualifications Minimum 3 years of professional experience in digital marketing, performance marketing, growth marketing, or a closely related field. Proven experience planning, managing, and optimising paid advertising campaigns across multiple digital platforms. Strong hands-on knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads . Demonstrated ability to generate qualified leads and improve campaign performance through data-driven optimisation. Strong understanding of key performance indicators, including CTR, CPC, CPL, CPA, conversion rate, and ROAS. Experience using Google Analytics 4 and advertising platform analytics to monitor performance and generate actionable insights. Good understanding of audience targeting, retargeting, lead funnels, landing page performance, and conversion optimisation. Ability to manage advertising budgets effectively and allocate resources based on campaign performance. Experience conducting A/B tests and using performance data to make informed marketing decisions. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. Excellent communication, organisation, and project management abilities. Ability to work independently, manage multiple campaigns, meet deadlines, and take ownership of measurable results. A proactive, commercially minded approach with a strong focus on continuous improvement and business growth. Preferred Experience Experience working with UK-based or international businesses and audiences. Experience with CRM platforms, marketing automation tools, lead tracking, and campaign attribution. Knowledge of email marketing, remarketing, audience segmentation, and customer lifecycle campaigns. Experience improving landing pages and marketing funnels to increase lead conversion. Familiarity with creative tools such as Canva, Photoshop, or Illustrator for reviewing or supporting advertising creatives. Experience using AI-powered marketing tools to improve campaign planning, analysis, and execution. A portfolio or case studies demonstrating measurable improvements in lead generation, campaign efficiency, conversion rates, customer acquisition costs, or revenue growth. Key Performance Expectations The successful candidate will be expected to contribute to measurable business growth through: Increased volume and quality of qualified leads. Improved paid advertising performance and return on ad spend. More efficient use of marketing budgets. Reduced cost per lead and customer acquisition cost. Improved landing page and lead funnel conversion rates. Stronger campaign performance through testing and optimisation. Improved audience engagement and campaign effectiveness. Clear, data-driven reporting and actionable growth recommendations. Consistent progress towards agreed marketing and business objectives. Requirements Education Bachelor’s degree in finance or accounting Experience At least 1 year The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): NGO Additional Requirements Proven minimum of one year of experience in a finance role in a humanitarian context Responsibilities & Context The Norwegian Refugee Council (NRC) is an independent humanitarian organisation dedicated to protecting the rights of displaced and affected people during crises. NRC delivers high-quality programmes to support people forced to flee, helping them rebuild their lives and establish a new future. It operates across both new and protracted crises across 40 countries. NRC specialises in five core competencies: counselling and legal assistance (ICLA), protection from violence, education, shelter and settlements, and water, sanitation, and hygiene (WASH). These specialised areas enable NRC to respond effectively to the diverse needs of displaced populations. NRC began operations in Bangladesh in 2018 and continues to support Rohingya refugees and vulnerable Bangladeshi communities affected by climate change and displacement. NRC Bangladesh currently implements programs across camps and unions in Ukhiya and Teknaf, with interventions in education, Information, Counselling and Legal Assistance (ICLA), shelter, WASH, and protection. In the Rohingya camps, the NRC manages learning centres, ICLA, and WASH hubs. Responsibilities Managed end-to-end financial operations across Cox’s Bazar operations, including cash and bank management, payment processing, reconciliations, staff advances, petty cash, travel claims, and volunteer payments. Ensured compliance with NRC policies, donor requirements, and Bangladesh VAT and Tax regulations, while maintaining accurate financial records, supporting financial reporting, and ensuring audit readiness and effective financial controls. Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Bachelor’s degree (highly advantageous) in Information Systems, Information Technology, Computer Science or equivalent Experience At least 2 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Training Institutes, Coaching Center Additional Requirements Minimum two years of experience in IT and network related field Excellent speaking and writing skills in English Knowledge of German Language or willingness to learn the language in short span of time Willingness to embrace latest technology und upgrade skills Ability to attend minor repairs of IT-equipment Ability to keep routine records and make reports Good decision-making and problem-solving skills Good interaction with internal and external people / customers Good organizational skills and time management. Excellent communication, interpersonal and teamwork skills Flexibility and readiness to work at odd hours, weekends and under pressure, when required Responsibilities & Context We are looking for a dedicated colleague to join us from 1 November 2026.Remuneration in accordance with the local remuneration scheme of the Goethe-Institut Bangladesh.The Goethe-Institut is the official cultural institute of the Federal Republic of Germany and operating worldwide. We promote knowledge of the German language abroad and foster international cultural co-operation. RESPONSIBILITIES Identification and resolution of all IT and network related issues Create and maintain end-user accounts and mailing lists Provision and management of Hardware, Software and Network infrastructure Perform regular Software and Hardware updates Manage telecommunication and security infrastructure Coordination with Internet Service Provider Provide troubleshooting support for escalated software and hardware problems Install and maintain desktop computer hardware; including computers, monitors, printers, modems, internal cards, and other computer equipment Supervision of IT-inventory and procure offers from external vendors Participation in planning and execution of digital projects Develop standard operating procedures and best practices, including providing written protocols and guidance to end-users Investigate, analyse, and resolve complex hardware problems; perform hardware repairs, maintenance, technical assistance, and support on a range of PC computers and peripherals Performance of other related duties Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Network Administration IT Infrastructure Computer Hardware Maintenance Technical Documentation Workplace Work at office Employment Status Part Time Job Location Dhaka (Dhanmondi)
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

Participation in planning and execution of digital projects

The research team works out of Bangladesh, Australia, Canada, UK, and USA. DataSense client list includes Helvetas, ICT Division, ILO, UNCDF, UNESCAP, UNDP, UNWOMEN, BMZ and other national and international organizations. iSocial partnered with wide-range of national and international organizations including BILS, British Council, Cornell University USA, CSF Sri Lanka, Data and Society USA, Oxfam Bangladesh, Oxford Internet Institute, The Business Standard, University of Edinburgh and so on. JOB OVERVIEW We are seeking an experienced, high-caliber, and forward-thinking research professional to join DataSense as Senior Research Associate (Digital Economy & Governance). This mid-level leadership role requires strong project ownership, advanced expertise in econometric modeling and quantitative/qualitative methodologies, and substantial experience leading research components on digital transformation, platform economy, digital public infrastructure (DPI), data governance, e-services, and technology policy. JOB NATURE AND MODALITY Full-time (Sunday through Thursday) Hybrid modality (4 days in-office, 1 day remote weekly). This may be adjusted based on project requirements. Field visit outside Dhaka may be required SCOPE OF WORK Lead the end-to-end design, conceptualization, and implementation of complex research projects covering digital transformation, e-governance, digital trade, platform economy, DPI, and AI policy frameworks. Serve as lead or co-author for high-impact research publications, working papers, policy briefs, regulatory assessments, and peer-reviewed articles targeting executive, government, and donor audiences. Spearhead business development initiatives by taking a lead role in designing research methodologies, technical frameworks, and financial proposals to win competitive grants and donor tenders. Architect primary research frameworks, oversee CAPI survey instrument designs, build sampling strategies, and supervise quantitative data cleaning and econometric modeling pipelines. Actively build and nurture high-level relationships with key stakeholders, including the ICT Division, government ministries, regulatory authorities, donor organizations (UN, donor agencies), and academic partners. Provide direct technical supervision, quality control, and professional guidance to Research Associates, Junior Researchers, and field teams across research assignments. Represent DataSense and iSocial as a speaker and domain specialist in national and international roundtables, policy dialogues, and academic conferences. Contribute to cross-SBU strategic initiatives (with Junction Bangladesh and iSkill) to integrate data intelligence into broader social enterprise programs. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Data analysis Leadership Proposal Development Research and Development Project Management Compensation & Other Benefits Salary Negotiable (Based on experience and competency) OTHER BENEFITS Subsidies lunch Two festival bonuses yearly Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Anywhere in Bangladesh

ABOUT US:
iSocial is an evidence-driven, for-profit social enterprise conducting impact business. iSocial specializes in data-driven insights, strategic policy advocacy, skills and entrepreneurship development and innovative solutions design.
DataSense is one of the three core strategic business units (SBUs) at iSocial for research and data intelligence. It offers services to corporates, non-profits, and development agencies in Bangladesh and abroad, as well as to the Government of Bangladesh. DataSense conducts systemic research, policy analysis, data collection, data curation, data analytics for operations management, and evidence-based insights to simplify executive and policy decision-making. This has enabled DataSense to grow into a multidisciplinary team of professionals, educated and trained in Bangladesh and abroad. The research team works out of Bangladesh, Australia, Canada, UK, and USA. DataSense client list includes Helvetas, ICT Division, ILO, UNCDF, UNESCAP, UNDP, UNWOMEN, BMZ and other national and international organizations. iSocial partnered with wide-range of national and international organizations including BILS, British Council, Cornell University USA, CSF Sri Lanka, Data and Society USA, Oxfam Bangladesh, Oxford Internet Institute, The Business Standard, University of Edinburgh and so on.
JOB OVERVIEW
We are seeking an experienced, high-caliber, and forward-thinking research professional to join DataSense as Senior Research Associate (Digital Economy & Governance). This mid-level leadership role requires strong project ownership, advanced expertise in econometric modeling and quantitative/qualitative methodologies, and substantial experience leading research components on digital transformation, platform economy, digital public infrastructure (DPI), data governance, e-services, and technology policy.
JOB NATURE AND MODALITY
Full-time (Sunday through Thursday)
Hybrid modality (4 days in-office, 1 day remote weekly). This may be adjusted based on project requirements.
Field visit outside Dhaka may be required
SCOPE OF WORK
Lead the end-to-end design, conceptualization, and implementation of complex research projects covering digital transformation, e-governance, digital trade, platform economy, DPI, and AI policy frameworks.
Serve as lead or co-author for high-impact research publications, working papers, policy briefs, regulatory assessments, and peer-reviewed articles targeting executive, government, and donor audiences.
Spearhead business development initiatives by taking a lead role in designing research methodologies, technical frameworks, and financial proposals to win competitive grants and donor tenders.
Architect primary research frameworks, oversee CAPI survey instrument designs, build sampling strategies, and supervise quantitative data cleaning and econometric modeling pipelines.
Actively build and nurture high-level relationships with key stakeholders, including the ICT Division, government ministries, regulatory authorities, donor organizations (UN, donor agencies), and academic partners.
Provide direct technical supervision, quality control, and professional guidance to Research Associates, Junior Researchers, and field teams across research assignments.
Represent DataSense and iSocial as a speaker and domain specialist in national and international roundtables, policy dialogues, and academic conferences.
Contribute to cross-SBU strategic initiatives (with Junction Bangladesh and iSkill) to integrate data intelligence into broader social enterprise programs.
Other Relevant Skills

Two festival bonuses yearly

raw_source_fields.age: At least 25 years 1–2 years of relevant

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1546562&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelor of Science (BSc) in Applied Statistics and Data Science, Economics, Mass Communication & Journalism Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) Experience At least 1 year The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Manufacturing (FMCG), Group of Companies, Automobile Freshers are also encouraged to apply. Additional Requirements Age At least 25 years 1–2 years of relevant experience in market research, EdTech, digital content, sales or business development. Practical familiarity with AI tools and modern digital applications. Strong research, analytical, writing and communication skills. Experience with online learning platforms, content production or digital marketing will be an advantage. Responsibilities & Context Market Research & Content Development (70%) Conduct market and competitor research to identify customer needs, emerging trends in the Bangladesh economy and potential business opportunities. Analyze industry trends, skill requirements and market insights to support the development of relevant digital learning products. Use modern AI tools to support research, content creation and digital learning product development. Develop, review and refine learning content to ensure accuracy, quality, clarity and a natural, engaging tone. Support the preparation of course materials, scripts, presentations and other digital learning assets. Maintain research databases, content documentation and project progress reports. Business Development & User Acquisition (30%) Support product launches, marketing initiatives and user acquisition activities. Assist in lead generation, sales outreach, customer engagement and prospect follow-up. Identify potential customers, distribution channels and business development opportunities. Support initiatives to convert prospects into registered and paying learners. Track relevant campaign and business development activities to support growth targets. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Market Research Content Development Lead Generation Business Development Compensation & Other Benefits Provident fund,Medical allowance,Mobile bill,Weekly 2 holidays,Performance bonus,Insurance,Profit share,Gratuity Lunch Facilities: Partially Subsidize Salary Review: Yearly Festival Bonus: 2 Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1546796&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) in Human Resource Management Experience At least 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Group of Companies, Retail Store Additional Requirements Age At least 28 years Experience in Retail Fashion Industry will be an advantage. Excellent communication & Interpersonal Skill. People oriented and results driven. Self-driven to work under pressure and self-motivated to take new initiatives. Ability to work independently with minimal supervision. Responsibilities & Context Outlet: Conduct need analysis to identify skill gaps and future learning needs for Outlet staff. Designing, developing, and delivering training programs as per business needs. Stay abreast of the latest trends in learning and development and incorporate best practices into programs. Delivering new Joiner Induction Training. Package Employee Training Module prepare, co-ordinate, prepare training plan and delivering as per management decision. Training budget prepare and settle after training. Monthly Training Report prepare and share with management. Management: Conduct needs analysis to identify skill gaps and future learning needs for management staff. Assist to Develop engaging and effective learning programs, both in-person and online. Implement a variety of learning methods (e.g., coaching, mentoring, e-learning, workshops) to address diverse learning needs. Coordinate with external training providers and manage training logistics. Align training programs with career development and succession planning. Maintain all training documentation & share the report with stakeholder for further plan & Improvement. Performance Management System: Periodical information collection from outlet, analysis, review with stakeholder, take approval from management and declare the winner of Reward & Recognition program. Requirements Education Master of Development Studies (MDS) Experience At least 2 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): NGO Additional Requirements Preferred Experience, Knowledge and/or other Qualifications: Two years’ prior professional experience in international development or a related field. Two years’ prior experience in business development, including bid capture, live bid management, and proposal development and/or project implementation for USAID, DFID, DFAT, EU and/or other major donors, preferably within a World Vision context. Experience in implementing development programmes in one or more of WVB’s core sectors (health, livelihoods and education). Excellent interpersonal skills and high emotional intelligence (EQ). Skills in monitoring and the development of logframes. A sense of humour and the ability to thrive in fast-paced, stressful situations. Competence in using MS Word, MS Excel and PowerPoint. Understanding of USAID, DFID, DFAT and EU policies, priorities and proposal processes. Broad understanding of principled humanitarian action, emergency relief and resilience objectives, and sectors such as shelter and settlements, WASH, food security and livelihoods, humanitarian protection, and health and nutrition. Proven capacity-building, facilitation and training skills. Strong decision-making and conflict-resolution skills. Experience working in a cross-cultural environment, preferably within a South Asian context. Responsibilities & Context Job Purpose The purpose of this position is to work collaboratively with all departments to advance the acquisition of grant revenue by: developing and managing opportunity capture plans; developing bid action plans and managing live bids; coordinating go/no-go assessments; coordinating after-action reviews following submission to improve the bidding process and ability to compete generally; leading teaming strategies and processes (for both prime and sub opportunities) in close collaboration with Programme Development and Quality Assurance (PDQA), Support offices (SOs), South Asia Pacific office (SAPO) and other World Vision (WV) partners; ensuring the production of best-in-class capability statements, and updating the same on a quarterly basis; assisting in the identification of grant funding opportunities; writing key sections of proposals as necessary, including management, executive summary and other non-technical sections; developing and managing compliance matrices for all submissions; leading preparation for bi-weekly Resource Development Unit meetings with the National Director (ND) and Department Leads; and undertaking other responsibilities as required. Key Deliverables: Prepare and manage capture activities for all opportunities. Support resource acquisition and the implementation of Capture Plans, development of Bid Implementation Plans, and execution of live bids. Lead all live bids, ensuring seamless collaboration with SOs and NO partners (PDQA, Finance, People & Culture, etc.). Lead partnering for all opportunities, in close collaboration with PDQA, Finance and SOs. Knowledge management, including but not limited to: preparation and updating of capability statements; critical review of pipeline data accuracy. Key Responsibilities: Capture Oversee direct reports in the development and implementation of capture plans, bid action plans, and the execution of live bids. Prepare capture plans for all opportunities in excess of USD 5,000,000. Ensure capture plans are reviewed and endorsed by all internal partners and SOs. Manage capture plans and update them on a weekly basis for presentation at the weekly BD meeting. Resolve any complications or delays experienced during the capture process. Report on the progress of capture plans at all bi-weekly BD meetings with the ND, SDO, and other Department Leads. Bid Management Lead Go/No-Go process, launched within 24 hours of solicitation drop date, working alongside where appropriate with Business Development Managers. Develop Bid Action Plans (BAPs) for all live opportunities. Manage BAPs to ensure seamless collaboration among SOs, the NO, partners, and external bid partners (subs and primes). Develop and manage bid compliance matrices in close collaboration with SOs and all relevant internal partners. Conduct after-action reviews of all bids within 24 hours of submission. Ensure consistent support to Response and Humanitarian and Emergency Affairs (HEA) teams, providing surge support whenever needed. Knowledge Management Lead the production and dissemination of best-in-class capability statements for all technical areas, as well as one-page overviews, contributing as first author wherever necessary and appropriate. Work closely with the Communications Department to ensure full compliance with branding requirements. Custom build cape statements for specific opportunities, donors, visitors etc. as required. Review pipeline (opportunity) data to assure accuracy in advance of bi-weekly Business Development meetings. Coordinate closely with BD Analysts to ensure the status of bids (won, lost or pending) is communicated in real time. Professional & Personal Development Demonstrate an increasing understanding of and commitment to World Vision’s Core Values in the approach to work and relationships. Complete performance reviews and achieve personal development goals. Participate in training related to grant acquisition, as feasible and appropriate. Gain experience in giving and receiving feedback using the SBI model or other appropriate tools, and practise this regularly with all colleagues. Compensation & Other Benefits Provident fund,Medical allowance,Mobile bill,Weekly 2 holidays,Gratuity,Insurance Festival Bonus: 1 As per organisational policy.
