Responsibilities & Context
Job Purpose
The purpose of this position is to work collaboratively with all departments to advance the acquisition of grant revenue by: developing and managing opportunity capture plans; developing bid action plans and managing live bids; coordinating go/no-go assessments; coordinating after-action reviews following submission to improve the bidding process and ability to compete generally; leading teaming strategies and processes (for both prime and sub opportunities) in close collaboration with Programme Development and Quality Assurance (PDQA), Support offices (SOs), South Asia Pacific office (SAPO) and other World Vision (WV) partners; ensuring the production of best-in-class capability statements, and updating the same on a quarterly basis; assisting in the identification of grant funding opportunities; writing key sections of proposals as necessary, including management, executive summary and other non-technical sections; developing and managing compliance matrices for all submissions; leading preparation for bi-weekly Resource Development Unit meetings with the National Director (ND) and Department Leads; and undertaking other responsibilities as required.
Key Deliverables:
Prepare and manage capture activities for all opportunities.
Support resource acquisition and the implementation of Capture Plans, development of Bid Implementation Plans, and execution of live bids.
Lead all live bids, ensuring seamless collaboration with SOs and NO partners (PDQA, Finance, People & Culture, etc.).
Lead partnering for all opportunities, in close collaboration with PDQA, Finance and SOs.
Knowledge management, including but not limited to: preparation and updating of capability statements; critical review of pipeline data accuracy.
Key Responsibilities:
Capture
Oversee direct reports in the development and implementation of capture plans, bid action plans, and the execution of live bids.
Prepare capture plans for all opportunities in excess of USD 5,000,000.
Ensure capture plans are reviewed and endorsed by all internal partners and SOs.
Manage capture plans and update them on a weekly basis for presentation at the weekly BD meeting.
Resolve any complications or delays experienced during the capture process.
Report on the progress of capture plans at all bi-weekly BD meetings with the ND, SDO, and other Department Leads.
Bid Management
Lead Go/No-Go process, launched within 24 hours of solicitation drop date, working alongside where appropriate with Business Development Managers.
Develop Bid Action Plans (BAPs) for all live opportunities.
Manage BAPs to ensure seamless collaboration among SOs, the NO, partners, and external bid partners (subs and primes).
Develop and manage bid compliance matrices in close collaboration with SOs and all relevant internal partners.
Conduct after-action reviews of all bids within 24 hours of submission.
Ensure consistent support to Response and Humanitarian and Emergency Affairs (HEA) teams, providing surge support whenever needed.
Knowledge Management
Lead the production and dissemination of best-in-class capability statements for all technical areas, as well as one-page overviews, contributing as first author wherever necessary and appropriate.
Work closely with the Communications Department to ensure full compliance with branding requirements.
Custom build cape statements for specific opportunities, donors, visitors etc. as required.
Review pipeline (opportunity) data to assure accuracy in advance of bi-weekly Business Development meetings.
Coordinate closely with BD Analysts to ensure the status of bids (won, lost or pending) is communicated in real time.
Professional & Personal Development
Demonstrate an increasing understanding of and commitment to World Vision’s Core Values in the approach to work and relationships.
Complete performance reviews and achieve personal development goals.
Participate in training related to grant acquisition, as feasible and appropriate.
Gain experience in giving and receiving feedback using the SBI model or other appropriate tools, and practise this regularly with all colleagues.
Compensation & Other Benefits
As per organisational policy.

Responsibilities & Context Industry: Plastic Recycling & Manufacturing (Plastic Dana) Job Location: Factory - Amtola, Kathgora, Ashulia, Dhaka About Us: A1 Plastics OPC is a growing plastic recycling and manufacturing company. Maintain bank transactions and bank reconciliation. Preserve all documents and files properly for audit. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Accounting Financial Reporting Financial Analysis Tally Software Compensation & Other Benefits Salary Review: Yearly Salary: Negotiable / BDT 20,000 - 28,000 (Based on Experience & Skills) As per company policy. Responsibilities & Context Context: Responsible for supporting and executing commercial operations, local and international procurement, supply chain logistics, customs clearance, and vendor contract administration across all phases of utility-scale solar IPP projects. Baraka InfraCo Solar Power Limited is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. Job Responsibility: Procurement & Sourcing Execution: Assist in preparing Requests for Quotation (RFQ), bidding documents, commercial evaluation matrices, and purchase orders (PO) for local and international solar equipment, civil materials, and site services. Requirements Education BBA/MBA in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline from a recognized public university or a reputed private university, such as NSU, BRAC University, IUB, or AIUB. CA Course Completed (CA CC), CMA (Partly Qualified), ACCA (Partly Qualified), or other relevant professional qualifications will be considered an advantage. Experience 2 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Group of Companies Additional Requirements Age At most 33 years Only Male 2-3 years of relevant experience in accounts and finance. Experience in a group of companies, sports and recreation facilities, hospitality, entertainment, retail, property management, or other relevant businesses will be preferred. Responsibilities & Context Maintain complete day-to-day accounts, including sales, purchases, receipts, payments, expenses, journals, vouchers, and ledgers. Complete month-end and year-end closing activities, including accruals, prepayments, depreciation, adjustments, and ledger reconciliations. Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements, including the Income Statement, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow Statement, with supporting schedules. Assist in preparing annual budgets, forecasts, and cash flow projections; monitor actual performance against budgets and explain significant variances. Maintain and reconcile cash and bank accounts regularly, investigate differences, and follow up on outstanding reconciling items. Manage customer receivables and supplier payables; prepare ageing reports, follow up on collections, and arrange payment schedules for approval. Maintain accurate billing and accounting for memberships, facility bookings, rent, service charges, events, sponsorships, and other operating revenue. Reconcile POS sales and cash, card, bank, and digital collections with operational records; review discounts, cancellations, refunds, and settlement differences. Collect, verify, and reconcile accounting records from different operating units with central accounts, including inter-unit and intercompany balances. Reconcile accounting records with inventory and stock records; investigate discrepancies and support periodic physical verification. Maintain fixed asset registers and account for asset additions, disposals, depreciation, and capital expenditure. Verify supplier bills, vouchers, purchase orders, goods received notes, service confirmations, and supporting documents before submitting payments for approval. Prepare tax and VAT workings, including applicable deductions at source; assist with timely deposits, returns, reconciliations, and maintenance of statutory records. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly management reports covering revenue, expenses, profitability, cash position, receivables, payables, and budget performance. Support internal and external audits, provide required schedules and documents, and follow up on audit observations. Maintain organized financial records and ensure compliance with company policies, approval limits, and internal controls. Promptly report unusual transactions, accounting errors, financial discrepancies, and unresolved outstanding items to the reporting supervisor. Skills & Expertise Accounting Accounting Software Accounts and Finance Other Relevant Skills Financial accounting Financial Reporting Bank Reconciliation Accounts Payable Receivable Compensation & Other Benefits Gratuity Lunch Facilities: Partially Subsidize Festival Bonus: 2 Leave as per Bangladesh Labor Law. jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1546813&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Master of Development Studies (MDS) Experience At least 2 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): NGO Additional Requirements Preferred Experience, Knowledge and/or other Qualifications: Two years’ prior professional experience in international development or a related field. Two years’ prior experience in business development, including bid capture, live bid management, and proposal development and/or project implementation for USAID, DFID, DFAT, EU and/or other major donors, preferably within a World Vision context. Experience in implementing development programmes in one or more of WVB’s core sectors (health, livelihoods and education). Excellent interpersonal skills and high emotional intelligence (EQ). Skills in monitoring and the development of logframes. A sense of humour and the ability to thrive in fast-paced, stressful situations. Competence in using MS Word, MS Excel and PowerPoint. Understanding of USAID, DFID, DFAT and EU policies, priorities and proposal processes. Broad understanding of principled humanitarian action, emergency relief and resilience objectives, and sectors such as shelter and settlements, WASH, food security and livelihoods, humanitarian protection, and health and nutrition. Proven capacity-building, facilitation and training skills. Strong decision-making and conflict-resolution skills. Experience working in a cross-cultural environment, preferably within a South Asian context. Responsibilities & Context Job Purpose The purpose of this position is to work collaboratively with all departments to advance the acquisition of grant revenue by: developing and managing opportunity capture plans; developing bid action plans and managing live bids; coordinating go/no-go assessments; coordinating after-action reviews following submission to improve the bidding process and ability to compete generally; leading teaming strategies and processes (for both prime and sub opportunities) in close collaboration with Programme Development and Quality Assurance (PDQA), Support offices (SOs), South Asia Pacific office (SAPO) and other World Vision (WV) partners; ensuring the production of best-in-class capability statements, and updating the same on a quarterly basis; assisting in the identification of grant funding opportunities; writing key sections of proposals as necessary, including management, executive summary and other non-technical sections; developing and managing compliance matrices for all submissions; leading preparation for bi-weekly Resource Development Unit meetings with the National Director (ND) and Department Leads; and undertaking other responsibilities as required. Key Deliverables: Prepare and manage capture activities for all opportunities. Support resource acquisition and the implementation of Capture Plans, development of Bid Implementation Plans, and execution of live bids. Lead all live bids, ensuring seamless collaboration with SOs and NO partners (PDQA, Finance, People & Culture, etc.). Lead partnering for all opportunities, in close collaboration with PDQA, Finance and SOs. Knowledge management, including but not limited to: preparation and updating of capability statements; critical review of pipeline data accuracy. Key Responsibilities: Capture Oversee direct reports in the development and implementation of capture plans, bid action plans, and the execution of live bids. Prepare capture plans for all opportunities in excess of USD 5,000,000. Ensure capture plans are reviewed and endorsed by all internal partners and SOs. Manage capture plans and update them on a weekly basis for presentation at the weekly BD meeting. Resolve any complications or delays experienced during the capture process. Report on the progress of capture plans at all bi-weekly BD meetings with the ND, SDO, and other Department Leads. Bid Management Lead Go/No-Go process, launched within 24 hours of solicitation drop date, working alongside where appropriate with Business Development Managers. Develop Bid Action Plans (BAPs) for all live opportunities. Manage BAPs to ensure seamless collaboration among SOs, the NO, partners, and external bid partners (subs and primes). Develop and manage bid compliance matrices in close collaboration with SOs and all relevant internal partners. Conduct after-action reviews of all bids within 24 hours of submission. Ensure consistent support to Response and Humanitarian and Emergency Affairs (HEA) teams, providing surge support whenever needed. Knowledge Management Lead the production and dissemination of best-in-class capability statements for all technical areas, as well as one-page overviews, contributing as first author wherever necessary and appropriate. Work closely with the Communications Department to ensure full compliance with branding requirements. Custom build cape statements for specific opportunities, donors, visitors etc. as required. Review pipeline (opportunity) data to assure accuracy in advance of bi-weekly Business Development meetings. Coordinate closely with BD Analysts to ensure the status of bids (won, lost or pending) is communicated in real time. Professional & Personal Development Demonstrate an increasing understanding of and commitment to World Vision’s Core Values in the approach to work and relationships. Complete performance reviews and achieve personal development goals. Participate in training related to grant acquisition, as feasible and appropriate. Gain experience in giving and receiving feedback using the SBI model or other appropriate tools, and practise this regularly with all colleagues. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Bid Management Knowledge Management Compensation & Other Benefits Provident fund,Medical allowance,Mobile bill,Weekly 2 holidays,Gratuity,Insurance Festival Bonus: 1 As per organisational policy. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka

Requirements Education BBA/MBA in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline from a recognized public university or a reputed private university, such as NSU, BRAC University, IUB, or AIUB. Experience 1 to 2 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Group of Companies Additional Requirements Age At most 31 years Only Male 1-2 years of relevant experience in accounting, billing, collections, accounts receivable, or accounts payable. Experience in a group of companies, sports facilities, hospitality, entertainment, retail, property management, or other service businesses will be preferred. Practical knowledge of accounting or ERP software, POS systems, and Microsoft Excel. Responsibilities & Context Handle accounting and billing for memberships, facility bookings, rent, service charges, events, sponsorships, and POS sales. Prepare invoices according to approved rates, agreements, packages, and payment schedules. Record collections and reconcile cash, card, bank, and digital payments with billing and operational records. Maintain customer and tenant ledgers, monitor outstanding balances, and follow up on overdue payments. Account for advance receipts, security deposits, cancellations, refunds, and approved adjustments. Verify supplier invoices against purchase orders, goods received notes, service confirmations, and approved contracts. Prepare payment vouchers and supplier payment schedules, ensuring proper documentation and authorization. Reconcile customer, tenant, supplier, and bank accounts and resolve discrepancies promptly. Prepare revenue schedules, receivable and payable ageing reports, collection summaries, and event profitability statements. Support applicable VAT and tax deductions, record maintenance, and statutory reporting. Assist with month-end closing, accruals, financial reporting, and internal and external audits. Ensure compliance with company policies and internal controls, maintain complete accounting records, and coordinate with relevant departments. Skills & Expertise Accounts and Finance Other Relevant Skills Billing Invoicing Accounts Receivables Bank Reconciliation Financial Reporting VAT Compliance Compensation & Other Benefits Gratuity Lunch Facilities: Partially Subsidize Festival Bonus: 2 Leave as per Bangladesh Labor Law. Other benefits as per Company Policy. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Job Location Dhaka
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

Requirements Additional Requirements Only Male Responsibilities & Context A reputed group of companies is looking for a competent, proactive, and experienced Senior Executive/ Assistant Manager – HR & Admin to manage day-to-day HR and administrative operations. The ideal candidate should have substantial hands-on experience in core HR functions, employee management, office administration, and labour law compliance. The candidate must be capable of working independently, ensuring smooth operations, and effectively implementing company policies and procedures. Key Responsibilities Manage recruitment, selection, onboarding, separation, confirmation, transfer, promotion, resignation, and HR documentation. Maintain employee records, personal files, HR databases, attendance, and leave records. Coordinate payroll inputs, performance appraisals, training, and employee development. Implement HR policies, service rules, and disciplinary procedures; resolve employee grievances and ensure labour law compliance. Oversee office administration, maintenance, housekeeping, security, and facility management. Manage office supplies, assets, vehicles, logistics, and administrative expenses. Supervise support staff and coordinate with vendors, service providers, and relevant authorities. Arrange meetings, official events, and travel; maintain administrative records and ensure workplace safety, discipline, and cleanliness. Prepare HR & Admin reports and perform other duties assigned by management. Candidate Qualifications & Experience Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field is required; a master’s degree will be considered an additional advantage. Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in HR & general Administration. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint. Candidates holding professional certifications in HRM, Bangladesh Labour Law, Payroll Management, or relevant HR & Administration fields will be given preference. Strong organizational, coordination, and multitasking abilities. Ability to identify solutions, work independently, meet deadlines, and manage multiple responsibilities effectively. Important Note: Candidates must have substantial, hands-on experience across core HR and Administrative functions. Applicants with only academic qualifications or limited exposure without practical, in-depth HR & Admin experience are strongly discouraged from applying. Skills & Expertise Factory HR Administration Factory Administration Factory Operation Human Resources Administration Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

Financial Planning & Analysis: Budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, unit economics, and cash flow modeling. Responsibilities & Context Job Location: House 67, Block – KA, Pici-culture Housing Society, Shyamoli, Dhaka - 1207 About Ambala Fintech Limited Ambala Fintech Limited is a technology-driven financial services company focused on delivering innovative, accessible, and sustainable financial solutions through digital platforms. By combining technology, financial expertise, and operational excellence, the company aims to expand financial inclusion, strengthen digital financial services, and create long-term value for customers and business partners across Bangladesh. Role Overview Ambala Fintech Limited is looking for a highly analytical and strategically minded Credit Analyst to lead financial planning, portfolio performance analysis, financial modeling, and strategic decision support. This is a strategic finance role that goes beyond traditional accounting and bookkeeping. The successful candidate will translate financial and operational data into actionable insights to support business growth, credit risk management, pricing decisions, capital allocation, and profitability. The role will work closely with management, business operations, and credit/risk teams to strengthen financial performance, improve portfolio quality, and support sustainable business expansion. Key Responsibilities Credit Portfolio & Financial Analytics Develop and maintain default curves and credit loss forecasts. Monitor delinquency, default rates, recoveries, write-offs, and portfolio profitability. Analyze loan-level and customer-level data to identify portfolio risks, performance trends, and opportunities for improvement. Recommend data-driven strategies to improve portfolio quality, collection efficiency, and risk-adjusted returns. Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) Lead annual budgeting, roll forecasts, financial planning, and variance analysis. Develop and maintain integrated financial models covering revenue, operating costs, unit economics, cash flow, and profitability. Prepare financial projections and scenario analyses to support business planning and management decisions. Evaluate the financial feasibility of new products, business channels, strategic partnerships, and market expansion initiatives. Credit Risk & Underwriting Support Collaborate with credit and operations teams to assess and improve underwriting policies, credit limits, and customer eligibility criteria. Conduct sensitivity and scenario analyses to evaluate the financial impact of credit policy changes. Monitor portfolio performance against approved risk policies and recommend corrective actions. Assess the relationship between customer acquisition, repayment behavior, default risk, and overall profitability. Capital Planning & Management Reporting Forecast capital requirements based on business growth, financing needs, and portfolio origination plans. Prepare financial and portfolio performance reports for senior management, the Board of Directors, lenders, and investors. Support fundraising initiatives, financing arrangements, financial due diligence, and covenant monitoring where applicable. Develop dashboards and reporting frameworks to improve financial transparency and decision-making. Ambala Fintech Limited is a technology-driven financial services company focused on delivering innovative, accessible, and sustainable financial solutions through digital platforms. By combining technology, financial expertise, and operational excellence, the company aims to expand financial inclusion, strengthen digital financial services, and create long-term value for customers and business partners across Bangladesh.
Role Overview
Ambala Fintech Limited is looking for a highly analytical and strategically minded Credit Analyst to lead financial planning, portfolio performance analysis, financial modeling, and strategic decision support.
This is a strategic finance role that goes beyond traditional accounting and bookkeeping. The successful candidate will translate financial and operational data into actionable insights to support business growth, credit risk management, pricing decisions, capital allocation, and profitability.
The role will work closely with management, business operations, and credit/risk teams to strengthen financial performance, improve portfolio quality, and support sustainable business expansion.

Credit Portfolio & Financial Analytics
Develop and maintain default curves and credit loss forecasts.
Monitor delinquency, default rates, recoveries, write-offs, and portfolio profitability.
Analyze loan-level and customer-level data to identify portfolio risks, performance trends, and opportunities for improvement.
Recommend data-driven strategies to improve portfolio quality, collection efficiency, and risk-adjusted returns.
Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)
Lead annual budgeting, roll forecasts, financial planning, and variance analysis.
Develop and maintain integrated financial models covering revenue, operating costs, unit economics, cash flow, and profitability.
Prepare financial projections and scenario analyses to support business planning and management decisions.
Evaluate the financial feasibility of new products, business channels, strategic partnerships, and market expansion initiatives.

Collaborate with credit and operations teams to assess and improve underwriting policies, credit limits, and customer eligibility criteria.
Conduct sensitivity and scenario analyses to evaluate the financial impact of credit policy changes.
Monitor portfolio performance against approved risk policies and recommend corrective actions.
Assess the relationship between customer acquisition, repayment behavior, default risk, and overall profitability.

Forecast capital requirements based on business growth, financing needs, and portfolio origination plans.
Prepare financial and portfolio performance reports for senior management, the Board of Directors, lenders, and investors.
Support fundraising initiatives, financing arrangements, financial due diligence, and covenant monitoring where applicable.
Develop dashboards and reporting frameworks to improve financial transparency and decision-making.

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1546810&fc.source_content: Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a recognized university; a background in Education, Business, Social Science or English is preferred. A degree from a foreign university is an added advantage. Experience 1 to 3 years Additional Requirements Experience Requirements 1-3 years of experience in study-abroad consultancy, admissions, visa processing or research. Freshers with strong research skills and good knowledge of international education may also apply. Skills & Competencies Strong research and analytical skills, with an eye for detail and accuracy. Excellent written and spoken English and Bangla. Good knowledge of global higher education systems and student visa procedures. Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and Google Workspace; ability to build and maintain databases. Ability to organise large amounts of information clearly and present it simply. Self-motivated, organised and able to meet deadlines. Good communication and teamwork skills. Responsibilities & Context HAI Education is hiring a Research & Development Specialist to be the team's go-to source on admission requirements, student visa rules and universities abroad. Position Overview Job title: Research & Development Specialist Department: Research & Development Reports to - Managing Director / Head of Operations The specialist researches and tracks admission processes, country-wise student visa procedures and university information, and keeps that knowledge accurate and up to date so counsellors can give students correct, current advice. Key Responsibilities Admission Process Research Research and document admission requirements for undergraduate, postgraduate, diploma and foundation programs in priority destination countries. Track intakes, application deadlines, entry requirements (academic results, IELTS/TOEFL/PTE/Duolingo, GRE/GMAT/SAT), application fees and required documents. Monitor changes to admission policies, gap-year acceptance, credit transfer and scholarship criteria. Prepare step-by-step admission guides and checklists for counsellors and students. Visa Processing Research (Country-wise) Research and maintain current student visa procedures for each destination (e.g. UK, Europe, Australia, New Zealand, Malaysia, South Korea and others served by HAI Education). Track visa requirements: financial proof, sponsorship, bank statements, CAS/I-20/CoE/LOA, health checks, biometrics, interviews, processing times and fees. Follow embassy, high commission and immigration website updates, and alert the team immediately to any policy change. Track post-study work rights, dependent rules, part-time work limits and refusal trends. Maintain country-wise visa checklists and document templates for the processing team. University Research Build and maintain a database of universities and colleges: rankings, programs, tuition fees, living costs, scholarships, intakes and location. Identify suitable institutions and programs that match different student profiles and budgets. Research partner and prospective partner institutions, including commission structures and agent agreements, to support business development. Compare universities by quality, cost, employability outcomes and visa success rates. Knowledge Management & Team Support Keep a central, regularly updated knowledge base (country profiles, university lists, visa and admission guides). Share a weekly update on key changes in admissions and visa policy with management and counsellors. Train and brief counsellors on new destinations, programs and procedures. Answer complex student or counsellor queries that need in-depth research. Support marketing with accurate content for brochures, social media posts, seminars and the website. Development & Market Insight Identify new study destinations, programs and opportunities for HAI Education to expand its services. Analyze market trends, competitor offerings and student demand in Bangladesh. Recommend improvements to internal processes, checklists and tools. Attend webinars, education fairs and university training sessions to stay current. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Market Research Database management Google workspace Compensation & Other Benefits Salary: BDT 20,000 - 35,000 per month (Based on Expertise) Festival bonuses: 2 per year Performance-based incentives Training and professional development, including university and embassy workshops Friendly and growth-focused work environment Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka (Banglamotor)

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1546932&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education A bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Digital Marketing, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is preferred. Relevant professional certifications in performance marketing, digital advertising, marketing analytics, AI content production, or marketing automation will be an advantage. Formal academic qualifications are secondary to demonstrable hands-on expertise, a strong portfolio, and verifiable business results. Candidates with exceptional practical skills and proven experience may be considered regardless of their academic background. Experience At most 1 year The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Manufacturing (Light Engineering and Heavy Industry) Additional Requirements Minimum 0-1 years of hardcore hands-on experience in performance marketing, social media scaling, and funnel building (experience in Healthcare, Medical Devices, Pharmaceuticals, or B2B Tech is a massive advantage). No "Boost Post" Marketers: If your idea of Facebook marketing is clicking the "Boost" button from the page, do not apply. You must live and breathe Meta Ads Manager, Custom Audiences, Pixel/CAPI tracking, and A/B testing. AI-Native Workflow: Must have advanced proficiency in leveraging AI tools (Midjourney, Claude, Gemini, Runway/Kling, ElevenLabs) to produce ultra-high-resolution product visuals, 3D-style medical animations, and persuasive technical copy at 10x speed. Ability to understand and translate complex medical/surgical specifications (e.g., orthopedic casting tapes, surgical antiseptics, OT equipment, diagnostic machines) into clear, high-converting visual stories for doctors, procurement officers, and hospital management. Paid Media Mastery: Meta Ads Manager (Pixel, Conversion API, Lookalike Audiences, Lead Forms, Catalog Sales), TikTok Ads, Google Search/Display Ads, and LinkedIn B2B Outreach. Visual & Video Engineering: Advanced command over Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro / CapCut Pro, Canva Pro, and AI Image/Video generation prompting for studio-grade product rendering. Content & Hook Psychology: Deep understanding of 3-second video hooks, educational storytelling, clinical demonstration framing, and B2B trust-building architectures. Automation & Operations: Meta Business Suite bulk workflows, Google Sheets data organization, WhatsApp Business automation, and basic landing page/funnel optimization. Responsibilities & Context About the Role M/S Ocean Enterprise is a leading supplier of specialized medical equipment and surgical consumables. We are looking for a one-person digital powerhouse to take complete ownership of our digital ecosystem across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and YouTube Shorts. Your mission is simple but demanding: transform our social channels from basic product catalogs into high-authority lead-generation engines within 6 months. You will bridge the gap between technical medical superiority and aggressive digital distribution. Responsibilities Omnichannel Ecosystem Management: Build, optimize, and scale M/S Ocean Enterprise’s presence across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn with platform-specific content strategies. High-Converting Content Production: Script, design, and edit scroll-stopping static graphics, carousels, and short-form video reels/TikToks showcasing product mechanisms, clinical benefits, and usage demonstrations of our medical machines and surgical consumables. Bulk Automation & Scheduling: Architect a streamlined content pipeline using Google Sheets, Canva/Adobe Suite, and Meta Business Suite to bulk-create and schedule 30 to 60 days of strategic content in advance without sacrificing quality. Precision B2B & Doctor-Targeted Paid Ads: Set up and scale advanced Meta & TikTok ad campaigns focusing on Lead Generation, WhatsApp/Messenger conversion, and Retargeting. Build hyper-targeted funnels specifically aimed at surgeons, medical college procurement heads, clinic owners, and wholesale distributors across Bangladesh. Technical Copywriting & Localization: Write authoritative, medically accurate, yet commercially persuasive copy in both English and Bengali that addresses the pain points of healthcare professionals (durability, patient safety, cost-efficiency, certification). Lead Funnel & CRM Integration: Design automated response workflows (ManyChat / WhatsApp Business API) so that every comment, inbox query, or lead form submission from a doctor or hospital is instantly captured, qualified, and routed to our Sales & Service Engineers. Data Analytics & Competitors' Spying: Track weekly KPIs (Cost Per Lead, ROAS, Hook Rate, Hold Rate, Engagement Rate), monitor competitor ad libraries, and pivot strategies aggressively to dominate market share within 180 days. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Anywhere in Bangladesh

Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Experience At least 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Real Estate Responsibilities & Context জব কনটেক্সট: রিয়েল এস্টেট একটি গতিশীল খাত, যেখানে রয়েছে ক্যারিয়ারে উন্নতি, সফলতা অর্জন এবং দীর্ঘমেয়াদে পেশাগত দক্ষতা বিকাশের সুযোগ। জেদ্দা হাউজিং লিমিটেডে যোগ দিয়ে একটি সম্ভাবনাময় ও মর্যাদাপূর্ণ খাতে নিজের ক্যারিয়ার গড়ে তুলুন, যেখানে আপনার দক্ষতা, কাজের পারফরম্যান্স ও আগ্রহ আপনাকে আরও এগিয়ে নিতে পারে। দায়িত্বসমূহ : প্রতিষ্ঠানের আবাসন প্রকল্পের প্লট বিক্রয়ের লক্ষ্যমাত্রা অর্জন করা। সম্ভাব্য গ্রাহক সংগ্রহ এবং প্লট ক্রয়ের বিষয়ে আগ্রহী গ্রাহকদের সঙ্গে যোগাযোগ ও ফলোআপ করা। গ্রাহকদের প্লটের অবস্থান, মূল্য, কিস্তি সুবিধা ও অন্যান্য শর্তাবলি সম্পর্কে বিস্তারিত তথ্য প্রদান করা। গ্রাহকদের প্রকল্প সাইট পরিদর্শনের ব্যবস্থা করা এবং প্লট বুকিং ও বিক্রয় কার্যক্রম সম্পন্ন করতে সহায়তা করা। বাজার পরিস্থিতি বিশ্লেষণ করে নতুন গ্রাহক তৈরি এবং বিক্রয় বৃদ্ধির উদ্যোগ গ্রহণ করা। নির্ধারিত বিক্রয় লক্ষ্যমাত্রা অর্জন এবং নিয়মিত বিক্রয় প্রতিবেদন প্রদান করা। Skills & Expertise Communication and interpersonal skill Real Estate Marketing Strategic Planning Target Achievement Compensation & Other Benefits বার্ষিক উৎসব বোনাস পারফরম্যান্সভিত্তিক ইনসেনটিভ কাজের পারফরম্যান্সের ভিত্তিতে পদোন্নতির সুযোগ কোম্পানির নীতিমালা অনুযায়ী অন্যান্য সুযোগ-সুবিধা Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Gazipur (Sreepur)

Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Experience At least 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Real Estate Responsibilities & Context জব কনটেক্সট: রিয়েল এস্টেট একটি গতিশীল খাত, যেখানে রয়েছে ক্যারিয়ারে উন্নতি, সফলতা অর্জন এবং দীর্ঘমেয়াদে পেশাগত দক্ষতা বিকাশের সুযোগ। জেদ্দা হাউজিং লিমিটেডে যোগ দিয়ে একটি সম্ভাবনাময় ও মর্যাদাপূর্ণ খাতে নিজের ক্যারিয়ার গড়ে তুলুন, যেখানে আপনার দক্ষতা, কাজের পারফরম্যান্স ও আগ্রহ আপনাকে আরও এগিয়ে নিতে পারে। দায়িত্বসমূহ : প্রতিষ্ঠানের আবাসন প্রকল্পের প্লট বিক্রয়ের লক্ষ্যমাত্রা অর্জন করা। সম্ভাব্য গ্রাহক সংগ্রহ এবং প্লট ক্রয়ের বিষয়ে আগ্রহী গ্রাহকদের সঙ্গে যোগাযোগ ও ফলোআপ করা। গ্রাহকদের প্লটের অবস্থান, মূল্য, কিস্তি সুবিধা ও অন্যান্য শর্তাবলি সম্পর্কে বিস্তারিত তথ্য প্রদান করা। গ্রাহকদের প্রকল্প সাইট পরিদর্শনের ব্যবস্থা করা এবং প্লট বুকিং ও বিক্রয় কার্যক্রম সম্পন্ন করতে সহায়তা করা। বাজার পরিস্থিতি বিশ্লেষণ করে নতুন গ্রাহক তৈরি এবং বিক্রয় বৃদ্ধির উদ্যোগ গ্রহণ করা। নির্ধারিত বিক্রয় লক্ষ্যমাত্রা অর্জন এবং নিয়মিত বিক্রয় প্রতিবেদন প্রদান করা। Skills & Expertise Communication and interpersonal skill Real Estate Marketing Strategic Planning Target Achievement Compensation & Other Benefits বার্ষিক উৎসব বোনাস পারফরম্যান্সভিত্তিক ইনসেনটিভ কাজের পারফরম্যান্সের ভিত্তিতে পদোন্নতির সুযোগ কোম্পানির নীতিমালা অনুযায়ী অন্যান্য সুযোগ-সুবিধা Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Gazipur (Sreepur)

Educational Requirements
BBA or BCom in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline.

Workplace
Work at office
Employment Status
Full Time
Application
Online
Job Description
Job Summary
Jabbar Jute Mills is looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Accounts Intern to support daily accounting and finance operations. The selected candidate will gain practical experience in bookkeeping, financial documentation, payment processing, reporting and manufacturing accounts.
We are looking for someone comfortable with digital tools, familiar with basic AI-assisted productivity, and eager to learn.
Key Responsibilities
Assist with daily accounting entries and maintain accurate financial records.
Prepare and organize payment vouchers, receipts, invoices and supporting documents.
Assist with accounts payable, accounts receivable and cashbook maintenance.
Help reconcile bank statements, cash balances and ledger entries.
Assist in preparing daily, weekly and monthly financial reports.
Maintain bills, invoices, expense records and accounting documents.
Verify supplier bills, purchase records and payment requests.
Assist with inventory accounting and raw material purchase documentation.
Use Microsoft Excel and accounting software to maintain financial data.
Use AI tools to assist with documentation, spreadsheet tasks, data organization and report drafting.
Verify AI-generated information and calculations against original records.
Coordinate with the Accounts, Purchase, Store and Administration departments.
Perform other tasks assigned by the Accounts Department.
Additional Requirements
Age At least 23 years
Only Male
Experience
Freshers are encouraged to apply.
Previous accounting or internship experience is an advantage.
Additional Requirements
Basic understanding of accounting principles and bookkeeping.
Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office.
Basic AI literacy, including familiarity with tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini or Claude.
Ability to use AI tools for research, documentation, spreadsheet assistance and routine administrative tasks.
Ability to evaluate AI-generated information critically and verify accuracy before use.
Understanding of data privacy and the importance of protecting confidential financial information.
Strong numerical accuracy, analytical thinking and attention to detail.
Honest, disciplined, punctual and willing to learn.
Ability to work full-time at the factory office in Bhairab, Kishoreganj.
Skills: Accounting, Accounting Data Entry, Accounts and Finance, Accounts Payable Receivable, Bank Reconciliation, Bookkeeping, Financial analysis and reporting, Financial Reporting, Microsoft Excel, Reporting and Documentation
Company Address: Bhairab Bazar
Company Business
History: Jabbar Jute Mills Ltd. prides itself for being one of the oldest jute producers in the country. Established in 1965 by JB M. Nasir, under the jurisdiction of the government of Pakistan at the time, it, along with all other jute mills in the country, was converted into a public limited company by the newly formed government of Bangladesh in 1971. Jabbar Jute Mills Ltd was privatized again in 1984. Since then, new leadership has resulted in a flourishing mill, producing various types of finished jute products for the local and international markets. The Mill Based just outside the capital of Bangladesh in Bhairab, the Jabbar Jute Mill spans over 45 acres of land and currently employs over a 1000 people. Capable of producing various types of finished jute products including Hessian and Sacking products, new machinery and improved techniques allow the production of 5,500 MT of product annually, many of which are exported to various parts of the world. Products 2 Inch Heavy Cees, Standard Binola, Standard B. Twill, Hessian Cloth

Job Description
Are you good at English and confident talking to people? Then we’d like to meet you.
We are growing our Dhaka team and looking for smart, confident people who want to start or grow their career in international business development. You don’t need to come from a particular industry. You could be a fresh graduate or at the beginning of your career. If you communicate well, are curious, and are willing to learn, we will train you.
What will you actually do?
You’ll work with international campaigns across the US, UK, Australia and APAC and speak directly with businesses and decision-makers in these markets.
Your day will involve:
Starting conversations with businesses overseas
Speaking with managers, business owners and decision-makers
Understanding their business needs
Introducing the product or service you are representing
Finding genuine business opportunities
Booking qualified meetings
Following up with people you have already spoken with
You won’t be expected to know everything when you join. Training, campaign knowledge and regular coaching will be provided.
You might be a good fit if…
Your spoken English is strong
You enjoy talking to people
You can have a natural conversation without simply reading a script
You are confident enough to speak with someone you’ve never met
You are curious and learn quickly
You can take feedback and improve
You are comfortable working towards targets
You want exposure to an international working environment
Fresh graduates are encouraged to apply. We care more about how you communicate and your potential than what your previous job title was.
What do you get from the role?
Exposure to international markets and businesses
Practical experience in B2B sales and business development
Experience speaking directly with international business professionals
Hands-on training and coaching
Performance-based incentives
Opportunity to grow into Senior BDR and leadership positions
What will success look like?
Once you are trained, your core targets will be:
100 outbound calls per day
5 meaningful business conversations per day
15 attended meetings per month

Working Days: Monday–Friday
Markets: US / UK / Australia / APAC

The first thing we want to understand is simple:
Can you communicate well?

Job Description
Job Context
We are looking for a creative, analytical, and results-driven
Marketing Executive
to plan and execute marketing activities targeting both the
Bangladesh and US markets
.
The main objective of this role is to increase brand awareness, generate qualified leads, support customer acquisition, and improve marketing performance across digital channels.
The ideal candidate should understand how to identify different customer groups, create appropriate marketing strategies for each market, manage campaigns, produce or coordinate marketing content, analyze results, and continuously optimize marketing performance.
Candidates with experience in
digital marketing, lead generation, performance marketing, content marketing, B2B/B2C marketing, SaaS, software, technology, or service businesses
will be preferred.
Job Responsibilities
Plan and execute digital marketing campaigns for Bangladesh and US audiences.
Develop marketing strategies based on company objectives and target customers.
Create different approaches for Bangladesh and US markets where appropriate.
Identify target customers, industries, buyer personas, and potential opportunities.
Conduct market and competitor research.
Generate qualified leads for the sales team.
Manage or support campaigns across:
Google Ads
Meta Ads
Facebook and Instagram
LinkedIn
Email marketing
SEO
Content marketing
Organic social media
Build prospect and lead lists for marketing and outreach campaigns.
Use LinkedIn, Sales Navigator, databases, directories, social media, and other research tools to identify prospects.
Create and manage email-marketing and lead-nurturing campaigns.
Develop or coordinate marketing content including:
Social-media posts
Advertising copy
Email campaigns
Landing pages
Website content
Blog articles
Case studies
Promotional materials
Adapt campaign messaging and content appropriately for Bangladesh and US audiences.
Manage social-media content calendars.
Conduct keyword research and support SEO activities.
Improve website visibility and organic traffic.
Track campaign performance, lead sources, and conversions.
Monitor important marketing KPIs such as:
Leads generated
Qualified leads
Cost per lead
Conversion rate
Cost per acquisition
Website traffic
Engagement
Campaign ROI
Conduct A/B testing and optimize campaigns based on performance.
Use analytics tools to understand what is working and what needs improvement.
Maintain campaign and lead information in CRM or marketing systems.
Work with the sales team to evaluate lead quality.
Compare campaign performance between Bangladesh and US markets.
Prepare regular marketing reports and recommendations.
Research and use new AI, automation, and digital-marketing tools where useful.

Previous experience in
digital marketing, performance marketing, lead generation, SEO, content marketing, social-media marketing, or related marketing work
.
Experience targeting the
Bangladesh market
is valuable.
Experience targeting the
US market
will be an advantage.
Candidates who have worked with both local and overseas audiences will receive preference.
Experience with SaaS, software, technology, B2B services, e-commerce, or professional services will be an advantage.
Additional Requirements
Strong understanding of digital-marketing fundamentals.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Good English writing ability for US-facing marketing.
Ability to create appropriate communication for Bangladeshi audiences.
Understanding of different customer behaviors and target audiences.
Strong research and analytical skills.
Ability to identify and define customer personas.
Comfortable working with marketing data and KPIs.
Experience creating or coordinating marketing content.
Understanding of lead-generation funnels and customer journeys.
Ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines.
Strong attention to detail.
Comfortable learning new marketing and AI tools.
Ability to work independently and collaborate with sales, design, technical, and management teams.

Google Ads

Facebook and Instagram marketing

Google Analytics / GA4
Google Tag Manager
Google Search Console
SEO tools
HubSpot
Salesforce
Zoho CRM
Email-marketing platforms
Marketing-automation tools
Canva
Social-media management tools
Content-management systems
AI-assisted marketing tools

Number of qualified leads generated
Bangladesh-market lead generation
US-market lead generation
Cost per lead
Lead quality
Conversion rates
Website traffic
Organic search growth
Paid-advertising performance
Campaign ROI
Email-marketing performance
Social-media engagement
Content performance
Achievement of marketing targets

Apply by completing the
15-minute AI interview
at
https://shorturl.at/W9iWZ
by
31 October 2026
.

first-come, first-served basis

Only candidates who complete this interview will be considered for shortlisting.

Job Context
We are looking for a curious, detail-oriented Researcher who can find relevant opportunities for our business, check eligibility requirements, and prepare accurate, tailored applications.
Opportunities may include grants, funding programmes, startup competitions, accelerators, tenders, contracts, and partnerships.
Students and recent graduates are welcome. Academic research, freelance work, volunteering, and personal projects can demonstrate relevant skills.
Job Responsibilities
Research official portals and credible sources to identify opportunities relevant to the company’s profile and business needs.
Read full guidelines and check eligibility, including entity type, location, business stage, exclusions, required documents, deadlines, time zones, costs, and submission requirements.
Prepare clear opportunity summaries covering benefits, requirements, official links, and a justified recommendation on whether to apply.
Draft tailored application answers, proposals, and supporting documents using verified company information.
Request missing information rather than inventing claims, achievements, figures, or other details.
Coordinate application reviews and submit applications once authorised. Refer fees, declarations, and commitments to the manager before proceeding.
Maintain a Google Sheets or Excel tracker covering opportunities, eligibility, deadlines, application status, required documents, next actions, and follow-up dates.
Retain submission confirmations, monitor updates, and follow up where appropriate.
Provide concise progress reports and protect confidential company information.
Use AI tools to support research and drafting while checking facts and requirements against original sources.
What Success Looks Like
Finding relevant, verified opportunities.
Making accurate eligibility checks and clear apply/do-not-apply recommendations.
Preparing complete, tailored applications.
Meeting deadlines and maintaining reliable records and follow-up.
Quality, accuracy, and relevance matter more than the number of links collected.

Employment Status
Full Time

Online
Job Description
Job Responsibilities
Sales Auditing: Reconcile daily POS sales, cash receipts, card settlements, and online payment transactions with bank deposits.
Transaction Recording: Record daily sales, cash receipts, and supplier invoices in Tally or other accounting software.
Petty Cash Management: Monitor store petty cash, verify expense receipts, and ensure timely replenishment.
Accounts Payable (AP): Verify supplier invoices against purchase orders and delivery records, maintain payment schedules, and ensure timely payments.
Accounts Receivable (AR): Manage customer credit accounts, wholesale transactions, and corporate billing, where applicable.
Inventory Reconciliation: Reconcile physical stock with book inventory and investigate discrepancies affecting the cost of goods sold (COGS).
Bank Reconciliation: Reconcile bank statements and payment gateway settlements with internal accounting records.
Payroll Processing: Calculate salaries, overtime, and commissions, and ensure accurate payroll deductions and compliance with applicable tax regulations.
Financial Reporting: Prepare monthly Profit and Loss (P&L) statements, balance sheets, and budget variance reports.
VAT & Tax Compliance: Ensure accurate VAT calculations, timely submissions, and compliance with applicable VAT, income tax, and other statutory requirements in Bangladesh.
Budgeting & Forecasting: Assist in preparing operational budgets, cash flow forecasts, and profitability analyses.
Cost & Variance Analysis: Monitor operating expenses, analyze product profit margins, and identify inventory discrepancies and potential financial irregularities.
Audit Support: Maintain accounting records, supporting documents, and financial reports for internal, external, and statutory audits.
Additional Requirements
Age At least 18 years

Standard Islami Bank PLC.
Sales & Recovery Manager-Cards (upto VP)
Application Deadline: Nov 5, 2026
Age: 25 to 45 years
Location: Anywhere in Bangladesh
Salary: Negotiable
Experience: At least 2 years
Published: Oct 19, 2026
Requirements
Education
Masters
Bachelor/Honors
Workplace
Work at office
Employment Status
Full Time
Application
Online
Job Description
A. Card Sales:
Achieve individual and team sales targets for Islamic Credit Cards and Prepaid Cards, as set by management.
Plan and schedule the monthly sales target and visit calendar and track progress against it.
Visit individual and corporate customers to promote and sell Islamic card products.
Identify prospective customers through regular field visits, corporate tie-ups, and the bank’s existing customer base.
Arrange meetings with prospective clients, explain product features, Shariah-compliant structure, and applicable fees, and collect the required documents.
Verify the completeness of applications and documents (KYC, income proof, etc.) before submission and follow up with the processing unit until the card is issued.
Brief and train sales executives on products and services so they have adequate product knowledge.
Develop short- and long-term sales forecasts to support the marketing plan.
Plan strategies for acquiring new business, including campaigns, merchant offers, and corporate partnerships.
Maintain strong relationships with customers and provide excellent after-sales service, such as card activation, limit queries, and complaint resolution.
Prepare field visit and sales reports and present them to management.
B. Card Recovery:
Lead the card recovery team and ensure the collection of monthly installments and overdue amounts from cardholders.
Monitor accounts regularly to identify overdue and long-outstanding dues and classify them by aging.
Review the history of each delinquent card file, including usage, payment pattern, and past contact records.
Contact cardholders by phone, SMS, letter, and personal visit to secure repayment.
Visit defaulting cardholders at their residence or workplace to recover dues.
Negotiate repayment arrangements, such as rescheduling or settlement, within the bank’s policy and Shariah guidelines.
Ensure any late payment charge is handled as per Shariah-approved policy (charity, not bank income), and avoid conventional interest-based terms.
Coordinate with the legal and credit administration units on legal notices and further action for non-responsive accounts.
Prepare a daily time-wise work plan, weekly collection plan, and monthly tour plan, and submit them to the supervisor.
Achieve the collection and delinquency-reduction targets set by management.
Prepare regular recovery reports (collection status, NPL/delinquency ratio, aging analysis) for the manager.
Maintain good relationships with existing and potential customers while carrying out recovery in a professional and ethical manner.
C. Compliance & General:
Follow the bank’s policies, Shariah guidelines, central bank regulations, and anti-money laundering (AML/KYC) requirements.
Keep customer information confidential and use it only for authorized purposes.
Maintain accurate records of all customer interactions, visits, and collections in the system.
Ensure fair, respectful, and ethical dealing with customers, with no harassment or pressure tactics.
Coordinate with the Marketing, Operations, Credit, and Customer Service departments.
Perform any other duties assigned by management.
Additional Requirements
Age 25 to 45 years
No third class/division in any academic record.
Minimum 2 years of experience in card sales and card recovery in any reputed bank or financial institution.
Working knowledge of credit card and prepaid card products, sales processes, and recovery procedures.
Proven ability to meet individual sales and collection targets.
Strong communication and negotiation skills for dealing with customers.
Basic analytical skills, with the ability to read and interpret collection, aging, and delinquency data.
Good relationship-building and customer service skills.
Willingness to do regular field visits for sales and recovery.
Awareness of Shariah principles in Islamic banking, and of AML/KYC and central bank guidelines.
Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) for reports and tracking.
Skills: Bank Card Sales, Client Acquisition, Client Service/ Marketing, Credit card reconsilations, Customer Relationship, Recovery, Sales & Marketing
Compensation & Other Benefits
Provident fund,Mobile bill,Credit card,Gratuity
Festival Bonus: 2
Boishakhi Bonus
Furniture Allowance
Company Address: Metropolitan Chamber Building (3rd Floor), 122-124 Motijheel CA, Dhaka - 1000
Company Business
Bank

Employment Status
Full Time
Application

Job Description
Confidence Infrastructure PLC is starting a new Agri Business that buys processed rice from external millers and distributes it to customers. We are hiring Purchase Officers to handle day-to-day buying under the direction of the Purchase Lead. The work covers talking to suppliers, collecting quotations, issuing purchase orders, following up deliveries and keeping procurement records. The role is based in North Bengal and involves regular visits to millers and suppliers.
Job Responsibilities
Collect quotations and daily price offers from millers and suppliers, and prepare comparative statements.
Visit millers and suppliers in North Bengal to check their stock, capacity and rice quality.
Collect samples before purchase for QC review when needed.
Prepare purchase requisitions and purchase orders for approval, and send approved orders to suppliers.
Follow up with suppliers on delivery schedules, and coordinate transport, lifting and receipt with Logistics, Store and QC.
Check supplier bills, challans and weighment slips, and send them to Accounts for payment.
Follow shortage and quality claims with suppliers until they are settled.
Keep a complete procurement file for every purchase, in line with company procurement policy.
Keep the supplier database and documents up to date, such as the trade licence, food-grain licence, TIN and BIN/VAT certificates.
Share supplier price data with the Purchase Lead and Market Intelligence.
Additional Requirements
Procurement or supply chain work in food, agro or FMCG businesses.
Basic knowledge of rice varieties and quality parameters (moisture, broken percentage, grain size, colour and purity).
Experienced in collecting quotations, preparing comparative statements and processing purchase orders.
Good at following up deliveries and keeping supplier documents in order.
Comfortable with an ERP procurement module, MS Excel and MS Word.
Honest and detail-oriented, follows through on tasks, and communicates and works well with others.
Willing to be based anywhere in North Bengal and to travel often to millers and suppliers.
Compensation & Other Benefits
Provident Fund
Gratuity
Festival Bonus
Earned Leave Encashment
Mobile Bill Allowance
Health Insurance and Life Insurance
Employee Assistance Program (confidential counselling)
Wellness and self-development resources (company library)
Weekly holiday: 1 day (6-day work week)

Job Description
KNOWLEDGE HUB INSTITUTE TRUST (KHI Trust)
POLICY•INFO•INTEL•DECEN
Program Associate (Finance & Accounts)
Reports To:
Deputy Director, Finance
The Knowledge Hub Institute Trust (KHIT) is a results-oriented think and do tank that turns complex policy challenges into practical, evidence-based solutions, working across its six core thematic Research Units — Energy & Climate, Fiscal Justice, Business & Human Rights, Business Climate, Social Justice, and AI & Digitization — to strengthen institutions and drive inclusive impact in Bangladesh. KHI invites applications from accomplished finance and account professionals for the position of Program Associate (Finance & Accounts) to support the Institute’s financial management, accounting, administrative, and compliance functions.
Key Responsibilities
Assist in day-to-day financial operations, including voucher preparation, data entry, bookkeeping, and maintenance of accurate financial records.
Support the preparation of monthly financial statements, expenditure reports, and other financial information.
Assist in budget preparation, budget monitoring, and expenditure tracking for organizational activities and donor-funded programmes.
Process payments, maintain cash and bank records, and assist with bank reconciliations.
Support payroll processing, staff reimbursement, and other employee-related financial transactions.
Assist in preparing donor financial reports and maintaining supporting documents in accordance with grant agreements and donor requirements.
Maintain financial files, vouchers, bills, receipts, and other supporting documents for audit and compliance purposes.
Assist in VAT, income tax, and other statutory compliance activities, as required.
Support procurement documentation, asset registers, inventory records, and related financial administration.
Coordinate with programme and administrative teams to collect financial information and ensure timely processing of transactions.
Assist in internal and external audits by providing relevant financial records and supporting documents.
Perform any other duties assigned by the Deputy Director, Finance or the Executive Director.
Additional Requirements
Qualifications & Experience:
Minimum 1–3 years of relevant experience in finance, accounting, or financial administration, preferably in an NGO, nonprofit, or development organization.
Good knowledge of accounting principles, financial reporting, budgeting, bank reconciliation, and MS Excel. Experience with accounting software will be an advantage.
Basic understanding of donor-funded project financial management and reporting requirements will be an advantage.
Familiarity with Bangladesh’s VAT, income tax, and applicable financial compliance requirements.
Strong numerical and analytical skills, attention to detail, integrity, organizational ability, and effective communication skills.
Candidates with experience in NGO/CSO financial management and donor-funded projects will receive preference.
Compensation & Other Benefits
Compensation: An attractive remuneration package, negotiable and commensurate with the candidate`s qualifications and experience, will be offered along with other admissible benefits.

Plan International Bangladesh
Monitoring, Evaluation, Research and Learning (MERL) Specialist

Education
A Master’s degree in Sociology, Anthropology, Economics, Development Studies, Statistics, or a related discipline, providing the methodological and analytical foundation needed for robust evidence generation.
Employment Status
Contractual
Job Description
Join Us at Plan International Bangladesh: Make a Lasting Impact!
Plan International is an independent development and humanitarian organisation that advances children’s rights and equality for girls. We believe in the power and potential of every child. But this is often suppressed by poverty, violence, exclusion and discrimination. And its girls who are most affected and mostly during crisis. Working together with children, young people, our supporters and partners, we strive for a just world, tackling the root causes of the challenges facing girls and all vulnerable children. For over 85 years, we have rallied other determined optimists to transform the lives of all children in more than 80 countries.
Over the 30 years journey in Bangladesh, we envision a 2030 where children and youth, particularly girls and young women, are recognized as leaders of change in gender norms and can make decisions about their lives.
Since 24 September 2017, Plan International has been responding to the Rohingya refugee influx in Cox’s Bazar with special focus on protecting girls and boys from violence, abuse, neglect, and exploitation; improving hygiene and sanitation; and restoring access to safe, quality, and inclusive education for refugee children and adolescents. Guided by our core values, we remain unwavering in our commitment to advancing children’s rights and equality for girls so that children, especially girls, and their communities can learn, lead, decide, and thrive.
For the past three decades, our work in Bangladesh has made a significant impact, and we are now looking for a Monitoring, Evaluation, Research and Learning (MERL) Specialist.
The Role:
Monitoring, Evaluation, Research and Learning (MERL) Specialist will be responsible for designing and leading the monitoring, evaluation, research and learning (MERL) activities and ensuring result-based management in program and project areas as defined in the country strategy. The position holder will develop the theory of change (TOC), result framework, and indicators to measure success in respective projects & programmes through regular monitoring and evaluation activities. In line with PQI team the Specialist will track output delivery and assess outcomes to understand projects & programmes progress towards achieving objectives, conduct regular process monitoring, compile information, capture learning and produce quarterly reports for the projects & programme team and country management team to support decision-making. Data quality assurance is one of the key responsibilities of this role. The MERL Specialist will also contribute to capacity building of staff at Plan and partner organizations to enhance skills in programme monitoring. The role requires continuous support to resource mobilization initiatives for the Cox’s Bazar Programme. This position provides intensive support to different projects in Cox’s Bazar and other geographic locations and addresses donor requirements in the areas of MERL. Another major responsibility will be supporting the implementation of AAP (accountability to affected population) in different projects.
Additional Requirements
Proven M&E Practitioner with Emergency Expertise: At least 3 years of progressively responsible experience leading M&E systems in development or humanitarian settings, including a minimum of 1 year of emergency response projects in Cox’s Bazar.
Strategic Framework Architect: Demonstrated mastery in designing, operationalizing, and tracking Theories of Change (ToC), results frameworks, logframes, and indicator matrices to measure project and programme success systematically.
Advanced Data & Analytics Specialist: Strong quantitative and qualitative expertise—from managing digital data collection tools and quality assurance to conducting rigorous analysis using MS Excel and statistical packages (SPSS, STATA, or R) to drive evidence-based decisions.
Evaluation & Consultant Coordinator: Proven track record in executing Annual Outcome Monitoring, formulating clear Terms of Reference (ToRs), and managing external consultants and project evaluations to secure high-impact, timely deliverables.
Safeguarding Champion & Agile Field Responder: Deep commitment to child safeguarding, "Do No Harm" ethics, and donor compliance, paired with the readiness to deploy and deliver quality results during rapid-onset disasters or emergency responses.
Compensation & Other Benefits
Salary Package for this role is monthly CTC 128,566 BDT which includes contributory provident fund, gratuity, festival bonus, along with other benefits, i.e., hospitalization benefit for spouse and children, leave, group insurance, yearly medical check-up for employee, and day care facilities.
Company Address: House # CWN (B) 14, Road 35, Gulshan-2, Dhaka-1212
Company Business
Founded 80 years ago, Plan International is one of the oldest and largest childrens development organisations in the world. We work in 52 countries across Africa, Asia and the Americas to promote child rights and lift millions of children out of poverty. In 2015, Plan International worked with 100 million children in 85,282 communities. Plan International is independent, with no religious, political or governmental affiliations but having a vision of a world in which all children realize their full potential in societies that respect peoples rights and dignity. Plan International has been operating in Bangladesh since 1994. Plan International seeks to ensure the rights of children to education, health, safe water and sanitation, protection, youth social and economic empowerment and climate change, environmental degradation and natural or man-made disaster hazards throughout the country.

Founded 80 years ago, Plan International is one of the oldest and largest childrens development organisations in the world. Job Description
Job Summary
Responsible for multi-outlet sales reporting, cash handling, accounting entries, digital payment and bank reconciliation, supplier payments, collections, and financial documentation, ensuring accuracy, timely reporting, and compliance with company policies.
Key Responsibilities
Sales & Accounting:
Prepare daily outlet-wise sales sheets and summaries; verify POS reports, supporting documents, payment channels (cash, cards, bKash, Foodpanda, Pathao, Foodi, etc.), discounts, promotions, refunds, voids, and complimentary meals; identify discrepancies and post accurate, timely Sales Journal Vouchers (JV), Cash Vouchers (CV), receipts, deposits, supplier payments, petty cash, and other approved transactions in Accounts Care, maintaining correct ledgers, cost centres, references, and audit trails.
Cash & Fund Management:
Collect, count, verify, record, and safeguard outlet cash; reconcile collections with sales, deposit funds on time, and report shortages or excesses. Collect and maintain separate records of tips, excess money, scrap-sale proceeds, birthday contributions, and other designated funds; deposit within approved timelines and submit collection summaries and supporting documents.
Reconciliation & Banking:
Reconcile monthly bKash, card, cash, POS, merchant, accounting, and bank records; investigate charges, refunds, failed or delayed settlements, missing deposits, incorrect credits, and discrepancies. Follow up with banks, payment providers, and outlets; monitor outstanding settlements; prepare reconciliation statements and maintain deposit slips, bank statements, cheque records, transfer confirmations, payment advice, and related documents.
Food Bills & Supplier Payments:
Maintain and collect outstanding food bills from management, employees, and authorized persons; issue receipts, update ledgers, deposit collections, and report dues. Verify supplier invoices against purchase orders, delivery challans, goods receipt records, quantities, rates, calculations, VAT, tax deductions, and approvals; identify duplicate or unauthorized claims, prepare payment vouchers and schedules, process approved payments, retain evidence, and assist with supplier balance reconciliation.
Documentation & Reporting:
Maintain secure, organized, outlet-wise and date-wise physical and electronic records of sales reports, cash sheets, card slips, vouchers, collections, and banking documents; send required hard copies to the warehouse or designated office. Ensure signatures, approvals, supporting documents, and cross-references are complete. Assist with daily, weekly, monthly, and month-end reports, cash verification, reconciliations, outstanding transaction lists, collections, supplier payments, and unreconciled balances.
Compliance & Coordination:
Coordinate with outlet managers, warehouse personnel, suppliers, banks, and relevant departments; support internal and external audits; maintain confidentiality and audit-ready records. Follow company policies, authorization procedures, segregation of duties, internal controls, and document-retention rules. Report suspected fraud, duplicate payments, unauthorized transactions, and irregularities; correct errors only with authorization and perform other finance-related duties assigned by Management.
Key Performance Expectations
Accurate and timely reporting and accounting entries; timely deposits; completion of monthly reconciliations within deadlines; prompt resolution and reporting of variances; proper supplier and petty cash documentation; complete, audit-ready records; and compliance with company policies and internal controls.
Reporting To:
Accounts & Finance Manager or designated authority.
Additional Requirements
Age 25 to 35 years
Experience Requirements
2–3 years of relevant experience in Accounts, Finance, or Cash Management.
Practical experience in sales reporting, cash collection, bank deposits, digital payment reconciliation, and supplier payments.
Accounting software experience; knowledge of Accounts Care is an advantage.
Multi-outlet transaction experience, preferably in the restaurant, retail, or FMCG industry.
Skills: Cash Handling, Maintain sales records
Compensation & Other Benefits
Mobile bill
Salary Review: Yearly
Lunch Facilities: Full Subsidize
Festival Bonus: 2
Company Address: JL bhaban,1 Gulshan Avenue, Gulshan-1, Dhaka-1212

কোম্পানির পণ্য (দুধ, ঘি, সরিষার তেলসহ অন্যান্য পণ্য) প্রচার, ব্র্যান্ড পরিচিতি বৃদ্ধি এবং বিক্রয় সম্প্রসারণে কাজ করা।
নতুন গ্রাহক সংগ্রহ করা এবং বিদ্যমান গ্রাহকদের সাথে সুসম্পর্ক বজায় রাখা।
নতুন গ্রাহকদের নাম, মোবাইল নম্বর, ঠিকানা ও প্রয়োজনীয় তথ্য সংগ্রহ করে নির্ধারিত খাতা/রেজিস্টারে সঠিকভাবে এন্ট্রি করা এবং নিয়মিত আপডেট রাখা।
নির্ধারিত মাসিক ও দৈনিক বিক্রয় লক্ষ্যমাত্রা (Sales Target) অর্জন করা।

ডিস্ট্রিবিউটর, হোলসেলার, রিটেইলার এবং কর্পোরেট গ্রাহকদের সাথে নিয়মিত যোগাযোগ ও ব্যবসায়িক সম্পর্ক বজায় রাখা।
বিভিন্ন প্রচারণামূলক কার্যক্রম (Promotional Activities), পণ্য প্রদর্শনী (Product Display), টেস্টিং ক্যাম্পেইন এবং বিক্রয় বৃদ্ধিমূলক কার্যক্রম বাস্তবায়ন করা।
দৈনিক কার্যক্রম, নতুন গ্রাহক সংগ্রহের তথ্য এবং বিক্রয় প্রতিবেদন প্রস্তুত করে কর্তৃপক্ষের নিকট জমা দেওয়া।
কোম্পানির ব্র্যান্ড ইমেজ ও সুনাম অক্ষুণ্ণ রেখে দায়িত্ব পালন করা।
কর্মস্থল:
ঢাকা মহানগরীর বিভিন্ন এলাকা (ক্যাম্পেইন পিকআপের মাধ্যমে ফিল্ড মার্কেটিং)।
কর্মঘণ্টা (দুই শিফটে):
প্রথম শিফট: সকাল ৬:০০টা থেকে সকাল ১১:০০টা পর্যন্ত।
দ্বিতীয় শিফট: বিকাল ৩:৩০টা থেকে রাত ৮:৩০টা পর্যন্ত।
মোট কর্মঘণ্টা: দৈনিক ১০ ঘণ্টা।
বিশেষ শর্ত: প্রতিষ্ঠানের কাজের প্রয়োজনে নির্ধারিত সময়ের অতিরিক্ত কাজ করতে হতে পারে।
